declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The authors conducted the study and prepared the manuscript without any financial support from any outside sources.

detail.abstract: This paper attempts to conduct a spatial economic analysis to observe the Women's & Children's health disparities across districts of West Bengal. The index of Women & Child Healthcare (WCHI) for the years 2015 and 2019 is constructed using the two-stage Principal Component Analysis methodology based on twenty indicators sub-divided into three dimensions. It is found that underage mothers or teenage pregnancy and child nutrition are the major areas of concern for West Bengal. Moran’s I coefficient and LISA cluster maps have revealed regional health interdependence, particularly in the year 2019. A spatial lag regression has identified significant determinants, such as population stress per doctor and hospital bed, affecting health outcomes over space. The findings underscore the need for enhanced healthcare infrastructure and policies to reduce regional inequalities in curative variables within the state.

AI.tldr: 本文利用空间经济分析方法，基于20个指标构建妇女儿童健康指数（WCHI），发现西孟加拉邦在未成年母亲/少女怀孕和儿童营养方面存在突出问题，并通过空间回归识别出人口对医生和病床的压力是影响健康结果的关键因素，强调需加强医疗基础设施以减少区域不平等。
AI.research_question: 西孟加拉邦各地区之间在妇女与儿童健康方面是否存在显著差异？其空间分布特征和影响因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 关注妇女儿童健康这一重要民生指标，试图揭示区域内健康不平等问题及其空间依赖性，为政策制定提供证据支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 空间经济学理论、空间自相关理论（Moran's I）、空间回归模型
AI.method: 采用两阶段主成分分析法（PCA）构建妇女儿童健康指数（WCHI）；使用Moran's I系数和LISA聚类图进行空间自相关分析；运用空间滞后回归模型识别关键影响因素。
AI.findings: （1）未成年母亲/少女怀孕和儿童营养是西孟加拉邦最突出的问题；（2）2019年各地区间存在显著的健康空间依赖性；（3）人均医生负荷和人均病床负荷是显著影响健康结果的空间因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 将空间经济分析方法引入区域妇女儿童健康差异研究，验证了健康结果的空间自相关性和空间溢出效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了医疗基础设施（医生和病床供给）的空间分布不均对健康结果的影响，为改善西孟加拉邦医疗资源配置和制定针对性区域健康政策提供了实证依据。

title: Institutional access and Bitcoin volatility dynamics: evidence from the introduction of a spot Bitcoin ETF (IBIT)
affiliations: Saudi Electronic University

detail.title: Institutional access and Bitcoin volatility dynamics: evidence from the introduction of a spot Bitcoin ETF (IBIT)
detail.abstract: This study examines whether the launch of the iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) is associated with a persistent reconfiguration of Bitcoin's second-moment dynamics, extending beyond the short-run announcement effects documented in prior event studies. Using a multi-method empirical framework on daily data from 2020 to 2026 and a sustained twenty-eight-month post-event window, we document a durable transformation of volatility, persistence, and tail risk rather than a transitory announcement response. While Chow, HAC-Wald, Andrews sup-F, and PELT procedures fail to reject mean stability, annualized volatility declines by approximately 19% to 28% across estimators, with close-to-close, Parkinson, and Garman-Klass measures all yielding statistically significant reductions. EGARCH(1,1,1) estimates indicate that the implied half-life of volatility shocks shortens from approximately 45 to 12 trading days, with a complementary GJR-GARCH specification yielding a post-IBIT half-life of approximately 25 days; both specifications point to a substantial acceleration of shock dissipation. Extreme downside exposure, measured by 1% Value-at-Risk and Expected Shortfall, compresses by approximately 44%, with bootstrap inference confirming statistical significance. At the portfolio level, Bitcoin's marginal contribution to tail risk declines by approximately three-quarters at standard allocation weights. Non-parametric ICSS variance-break detection identifies no discrete break within thirty days of the launch, consistent with a gradual regime adjustment rather than an instantaneous structural switch. Robustness tests using weekly returns, exclusion of the April 2024 halving window, and alternative breakpoints confirm the findings. The results contribute to the literature on cryptocurrency risk dynamics by documenting a coincident compression in Bitcoin's second-moment characteristics around the spot ETF era, a pattern distinct from the volatility responses previously documented for derivative-based products. In contrast to short-window event-study evidence, the compression is shown to persist and to extend into the tail of the return distribution and the portfolio risk budget, dimensions outside the scope of an announcement-window design.

AI.tldr: 本文研究iShares比特币信托（IBIT）的推出是否引发了比特币二阶矩动态的持久性重构。使用2020-2026年日度数据和28个月后事件窗口，发现比特币年化波动率下降19%-28%，波动冲击半衰期从约45天缩短至12天，极端下行风险压缩约44%，投资组合尾部风险贡献下降约75%。这些变化是渐进式的制度调整而非瞬时结构性转变，且在多种稳健性检验下依然成立。
AI.research_question: IBIT（iShares Bitcoin Trust）的推出是否与比特币二阶矩特征（波动率、持续性、尾部风险）的持久性重构相关联，而不仅是短期公告效应？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注比特币衍生品（如期货）推出对波动率的短期影响，但对现货ETF这一重大制度变化的长期影响缺乏研究；此外，已有事件研究多聚焦于短窗口公告效应，无法捕捉持久性的结构变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 二阶矩动态（波动率、持续性、尾部风险）、制度转换/结构断点理论、投资组合尾部风险贡献理论。
AI.method: 多方法实证框架：Chow检验、HAC-Wald检验、Andrews sup-F检验、PELT算法检验均值稳定性；使用close-to-close、Parkinson、Garman-Klass多种波动率估计量；EGARCH(1,1,1)和GJR-GARCH模型估计波动冲击半衰期；1% VaR和Expected Shortfall衡量尾部风险；ICSS非参数方差断点检测；多种稳健性检验（周度数据、排除减半事件窗口、替换断点）。
AI.findings: 1）均值稳定，但波动率显著下降19%-28%；2）EGARCH模型显示波动冲击半衰期从约45天降至12天，GJR-GARCH模型显示降至约25天；3）1% VaR和Expected Shortfall压缩约44%；4）比特币对投资组合尾部风险的边际贡献在标准权重下下降约75%；5）ICSS检测未发现IBIT推出30天内的离散断点，表明是渐进式制度调整而非瞬时结构转换；6）多种稳健性检验支持核心结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）首次记录比特币在现货ETF时代二阶矩特征的压缩模式，区别于此前文献对衍生品（期货）波动率响应的研究结论；2）证明波动率压缩具有持久性，并延伸至回报分布尾部及投资组合风险预算维度，超出了短窗口事件研究的设计范围；3）发现制度调整是渐进式而非瞬时性结构断点，丰富了关于金融市场制度转换动态的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为投资者和风险管理人提供比特币现货ETF时代风险特征变化的关键参数（波动率降幅、半衰期加速、尾部风险压缩比例）；2）为资产配置决策提供尾部风险贡献下降约75%的量化依据；3）为监管机构评估ETF对市场质量和风险的影响提供实证证据；4）强调短期事件研究可能遗漏重要的持久性风险结构变化，提醒实践者采用更长的评估窗口。

title: Global Inflation Monitor — Regime Anchors and Asset Pricing Signals
affiliations: Laval University, Faculté des Sciences Sociales, Département d'Économique, Students

detail.title: Global Inflation Monitor — Regime Anchors and Asset Pricing Signals

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.

detail.abstract: This framework identifies sovereign-specific empirical inflation regime anchors — covering North America, Europe, Latin America, Asia, and key aggregates (G7, EMDE, Sub-Saharan Africa, and MECA) — using a non-parametric 50% Highest Density Region (HDR). The signal is straightforward: when realised inflation breaches the 50% HDR upper bound, inflation exits its dominant historical operating regime, consistent with an expansion in the inflation risk premium.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用非参数50%最高密度区域（HDR）方法，识别了主权国家特有的经验通胀制度锚点，覆盖北美、欧洲、拉丁美洲、亚洲及主要经济集团（G7、EMDE、撒哈拉以南非洲、MECA）。当实际通胀突破50% HDR上界时，意味着通胀脱离其主导历史运行区间，与通胀风险溢价扩张一致。
AI.research_question: 如何识别主权国家特有的经验通胀制度锚点，并判断通胀何时脱离其历史主导运行区间？
AI.motivation: 传统通胀锚定概念多基于理论或政策目标，缺乏基于实际数据的经验识别方法。本文旨在提出一个简单、非参数化的信号，以捕捉通胀风险溢价扩张的时机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀制度锚点、最高密度区域（HDR）、通胀风险溢价理论
AI.method: 非参数50%最高密度区域（HDR）方法
AI.findings: 当实际通胀率突破50% HDR上界时，通胀脱离其历史主导运行区间，这对应于通胀风险溢价的扩张。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于经验数据的通胀制度锚点识别框架，将通胀突破与通胀风险溢价扩张联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了一个直观、简单的通胀风险预警信号，覆盖多个主要经济体和地区。

title: FMD-RTDETR: Adaptive Feature Calibration for Bladder Epithelial Cell Detection in Multiplexed Immunofluorescence Images
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Yunnan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Yunnan University, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Yunnan University and Yunnan University

detail.title: FMD-RTDETR: Adaptive Feature Calibration for Bladder Epithelial Cell Detection in Multiplexed Immunofluorescence Images
detail.abstract: The accurate detection and quantification of bladder epithelial cell markers is essential for elucidating cell population dynamics and disease progression, yet conventional manual profiling methods remain labor-intensive and highly susceptible to subjective bias. To address the challenges of target localization and dense cell adhesion in complex multiplexed fluorescence backgrounds, we propose the Fluorescent Microcell Detection Real-Time Detection Transformer (FMD-RTDETR), an end-toend object detection framework based on RT-DETR, featuring a novel Adaptive Calibration Feature Fusion (ACFF) module. This module replaces conventional fusion with an Attention-based Fusion Module (AFM) incorporating parameter-free High-Resolution Feature Perception (HRFP) to suppress noise while preserving morphological detail. Additionally, the proposed ACFF integrates Contextual and Spatial Feature Calibration (CFC/SFC) to mitigate semantic dilution and spatial misalignmentduring cross-scale fusion. Evaluated on our custom multi-channel Fluorescent Staining of Bladder Epithelial Cells (FSBEC) dataset, FMD-RTDETR achieves an mAP0.5 of 0.895, outperforming stateof-the-art models in robust bounding box regression, handling cellular adhesion, and multi-class phenotyping across four staining profiles. It also attains 0.901 mAP0.5 on the public DSB2018 dataset, demonstrating strong generalization and enabling precise, high-throughput cell quantification for bladder pathology assessment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FMD-RTDETR框架，基于RT-DETR并引入自适应校准特征融合（ACFF）模块，用于荧光显微镜下膀胱上皮细胞的精准检测与量化，在自建FSBEC数据集和公开DSB2018数据集上均取得优异性能。
AI.research_question: 如何实现复杂荧光背景下膀胱上皮细胞标志物的准确检测与量化，以克服传统人工方法的主观偏差和效率低下问题？
AI.motivation: 传统人工手动分析膀胱上皮细胞标志物方法劳动密集且易受主观偏差影响，而现有自动化方法在复杂多重荧光背景下面临目标定位困难和细胞密集粘连等挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于RT-DETR的端到端目标检测框架；自适应校准特征融合（ACFF）模块，包含基于注意力的融合模块（AFM）、无参数高分辨率特征感知（HRFP）、上下文特征校准（CFC）和空间特征校准（SFC）。
AI.method: 提出FMD-RTDETR检测框架，设计ACFF模块替代传统特征融合方式，通过AFM+HRFP抑制噪声并保留形态细节，通过CFC/SFC缓解跨尺度融合中的语义稀释和空间错位。在自建多通道FSBEC数据集和DSB2018数据集上评估。
AI.findings: 在FSBEC数据集上mAP0.5达0.895，优于现有最先进模型；在DSB2018上达0.901 mAP0.5，展现出强泛化能力，能够稳健处理细胞粘连和多类表型识别。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出ACFF模块，将注意力机制与无参数高分辨率感知结合，并引入上下文和空间双重校准机制，为跨尺度特征融合中的语义稀释和空间错位问题提供了新的解决思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 为膀胱病理评估提供了一种精准、高通量的自动化细胞量化工具，可用于膀胱上皮细胞群体动态和疾病进展研究。

title: Cloud Value Chains in the Age of AI
affiliations: and University of North Carolina (UNC) at Chapel Hill - Operations Area

detail.title: Cloud Value Chains in the Age of AI
detail.abstract: The rapid adoption of generative AI is transforming cloud computing from a virtualized service platform into a tightly coupled, capital-intensive value chain spanning upstream supply networks (hardware, energy, and data), midstream AI data centers, and downstream AI platform ecosystems. In this AI era, traditional cloud assumptions-predictable performance from provisioned resources, frictionless elastic scaling, and unconstrained upstream inputs-are breaking down due to heterogeneous training and inference workloads, token-based performance measurement and pricing, and two-sided information asymmetry regarding demand characteristics and providers' hidden operational controls. To address these fundamental changes, this paper proposes an end-to-end framework for analyzing AI-driven cloud value chains from a holistic operations management (OM) perspective. Using this framework, we (i) articulate how AI workloads and production pipelines differ fundamentally from those of traditional cloud computing; (ii) map the key actors and interactions across downstream platform ecosystems, midstream AI data centers, and upstream supply networks; and (iii) synthesize emerging industry practices to develop a research agenda spanning strategic (e.g., coopetition, vertical integration, and long-term capacity expansion under sustainability objectives and policy constraints), tactical (e.g., pricing, capacity reservation and allocation mechanisms, and procurement of hardware, energy, and data services), and operational (e.g., compute pipeline scheduling, congestion control, and grid contingency planning) decisions. The proposed framework helps managers and policymakers diagnose bottlenecks and incentive conflicts while identifying their underlying drivers. In particular, AI platform providers should align pricing and contracting mechanisms with output uncertainty and information asymmetry, while cloud infrastructure and foundation model providers should design capacity reservation, allocation, and real-time pipeline control policies that reflect training-inference differences and throughput-latency tradeoffs. Together, these challenges require coordinated procurement, capacity planning, and operational strategies to scale AI infrastructure efficiently, responsibly, and sustainably.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个端到端的分析框架，从运营管理视角系统分析生成式AI驱动下的云计算价值链变革，涵盖上游供应网络、中游AI数据中心和下游平台生态，并据此提出战略、战术和运营层面的研究议程。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI如何从根本上改变传统云计算价值链的结构与运营逻辑？如何构建一个端到端的运营管理框架来系统分析这些变化并指导未来决策？
AI.motivation: 传统云计算的核心假设（可预测性能、弹性伸缩、无约束上游输入）在生成式AI时代已不再成立。AI带来的异构训练/推理负载、基于token的计费与绩效度量、以及上下游之间的信息不对称，使得现有运营管理理论难以适用，亟需新的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 端到端（End-to-End）AI驱动的云计算价值链分析框架，整合了运营管理中的战略决策（竞合、垂直整合、长期产能扩张）、战术决策（定价、容量分配、采购机制）和运营决策（计算管道调度、拥塞控制、电网应急规划）。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与概念性分析，综合新兴行业实践进行系统性综述，并在此基础上提出研究议程。
AI.findings: （1）AI工作负载与传统云计算的差异在于异构性、token化绩效度量与定价、双向信息不对称；（2）价值链各环节的关键角色与互动机制被系统梳理；（3）识别出三类决策层面的研究机会：战略层面（竞合、垂直整合、可持续产能扩张）、战术层面（定价、容量预留与分配、硬件/能源/数据采购）、运营层面（调度、拥塞控制、电网应急）；（4）AI平台应使定价与产出不确定性及信息不对称对齐；基础设施与基础模型提供商需设计反映训练-推理差异和吞吐-延迟权衡的容量与调度策略。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将运营管理理论拓展至生成式AI驱动的云计算新情境，突破了传统云计算OM假设的局限；（2）构建了涵盖战略-战术-运营三个层面的系统性分析框架，为后续理论研究提供了统一的坐标系；（3）识别了信息不对称、产出不确定性、异构工作负载等核心OM问题在AI价值链中的新表现。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为AI平台、云基础设施和基础模型提供商提供了定价、容量规划、调度等关键决策的诊断框架；（2）帮助管理者与政策制定者识别价值链中的瓶颈与激励冲突；（3）指导AI基础设施的高效、负责任和可持续规模化扩张。

title: Empirical Analysis Of Capm Model

detail.title: Empirical Analysis Of Capm Model

declarations.declarationOfInterest: All authors should briefly state any personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations that may have or could be perceived to have influenced their study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is based on publicly available secondary data obtained from stock market sources. No human participants, patients, personal data, surveys, or interviews were involved. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required for this research.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant, funding, or financial support from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit organization.

detail.abstract: • The study examines CAPM in the Indian stock market. Beta is used as the measure of systematic risk. Weekly returns are calculated from BSE Bhavcopy data. Time-series regression is used to estimate beta and cross-sectional regression is used to test the beta-return relationship. Stocks are also grouped into portfolios. Results show a weak and inconsistent relationship between beta and returns, providing limited support for CAPM

AI.tldr: 研究在印度股票市场检验CAPM，发现Beta与收益之间关系微弱且不稳定，对CAPM提供有限支持。
AI.research_question: 印度股票市场中的Beta系数与股票收益之间是否存在CAPM所预测的正向关系？
AI.motivation: CAPM作为经典资产定价模型在发达市场已被广泛检验，但在新兴市场（如印度）的适用性尚需实证验证。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资本资产定价模型（CAPM），系统性风险（Beta）与预期收益之间的线性正相关关系。
AI.method: 使用BSE Bhavcopy的周度收益率数据，通过时间序列回归估计Beta，再通过横截面回归检验Beta与收益的关系，同时将股票分组为投资组合进行分析。
AI.findings: Beta与股票收益之间存在微弱且不一致的关系，CAPM在印度市场仅获得有限支持。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了新兴市场（印度）对CAPM有效性的检验证据，表明CAPM的适用性可能存在市场依赖特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒印度市场的投资者与分析师，单纯依赖Beta作为风险衡量指标进行资产定价或投资决策可能不足，需结合其他风险因子。

title: Sovereign Debt, Inflation, and Capital Distortion: Quantifying Argentina’s First-Order Growth Margins
affiliations: , University of Miami - School of Business Administration - Department of Economics and University of Miami - School of Business Administration - Department of Economics

detail.title: Sovereign Debt, Inflation, and Capital Distortion: Quantifying Argentina’s First-Order Growth Margins
detail.abstract: We assess the medium-run growth potential of Argentina under President Milei’s stabilization-and-reform program by computing alternative scenaro bounds in a calibrated neoclassical framework benchmarked against Latin American, OECD, and post-EU-integration Eastern European peers. Using García-Belenguer et al.  (2026) evidence on the dual sovereign-debt/inflation channel, we treat sovereign-debt cycles and inflation as central macroeconomic forces behind Argentina’s productivity gap relative to regional peers, and Argentina’s high net marginal product of capital as evidence of binding investment-cost distortions. Counterfactual scenario bounds imply medium-term gains in GDP per worker ranging from roughly 11% under a partial-reform lower bound to 65% under a deep-reform upper bound, with a stabilization-oriented intermediate case generating about 24%. Crucially, a solvency-led variant of this intermediate case—in which debt-driven channels are fully resolved while disinflation remains modest—preserves roughly three-quarters of the total gains (about 19% of GDP per worker). This finding demonstrates that restoring fiscal solvency serves as the first-order growth margin at Argentina’s current debt and inflation levels.

AI.tldr: 本文在 calibrated 新古典框架下，评估了阿根廷总统米莱稳定与改革方案的中期增长潜力。通过考虑主权债务/通胀双重渠道，设定了部分改革（11%）、深度改革（65%）和稳定导向中间情景（24%）的GDP每工人增长区间。其中，偿债能力主导的中间变体（仅解决债务渠道，通胀温和下降）仍能保留约19%的增长，表明恢复财政偿债能力是阿根廷当前的首要增长边际。
AI.research_question: 在米莱政府稳定与改革方案下，阿根廷的中期增长潜力有多大？不同改革深度对应的GDP每工人增长区间是多少？
AI.motivation: 阿根廷长期面临高通胀、主权债务危机和低生产率困境。米莱上台后推行激进改革，但其增长效果尚缺乏量化评估。本文旨在为这一自然实验提供前瞻性的基准分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新古典增长框架（校准后的索洛模型），结合García-Belenguer等人（2026）提出的主权债务/通胀双重渠道理论，以及投资成本扭曲导致资本边际产品净额偏高的逻辑。
AI.method: 校准新古典模型，以拉美、OECD和东欧国家为基准，设定三种改革情景（部分改革、稳定导向中间情景、深度改革），并拆解偿债能力渠道与通胀渠道的贡献。
AI.findings: 部分改革下限增长约11%，深度改革上限增长约65%，稳定导向中间情景增长约24%。偿债能力主导的变体（仅解决债务问题）仍能实现约19%的增长，占总增益的3/4，表明恢复财政偿债能力是当前首要增长边际。
AI.theory_contributions: 量化分离了主权债务渠道与通胀渠道对增长的不同贡献，明确了在阿根廷当前债务与通胀水平下，偿债能力恢复是比去通胀更优先的增长驱动因素。
AI.practical_contributions: 为米莱政府的改革优先级提供了量化依据：应优先恢复财政偿债能力，再推进结构性改革以实现更大增长；同时也为其他高债务、高通胀新兴经济体提供了可借鉴的分析框架。

title: Jurisdictional Reward Funds for Tropical Forest Conservation and Restoration
affiliations: Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK), University of Potsdam - Economics and Social Sciences, Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research and Potsdam-Institut für Klimafolgenforschung (PIK)

detail.title: Jurisdictional Reward Funds for Tropical Forest Conservation and Restoration

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There is nothing to declare
declarations.funderStatement: Acknowledging financial support by the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) under the TRANSFORM project (Grant No. : 421 K8187-3012/006).

detail.abstract: Tropical forests store enormous carbon stocks, yet the global value of keeping them standing accrues to the world while the cost of conservation falls on the countries that own them. Results-based reward funds can close this gap, but tailoring each country's baseline to its own past clearing invites a ratchet effect that blunts incentives. We study the optimal design of a jurisdictional reward fund that pays a common, formula-based reward on net deforestation below a universal reference level, building on the Reversing Deforestation Mechanism of Assunção et al (2025). We first develop a dynamic model and show that static, contemporaneous incentives dominate dynamic, stock-based ones, reducing the design problem to a tractable static screening problem under informational anonymity. We derive closed-form expressions for the optimal reference level, reward rate, and induced emission reductions as functions of the budget, and show that exactly half of any budget is paid out as inframarginal rent. We calibrate the model using data from 76 tropical-forest countries (2002-2024). In a voluntary contributions game, the EU and China form a stable coalition contributing about USD 5.5 billion per year, avoiding 121 MtCO 2 annually.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了热带森林保护中基于结果奖励基金的最优设计问题，提出了一个统一的、基于公式的参考水平奖励机制，并通过动态模型和静态筛选问题推导出最优参考水平、奖励率和减排量的闭式解，利用76个热带森林国家的数据进行校准，发现欧盟和中国组成的稳定联盟每年可贡献约55亿美元，避免1.21亿吨二氧化碳排放。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个最优的管辖区域奖励基金，通过统一的、基于公式的参考水平来激励热带森林国家减少净毁林，从而在有限预算下最大化减排效果？
AI.motivation: 热带森林储存了巨大的碳储量，但保护的成本由森林所在国承担，而全球收益却由全世界共享。基于结果的奖励基金可以弥补这一差距，但为每个国家量身定制基线会导致棘轮效应，削弱激励。因此需要设计一个更优的激励机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态模型（证明静态即期激励优于动态存量激励）；静态筛选问题（在信息匿名条件下将设计问题简化为可处理的静态筛选问题）；自愿贡献博弈（分析欧盟和中国等国家的合作联盟稳定性）。
AI.method: 首先建立动态模型分析激励结构，证明静态即期激励占优；将问题简化为静态筛选问题，推导出最优参考水平、奖励率和减排量的闭式解；利用76个热带森林国家2002-2024年的数据进行校准，并通过自愿贡献博弈分析联盟稳定性。
AI.findings: 静态即期激励优于动态存量激励；最优参考水平和奖励率可表达为预算的函数；任何预算中恰好有一半会作为边际内租金支付出去；欧盟和中国可以形成一个稳定联盟，每年贡献约55亿美元，每年避免1.21亿吨二氧化碳排放。
AI.theory_contributions: 将棘轮效应问题纳入激励机制设计；证明在匿名信息条件下静态筛选问题的可处理性；推导出最优激励结构的闭式解；揭示了预算中一半作为边际内租金支付的精确比例关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国际热带森林保护基金设计提供了可操作的方案，包括统一的参考水平设定和奖励率计算；识别出欧盟和中国作为关键贡献者的稳定联盟及其所需资金规模，对实际气候政策的国际合作具有重要指导意义。

title: Locally Conservative, Globally Not: Diagnosing the Lagrangian Structure of Pretrained Transformers

detail.title: Locally Conservative, Globally Not: Diagnosing the Lagrangian Structure of Pretrained Transformers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. This research was conducted independently, outside the scope of any employment, with no external funding, no financial relationships with any organization relevant to the subject of this work, and no personal relationships that could be perceived to have influenced the study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This research involves no human participants, patient data, clinical studies, or personal data of any kind. All experiments were conducted on publicly available pretrained language models (GPT-2, Pythia) and synthetic text corpora.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding. This research was self-funded and conducted independently.

detail.abstract: We give an exact mechanical interpretation of the cosine Semantic Tube Prediction (STP) loss of Huang et al. (2026) and use it to construct a static architectural diagnostic for the global Lagrangian structure of pretrained transformers. The mathematical core is the closed-form identity  L_STP = 1 − √(1 − |a⊥|² / |d₂|²) , which relates the cosine STP loss between three consecutive hidden states to the magnitude of the component of acceleration normal to the trajectory; we prove the identity algebraically and verify it to machine precision across 1,314 consecutive triplets on GPT-2. Two structural consequences follow immediately: STP loss is blind to the tangential component of acceleration, which we measure to be approximately twice the normal component on GPT-2, and deceleration along the trajectory is the direct mechanical signature of a learned restoring force, with 97.9% of triplets decelerating and a permutation null at z <-11 establishing that sequential token order produces significantly smoother trajectories than random orderings. Both findings replicate on Pythia-160M. These descriptive results establish local hallmarks of damped Lagrangian flow on a bounded attractive potential as a property of trained attention transformers. The natural follow-up-whether the per-layer hidden-state updates globally derive from a single shared scalar potential-is empirically testable. We fit the joint regression Δh_ℓ ≈ α_ℓ · v_ℓ − β_ℓ · ∇V_ψ(h_ℓ) across all layers with a single learned V ψ on frozen checkpoints, and obtain a three-way architectural separator on Tiny Shakespeare: a weight-tied scalar-potential autoregressive flow (used here as a positive control) attains median per-layer test R 2 = 0.957 with a uniform layer profile; a scale-and data-matched 8M-parameter GPT-2-style decoder reaches R 2 = 0.54 with monotonic decay; pretrained GPT-2 small reaches R 2 = 0.46 with a bathtub profile (middle-band mean 0.09). Three independent controls rule out alternative explanations: an oracle fit using the positive control's own potential attains R 2 = 0.931 on the LayerNorm variant (and 1.0000 on the base architecture); a V ψ capacity sweep over a 16× parameter band rules out expressivity limitation; and the separation reproduces under orthogonal token-direction coordinates. All three architectures pass a velocity-aware Jacobian-symmetry test at PCA-16, making local per-step conservativity universal while global shared-potential structure remains architectural. We therefore characterise the Lagrangian content of trained attention transformers as locally conservative but globally not derivable from a shared scalar potential. We provide both a sharper reading of what STP-style training objectives do and do not measure, and a reproducible architectural diagnostic that other globally-Lagrangian designs can be evaluated against.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对余弦STP损失的力学解释，构建了预训练Transformer全局拉格朗日结构的静态架构诊断方法。核心发现是：训练后的注意力Transformer在局部呈现保守性（每步更新可近似为势能梯度下降），但全局上无法归因于单一共享标量势函数。研究通过代数证明、GPT-2和Pythia-160M验证，以及三种架构（权重绑定标量势流、GPT-2风格解码器、预训练GPT-2 small）的对比实验，揭示了架构间的可分离特征。
AI.research_question: 预训练Transformer的隐藏状态更新是否在全局上服从单一共享标量势函数驱动的拉格朗日动力学？
AI.motivation: 已有的余弦STP损失（Huang et al., 2026）虽被用于表征Transformer的语义轨迹特性，但其力学含义尚不明确。作者希望从力学角度精确解释STP损失，并利用它诊断Transformer的全局拉格朗日结构，为理解注意力机制的动力学特性提供理论基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拉格朗日动力学（Lagrangian mechanics）、阻尼振荡系统（damped Lagrangian flow）、势能梯度下降（scalar potential gradient descent）、余弦相似度度量
AI.method: 1. 代数推导余弦STP损失与加速度法向分量的恒等关系；2. 在GPT-2和Pythia-160M上进行数值验证（1314个连续三元组）；3. 构建三种架构（权重绑定标量势流、GPT-2风格解码器、预训练GPT-2 small）进行联合回归拟合（Δh_ℓ ≈ α_ℓ·v_ℓ − β_ℓ·∇V_ψ(h_ℓ)）；4. 使用置换检验、正交坐标变换、容量扫描等三个对照实验排除替代解释；5. 进行雅可比对称性检验。
AI.findings: 1. STP损失仅对加速度法向分量敏感，而对切向分量"盲视"；2. GPT-2中97.9%的三元组存在减速现象（阻尼特征）；3. 三种架构在全局共享势函数拟合中呈现明显可分离特征（权重绑定流R²=0.957，GPT-2风格解码器R²=0.54单调衰减，预训练GPT-2 small R²=0.46浴盆曲线）；4. 所有架构通过局部雅可比对称性检验（PCA-16），具有局部保守性但非全局共享势。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了余弦STP损失与加速度法向分量的精确力学对应关系（闭式恒等式）；2. 揭示了注意力Transformer的拉格朗日动力学本质：局部保守但全局非共享势；3. 为理解Transformer的隐藏状态更新机制提供了新的力学分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了一个可复现的架构诊断工具，用于评估不同架构的全局拉格朗日结构；2. 澄清了STP训练目标的测量边界——它仅捕获法向加速度分量，不反映切向动力学信息；3. 为设计具有全局拉格朗日特性的新型Transformer架构提供了基准。

AI.tldr: 本文回应了对《加州亿万富豪税法案》中居住地规则提出的各种（薄弱的）法律论据批评。
AI.research_question: 《加州亿万富豪税法案》中的居住地规则是否经得起法律层面的批评？
AI.motivation: 针对该法案居住地规则存在的法律争议（特别是关于合宪性、税收管辖权等薄弱法律论点），进行系统性的反驳与澄清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收法律理论、宪法学（州际税收管辖权）、居住地认定法律标准。
AI.method: 法律论辩分析——对批评该法案居住地规则的各类法律论点进行逐一批驳与回应。

title: A Reproducible Control-Validation Workflow for Circular-Shift and Surrogate Tests of Galactic Radial Profiles
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: A Reproducible Control-Validation Workflow for Circular-Shift and Surrogate Tests of Galactic Radial Profiles
detail.abstract: We present the Nisa Radial Control Battery (NRCB), a reproducible software workflow for branch-separated control validation of galactic radial-profile diagnostics. The package is designed for astronomical applications in which radial ordering, profile structure, and surrogate comparisons must be kept distinct from physical interpretation. NRCB implements compact, auditable control branches including shuffle/permutation controls, exhaustive circular-shift controls, random-phase surrogate tests, and fixed-reference profile comparisons. The workflow is demonstrated on derived SPARC-based radial-profile products, while raw SPARC data are not redistributed.The release emphasises reproducibility rather than model optimisation. It includes compact derived tables, figure-generation scripts, provenance records, checksum manifests, a preflight validator, and a quickstart notebook that reproduces headline summary values and regenerates manuscript figures without requiring a full production rerun. The software release also separates lightweight paper reproduction from full-production modes that require external data dependencies.NRCB is intended as a controlled computational layer for testing whether apparent radial-profile structure survives appropriate ordering-preserving and phase-randomised controls. The manuscript describes the workflow architecture, implementation safeguards, validation checks, and public release package, providing a reusable basis for transparent control testing in astronomical radial-profile analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Nisa径向控制电池（NRCB），一个用于星系径向剖面诊断的支路分离控制验证的可复现软件工作流，通过多种控制测试（如置换控制、循环移位控制、随机相位替代检验等）来检验径向剖面结构是否能够在排序保持和相位随机化控制下保持显著，强调可复现性而非模型优化。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个可复现的、分支分离的软件工作流，用于对星系径向剖面分析进行透明的控制验证，以区分真实物理结构与随机或排序保持伪影？
AI.motivation: 在天文径向剖面分析中，径向排序、剖面结构和替代比较需要与物理解释保持分离，但目前缺乏标准化、可审计的控制验证工作流来确保分析结果的稳健性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制验证方法论，包括排序保持控制（permutation/shuffle controls）、循环移位控制、随机相位替代检验（random-phase surrogate tests）以及固定参考剖面比较。
AI.method: 开发NRCB可复现软件工作流，包含多个独立的控制分支模块、数据清单、校验清单、预检验证器、快速入门笔记本，以及轻量级论文复现模式与完整生产模式的分离。
AI.findings: NRCB工作流能够在SPARC径向剖面产品上运行，通过多种控制测试检验剖面结构的显著性，并实现了从轻量级复现到完整生产运行的灵活部署。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一套系统化的控制验证框架，将多类控制测试（置换、循环移位、随机相位、固定参考）整合为统一的可复现工作流，为天文径向剖面分析提供了方法论层面的验证标准。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个开源、可复现的软件包，包含完整的文档、数据清单、校验验证和快速入门工具，使其他研究者能够透明地对其径向剖面分析进行控制测试，提升了天文数据分析的可靠性和可复现性。

title: An Evidence-Linked Multimodal MRI-Based AI System for Liver Lesion Assessment: Multi-Center and Prospective Validation
affiliations: Sichuan University, Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR), Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) - Institute of High Performance Computing and

detail.title: An Evidence-Linked Multimodal MRI-Based AI System for Liver Lesion Assessment: Multi-Center and Prospective Validation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This multicenter prospective validation study was approved by the Medical Ethics Committee of the First Affiliated Hospital of Guangxi Medical University, which served as the lead institution (approval number: E0084). The study was conducted in accordance with the principles of the Declaration of Helsinki. The requirement for informed consent was waived by the ethics committee because the study used anonymized clinical data generated during routine care and involved no direct patient interaction or intervention. Ethical approval was also obtained from the institutional review boards or ethics committees of all participating centers in accordance with their local regulatory requirements.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (Grant No. 82560338); the Science and Technology Department of Guangxi (Grant No. 2025GXNSFAA069531); the Science and Technology Department of Hainan Province (Grant No. ZDYF2024SHFZ052); the Post-doctoral Station Development Project of Sanya (Grant No. 23CZ009).

detail.abstract:
Background: Accurate non-invasive assessment of liver lesions on multiphasic MRI is essential for diagnostic triage, treatment planning and multidisciplinary management, particularly for distinguishing hepatocellular carcinoma, intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma, benign lesions and normal liver. Existing AI systems for liver MRI often generate diagnostic outputs without explicitly integrating cross-sequence information or linking predictions to lesion-level visual evidence. This study aimed to develop and evaluate an evidence-linked multimodal MRI-based AI system for liver lesion assessment.

Methods: In this multicentre diagnostic study, multimodal liver MRI data from patients were collected across participating hospitals in China. LiverGrounder was trained using a single-centre cohort and evaluated in independent internal, external, and prospective datasets, including external validation across eight independent centres. The prospective validation study was registered under ChiCTR2600123350. The study included more than 52,000 MRI slices, nearly 30,000 lesion annotations, and more than 188,000 question–answer pairs. LiverGrounder was compared with representative state-of-the-art multimodal vision-language models for lesion localisation, closed-ended diagnostic assessment, open-ended question answering, and report generation. In a prospective reader study, 12 radiologists assessed cases without and with AI assistance. A web-based research interface was implemented to support inspection of multimodal MRI inputs, sequential diagnostic questions, lesion-level visual evidence, model-generated outputs and per-modality gating weights.

Findings: In the internal test set, LiverGrounder achieved an mIoU of 0·5706 for lesion localisation, an average closed-ended diagnostic accuracy of 0·9406, an open-ended F1 score of 0·9585, and report-generation scores of 0·4591 for BLEU-1 and 0·3738 for ROUGE-L. Across eight external validation cohorts, average closed-ended diagnostic accuracies ranged from 0·7135 to 0·8527 and open-ended F1 scores ranged from 0·7561 to 0·8986; in external localisation cohorts, mIoU values ranged from 0·4390 to 0·5218. In the prospective evaluation, LiverGrounder achieved an mIoU of 0·5830, an average closed-ended diagnostic accuracy of 0·8600, an open-ended F1 score of 0·8289, and report-generation scores of 0·3690 for BLEU-1 and 0·2979 for ROUGE-L. Dataset-level improvements over the best-performing baseline model were significant across evaluated tasks (p<0·001). In the prospective reader study, AI assistance improved diagnostic accuracy from 66·0–74·0% to 88·0–96·0% among junior radiologists, reduced average reading time by 40–60% across experience levels, and increased inter-reader agreement from 0·588 to 0·852.

Interpretation: LiverGrounder provides an evidence-linked multimodal MRI-based AI system and research interface for transparent liver lesion assessment. In multicentre and prospective validation, the system improved automated assessment and supported more accurate, spatially grounded and consistent radiologist interpretation, suggesting potential value for non-invasive liver tumour assessment pending further real-world clinical evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个名为LiverGrounder的基于多模态MRI的AI系统，用于肝脏病变的透明评估。该系统整合了多序列MRI信息，能提供病变定位、闭合式诊断、开放式问答和报告生成等功能。在超过52,000张MRI切片、近30,000个病变标注和188,000个问答对的数据上训练和验证，并在多中心前瞻性研究中得到验证。AI辅助使初级放射科医生的诊断准确率从66-74%提升至88-96%，阅读时间减少40-60%，读者间一致性从0.588提升至0.852。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个能够整合跨序列MRI信息、提供病变级视觉证据链接的多模态AI系统，用于肝脏病变的透明、准确评估？
AI.motivation: 现有肝脏MRI的AI系统通常未明确整合跨序列信息，也未将预测结果与病变级视觉证据相关联，缺乏透明性和可解释性。因此需要开发一种能够提供证据链接的多模态MRI AI系统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多模态视觉-语言模型（VLM）、病变定位与诊断推理、跨序列信息融合、基于注意力的门控机制。
AI.method: 多中心诊断研究。收集来自中国多家医院的肝脏多模态MRI数据，构建LiverGrounder系统（包含52,000+切片、30,000+病变标注、188,000+问答对）。在内部、外部（8个独立中心）和前瞻性数据集上验证。与多个代表性多模态视觉-语言模型比较。进行前瞻性读者研究（12名放射科医生），评估有/无AI辅助下的诊断表现。
AI.findings: 内部测试集：病变定位mIoU 0.5706，闭合式诊断准确率0.9406，开放式F1 0.9585。8个外部验证集：诊断准确率0.7135-0.8527。前瞻性验证：mIoU 0.5830，诊断准确率0.8600。AI辅助使初级放射科医生诊断准确率从66-74%提升至88-96%，阅读时间减少40-60%，读者间一致性从0.588提升至0.852。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种证据链接的多模态MRI AI系统框架，实现了跨序列信息显式整合与病变级视觉证据的可解释关联，为透明AI辅助诊断提供了新的理论范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了LiverGrounder系统和网络研究界面，显著提升了放射科医生的诊断准确率、效率和一致性，尤其对初级医生帮助更大，可用于无创肝肿瘤评估的临床辅助。

title: Forest Protection and Landslide Regulation: A Global Ecosystem Service Methodology to Value Avoided Human Mortality
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Forest Protection and Landslide Regulation: A Global Ecosystem Service Methodology to Value Avoided Human Mortality
detail.abstract: Forests and other natural vegetation can reduce landslide risk by stabilizing slopes, yet their mortality-reduction benefits are rarely quantified at global scale. This study develops a 1 km annual framework that combines the Unified Global Landslide Catalogue with gridded terrain, climate, road, population, and forest-loss data to estimate avoided human mortality from forest-mediated landslide regulation. Landslide occurrence is modeled with a logit specification and conditional fatalities with a hurdle-severity model, then combined under observed and counterfactual deforestation scenarios. The resulting pixel-level estimates are aggregated to countries, World Bank regions, and the globe, and monetized using GDP-adjusted values of a statistical life. Results show that avoided mortality is concentrated in mountain regions of the Andes, Europe, and Asia, while economic values vary with income levels as well as hazard exposure. The framework advances valuation of an underrepresented regulating service by linking hazard modeling with mortality prediction and producing globally comparable, reproducible estimates that can inform natural capital accounting (SEEA) and policy in underrepresented regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了全球1公里分辨率框架，量化森林通过调节滑坡风险所避免的人类死亡率，发现安第斯山脉、欧洲和亚洲山区效益最集中，经济价值随收入水平和灾害暴露程度变化。
AI.research_question: 森林等自然植被通过稳定坡面减少滑坡风险，但其避免死亡率效益在全球尺度上如何量化？
AI.motivation: 森林调节滑坡的死亡率减少效益很少在全球尺度上被量化，这导致自然资本核算中一项重要的调节服务被低估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 滑坡灾害建模（logit模型）、条件致死率建模（hurdle-severity模型）、反事实情景分析、统计生命价值估值
AI.method: 结合全球滑坡目录与1公里网格化的地形、气候、道路、人口和森林损失数据；采用logit模型建模滑坡发生概率，hurdle-severity模型建模条件致死率；在观测与反事实毁林情景下进行估计；结果按国家、世界银行区域和全球汇总，并使用GDP调整后的统计生命价值进行货币化。
AI.findings: 森林避免的死亡率集中在安第斯山脉、欧洲和亚洲的山区；经济价值随收入水平以及灾害暴露程度而变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 将灾害建模与死亡率预测相结合，推进了对这一代表性不足的调节服务（森林滑坡调节）的估值框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供全球可比较、可复现的估值结果，可为自然资本核算（SEEA）及代表性不足地区的政策制定提供信息。

title: Impact of Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency on Carbon Emission Reduction Strategies in Germany and Norway
affiliations: Jiangsu Normal University

detail.title: Impact of Renewable Energy and Energy Efficiency on Carbon Emission Reduction Strategies in Germany and Norway
detail.abstract: This research examines energy efficiency as a crucial tactic for cutting carbon emissions, improving energy security, and bringing down energy expenses in Germany and Norway. We estimate energy efficiency at the province level from 2001 to 2020 using ARDL and VAR or VECM models, examining regional variances and the variables influencing energy efficiency using a panel data model. According to our research, improving energy flow might result in a yearly decrease of more than 4.1 million tons of CO2 emissions. Interestingly, there are notable differences in energy efficiency across German regions in the industrial sector. Using dynamic panel regression, we examine the various effects of environmental regulations on energy efficiency and find two key findings: (1) at certain levels of stringency, both market-based and command-and-control environmental regulations have a positive impact on total factor energy efficiency, and (2) there are nonlinear relationships between environmental regulations and overall factor energy efficiency. The success of the suggested coordinated optimization strategy is further supported by the findings, which show that energy efficiency in the whole ethylene process rises by an average of 4.99% while energy consumption in cracking output drops by 5.90 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2001-2020年德国和挪威省级层面的能源效率，发现工业部门存在显著区域差异，环境规制与能源效率呈非线性关系，且协调优化策略可使乙烯过程能源效率提升4.99%。
AI.research_question: 德国和挪威的能源效率如何？环境规制如何影响能源效率？
AI.motivation: 能源效率是减少碳排放、提高能源安全和降低能源成本的关键策略，但区域差异和环境规制的影响尚需深入探究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源效率理论、环境规制理论（市场型与命令控制型）
AI.method: ARDL模型、VAR/VECM模型、面板数据模型、动态面板回归
AI.findings: （1）改善能源流可使CO2年排放减少超过410万吨；（2）德国工业部门能源效率存在显著区域差异；（3）环境规制与全要素能源效率存在非线性关系；（4）协调优化使乙烯过程能源效率平均提升4.99%，能耗降低5.90%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了环境规制与能源效率之间的非线性关系，区分了市场型和命令控制型规制的差异化影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为德国和挪威的区域能源效率提升提供了实证依据，提出了协调优化策略以降低工业能耗和碳排放。

title: Pricing Electricity in Resource-Rich Economies: Reconciling Full-Chain Costs with Macroeconomic Realities
affiliations: Western Washington University and Islamic Azad University

detail.title: Pricing Electricity in Resource-Rich Economies: Reconciling Full-Chain Costs with Macroeconomic Realities
detail.abstract: Traditional electricity pricing models predominantly focus on direct generation and delivery expenses, often neglecting the broader systemic externalities assumed by the public. In monopolistic, heavily subsidized energy markets, this narrow scope obscures the true macroeconomic cost of power generation, systematically transferring unrecovered financial and environmental burdens to public deficits. To address this critical gap, this paper introduces a comprehensive macroeconomic pricing framework that quantifies the total socio-economic cost of electricity. The novel methodology constructs four-tiered pricing benchmarks—ranging from minimal deferred costs to total macroeconomic costs—by aggregating direct operational expenses, hidden resource subsidies, intergenerational scarcity premiums, and systemic damage costs (environmental, health, and value of lost load). Contextualized within Iran’s state-dominated energy market, the model evaluates the magnitude of pricing distortions against these structured tiers using residential consumption data from Mashhad. Rather than merely confirming the existence of subsidies, the empirical findings anatomize the structural deficit, identifying exactly at which tier the current administered tariffs fail to recover operational baselines, thereby mathematically elucidating the paradox of severe electricity shortages in a resource-rich nation. Finally, by integrating a dynamic socioeconomic calibration mechanism that balances cost-reflectivity with consumer affordability, this research provides a rigorous, scalable diagnostic and policy blueprint. This framework is highly applicable to other resource-rich or transitional economies seeking a phased, mathematically grounded pathway out of energy subsidy traps toward sustainable grid management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个四层级的宏观电力定价框架，量化电力的全社会经济成本（包括直接运营成本、隐性资源补贴、代际稀缺溢价和系统性损害成本），并以伊朗马什哈德为例，揭示垄断补贴市场中电价严重扭曲的结构性根源，为资源丰富或转型经济体提供可持续电价改革的诊断工具和路径蓝图。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能全面量化电力社会经济总成本的宏观定价框架，以揭示垄断补贴能源市场中电价扭曲的真实程度和结构性根源？
AI.motivation: 传统电价模型仅关注直接发电和输送成本，忽视了更广泛的系统性外部性（如环境、健康、资源代际稀缺等），导致在垄断补贴市场中，真正的宏观经济成本被隐藏，财政和环境负担被转移至公共赤字中。这一关键缺口亟需弥补。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观经济学定价理论、外部性内部化理论、代际公平与资源稀缺理论、系统性损害成本核算（环境、健康、失负荷价值）
AI.method: 构建四层级定价基准（最小递延成本→总宏观经济成本），聚合直接运营费用、隐性资源补贴、代际稀缺溢价和系统性损害成本四类成本；以伊朗马什哈德居民用电数据进行实证校准与分析。
AI.findings: 当前受管制定价在哪个层级未能覆盖运营基准线，精确揭示了资源丰富国家严重缺电悖论的结构性赤字来源——即补贴不仅存在，而且具体在哪一成本层级上出现断裂。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合直接成本、隐性补贴、代际稀缺和系统性外部性的四层定价理论框架，将电价扭曲的分析从"是否存在补贴"推进到"补贴在哪一层级断裂"的结构性诊断层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可扩展的诊断工具和政策蓝图，通过动态社会经济校准机制平衡成本反映性与消费者可负担性，为资源丰富或转型经济体提供从能源补贴陷阱走向可持续电网管理的分阶段、有数学依据的路径。

title: Heat-related cost-benefit analysis of the outdoor environment in current and future climate conditions - A case study in Germany
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN, , affiliation not provided to SSRN and Technische Universität München (TUM)

detail.title: Heat-related cost-benefit analysis of the outdoor environment in current and future climate conditions - A case study in Germany
detail.abstract: Climate change and increasing urban densification intensify the urban heat island effect, exacerbating thermal stress and associated human health risks. Urban trees mitigate local heat stress through shading and evapotranspiration, thereby supporting well-being in the built environment. However, while the environmental impacts of buildings are monetized, the economic valuation of outdoor thermal comfort remains limited. Within a planning competition context, a heat-related cost–benefit analysis of the outdoor environment under current and future predicted climate conditions was developed, focusing on realistic planning scenarios. Outdoor thermal comfort was quantified using ENVI-met simulations, and heat-related cost savings were estimated based on the proportion of the study area exposed to extreme heat stress. The results indicate that preserving existing trees, including implementing tree protection measures, yields a more favorable cost-benefit analysis (CBA) ratio than removal and replacement over the life cycle. While additional tree planting further improves thermal comfort and reduces heat-related costs, higher life-cycle costs result in only moderate CBA performance. Our study highlights the importance of prioritizing urban tree preservation as a key strategy for climate adaptation and public health protection in early planning decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究在城市规划竞赛背景下，对当前和未来气候条件下的室外环境进行热相关成本效益分析，发现保护现有树木比砍伐更换具有更优的成本效益比，而额外植树虽改善热舒适但成本效益表现中等，强调了在城市规划早期优先保护树木的重要性。
AI.research_question: 在城市规划决策中，保护现有树木、砍伐更换树木和额外植树三种策略在缓解热应激方面的成本效益如何？
AI.motivation: 气候变化和城市致密化加剧了城市热岛效应和热应激健康风险，但室外热舒适的经济价值评估有限，缺乏将热舒适纳入规划决策的成本效益分析工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市树木通过遮阳和蒸腾作用缓解热应激的生态机制；成本效益分析（CBA）框架；室外热舒适量化（ENVI-met模拟）。
AI.method: 基于规划竞赛中的现实情景，使用ENVI-met模拟量化室外热舒适度，根据研究区域暴露于极端热应激的比例估算热相关成本节约，进行全生命周期的成本效益分析。
AI.findings: 保护现有树木（包括采取树木保护措施）在全生命周期内比砍伐更换具有更优的成本效益比；额外植树进一步改善热舒适和降低热相关成本，但较高的生命周期成本导致成本效益表现仅为中等。
AI.theory_contributions: 将室外热舒适的经济价值纳入城市规划的成本效益分析框架，填补了该领域的研究空白；提供了将微气候模拟与健康经济学结合的方法论范例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者提供了基于实证的决策依据，强调在早期规划中优先保护现有树木作为气候适应和公共卫生保护的关键策略；开发了可在规划竞赛等实际场景中应用的热相关成本效益分析工具。

title:
The Programmable Firm: 
From Coordination to Coherent Evolution

detail.title:
The Programmable Firm: 
From Coordination to Coherent Evolution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this conceptual study. The article does not involve human participants, personal data, or experimental procedures
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: As coordination costs decline, specialization deepens and the speed of change accelerates. This shifts the economic role of the firm from coordinating activities to preserving coherence across evolving systems of specialization. Building on transaction cost economics, dynamic capabilities theory, and modularity research, this article proposes the programmable firm as a cumulative extension of the theory of the firm. It argues that as coordination becomes less constraining, coherence becomes the primary economic challenge. Structural optionality enables firms to evolve without repeated structural redesign, increasing the adaptive potential of both organizations and committed capital. AI acts as an amplifier of this transition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"可编程企业"概念，认为随着协调成本下降、专业化加深和变革加速，企业的经济角色正从协调活动转向在不断演化的专业化系统中维持一致性。AI是这一转变的放大器。
AI.research_question: 在协调成本下降、变革加速的时代，企业的经济角色如何演变？如何从理论层面重新定义企业？
AI.motivation: 传统企业理论（如交易成本经济学）将企业视为协调机制，但协调成本下降和变革加速使得"一致性"（coherence）成为更关键的经济挑战，需要重新审视企业本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 交易成本经济学（TCE）、动态能力理论、模块化研究
AI.method: 理论综合与概念推演
AI.findings: 提出了"可编程企业"（programmable firm）概念，作为企业理论的累积性延伸；指出结构可选性（structural optionality）使企业无需反复进行结构再设计即可演化，提升组织与承诺资本的适应潜力；AI加速了这一转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 延伸了企业理论，将"一致性"而非"协调"确立为企业的核心经济挑战；整合了TCE、动态能力与模块化研究；引入"结构可选性"概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计适应快速变革的组织结构提供了新思路；强调了AI作为转型催化剂的作用。

title: China's Overseas Production-Supply Bases: Network Structure and Implications
affiliations: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy

detail.title: China's Overseas Production-Supply Bases: Network Structure and Implications

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIEP Research Paper, World Economy Brief(WEB) 26-08
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Global supply chains are undergoing structural change as the prolonged U.S.–China strategic rivalry, the normalization of geopolitical risks, and post pandemic disruptions shift the organizing principle from efficiency to stability, resilience, security, and trust. Major economies such as the United States, EU, and Japan have responded by strengthening policies for supply chain diversification, friend shoring, and strategic management of critical minerals and advanced industries. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 全球供应链正在从效率导向转向稳定、韧性、安全和信任导向，主要经济体（美、欧、日）通过供应链多元化、友岸外包和战略产业管理来应对中美战略竞争和地缘政治风险。
AI.research_question: 全球供应链的结构性变化及其驱动因素是什么？主要经济体如何通过政策应对这些变化？
AI.motivation: 中美战略竞争长期化、地缘政治风险常态化以及疫情后供应链中断，促使供应链的组织原则从效率转向稳定、韧性、安全和信任，需要系统性理解这一转型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链治理理论、地缘政治经济学、国际政治经济学中的安全化与去风险化理论。
AI.method: 基于对美、欧、日等主要经济体政策动向的定性比较分析和案例研究。
AI.findings: 全球供应链正经历从效率优先到韧性、安全优先的范式转变；主要经济体纷纷推行供应链多元化、友岸外包及关键矿产和先进产业的战略管理政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 将地缘政治风险和安全逻辑纳入供应链治理分析框架，拓展了传统供应链研究中以效率为核心的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府和企业制定供应链韧性、多元化及战略安全策略提供政策分析和决策参考。

title: On Walter's Model and Cashflow-based Payout Ratio
affiliations: Case Western Reserve University - Department of Banking & Finance and Case Western Reserve University

detail.title: On Walter's Model and Cashflow-based Payout Ratio
detail.abstract: We examine whether Walter's (1956) Model holds in that firms with greater growth opportunities would pay out less, using operating cashflow-based payout measures that include only dividends, only repurchases or both. Two groups of explanatory variables are considered. The first group consists of firm characteristics (including contemporaneous and lagged P/E ratios to control for dividend growth model prediction), and the second group comprises macroeconomic indicators reflecting economic conditions. Across OLS, Random Forest, Lasso and Ridge methodologies, as well as in univariate tests, the cashflow based payout ratios consistently and significantly show contemporaneous association with growth opportunities, supporting Walter's Model.

AI.tldr: 本文检验Walter（1956）模型，发现基于经营现金流的分红比率（含股息、回购或两者）与增长机会呈显著负相关，支持了增长机会越多、支付越少的理论。
AI.research_question: Walter（1956）模型是否成立，即增长机会越多的企业是否支付更少？
AI.motivation: 检验经典股利理论（Walter模型）在更全面、基于经营现金流的支付衡量指标下是否仍然成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: Walter（1956）股利政策模型、股利增长模型。
AI.method: 使用基于经营现金流的支付比率（仅股息、仅回购、两者合计），包含两组解释变量（公司特征含当期和滞后P/E比率、宏观经济指标），采用OLS、随机森林、Lasso和Ridge回归以及单变量检验。
AI.findings: 基于现金流的支付比率与增长机会呈显著的同期关联，支持Walter模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 为Walter（1956）模型提供了基于现金流的新证据，验证了增长机会与支付政策的负向关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者制定股利和回购政策提供参考，强调了增长机会在支付决策中的核心作用。

title: Intelligent Enterprise Systems: Integrating Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, and Information Management for Strategic Decision Making
affiliations: University of Lagos

detail.title: Intelligent Enterprise Systems: Integrating Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, and Information Management for Strategic Decision Making
detail.abstract: Enterprises in regulated industries increasingly rely on AI-assisted decision making, yet deploying large language models (LLMs) at scale introduces persistent tensions between inferential performance, data privacy, and regulatory compliance. This paper proposes the Hybrid Edge-Aware LLM (HEAL) framework, an architecture that combines edge-side anonymisation, federated learning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and cloud-based foundation model inference to address these tensions simultaneously. The design routes sensitive data through a local privacy filter before any remote inference occurs, reducing re-identification risk while preserving the contextual richness needed for high-quality outputs. A compliance gating module enforces jurisdiction-specific rules at query time, and an explainable AI layer annotates every decision with traceable evidence. Analytical evaluation against four baseline configurations shows that HEAL achieves an inference accuracy of 91.6%, a mean edge-to-response latency of 148 ms, and a full compliance rating, outperforming each baseline on at least three of the five metrics examined. The results suggest that a carefully orchestrated hybrid pipeline can resolve the performanceprivacy trade-off that has historically constrained enterprise AI adoption.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合边缘感知LLM（HEAL）框架，通过边缘匿名化、联邦学习、RAG和云推理的组合架构，同时解决AI辅助决策中的推理性能、数据隐私和监管合规之间的张力。实验表明该框架在准确率、延迟和合规性上均优于基线方案。
AI.research_question: 如何在受监管行业中大规模部署LLM时，同时实现高推理性能、数据隐私保护和监管合规？
AI.motivation: 受监管企业在部署AI辅助决策时面临推理性能、数据隐私与法规合规之间的持续张力，现有方案难以同时兼顾三者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合边缘-云架构理论；隐私-性能权衡理论；合规性门控机制；可解释AI（XAI）理论
AI.method: 提出HEAL框架，包含边缘端隐私过滤器、联邦学习、检索增强生成（RAG）、云端基础模型推理、合规门控模块和可解释AI层；通过分析评估与四种基线配置对比性能。
AI.findings: HEAL实现91.6%推理准确率、148ms平均边缘到响应延迟和完全合规评级，在五个评估指标中至少三项优于所有基线配置。
AI.theory_contributions: 实证表明精心编排的混合管道可以解决历史上制约企业AI采用的性能-隐私权衡问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管行业提供了一套可行的AI部署架构，兼顾性能、隐私和合规要求。

title: The Asymptote of the Neutral: From Barthes's Degree Zero to the Deconstruction of the Proper -A Poststructuralist Genealogy of Writing beyond Bourgeois Normativity
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: The Asymptote of the Neutral: From Barthes's Degree Zero to the Deconstruction of the Proper -A Poststructuralist Genealogy of Writing beyond Bourgeois Normativity
detail.abstract:
Introduction: The Triple Aporia of the Neutral

Roland Barthes’s intellectual trajectory, often fragmented by periodisation into an early Marxist-semiological phase, a middle structuralist moment, and a late hedonistic-poststructuralist turn, conceals a deeper, more subterranean continuity: the relentless pursuit of a writing that would escape the threefold appropriation of meaning by bourgeois normativity. This normativity operates through three interlocking mechanisms—naturalisation (the transformation of the historical into the eternal), universalisation (the presentation of class-specific interests as human universals), and proprietarisation (the reduction of textual polysemy to the authorial proper name). Barthes’s response, first articulated in Writing Degree Zero (1953), is the concept of écriture blanche, a “white writing” or “degree zero” that would strip language of its mythological surplus and return it to a state of neutral, pre-signifying transparency. The exemplary literary realisation of this ideal, for the early Barthes, is Albert Camus’s The Stranger (1942), whose paratactic prose, systematic use of the passé composé, and refusal of metaphor appear to constitute a language delivered from the servitude of predestined meaning. Yet Barthes immediately recognised the constitutive aporia of this project: the zero degree, as soon as it is named and recognised, becomes a new positivity, a recognisable style, a commodity recuperated by the very literary institution it sought to negate. “This transparent language, initiated by Camus’s The Stranger,” Barthes writes, “achieves a style of absence which is almost an ideal absence of style; but this absence is immediately caught up in the mechanism of Literature” (Barthes 1968, 77). This failure, however, did not lead Barthes to abandon the zero-degree project; rather, it drove him to relocate its battlefield from the literary text to the writing subject itself. Roland Barthes by Roland Barthes (1975) enacts an autobiographical experiment in which the author’s proper name, the last redoubt of bourgeois proprietarisation, is subjected to the same semiological ascesis previously applied to the classical sentence. The present essay argues that this trajectory—from Camus’s white writing to Barthes’s fragmented autobiography—constitutes a sustained, if paradoxical, struggle against what can be termed the “metaphysics of the proper”: the bourgeois conviction that meaning, property, and selfhood are stable, transparent, and naturally owned. Through a dense dialogue with Jacques Derrida’s critique of presence, Gilles Deleuze’s theory of minor literature and the body without organs, Slavoj Žižek’s Lacanian reading of ideology, Michel Foucault’s analysis of the author-function, Jean-François Lyotard’s concept of the differend, Julia Kristeva’s semiotic chora, and Jean Baudrillard’s orders of simulacra, this essay will demonstrate that the zero degree is not a style to be achieved but an ethical asymptote—a perpetual practice of de-propriation that keeps writing at the limit of the sayable, exposing the ideological closure of every naturalised sign.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯罗兰·巴特从《写作的零度》到《罗兰·巴特自述》的思想轨迹，论证其“零度写作”并非一种可实现的风格，而是在与德里达、德勒兹、齐泽克、福柯、利奥塔、克里斯蒂娃、鲍德里亚等思想家的对话中展开的一场持续对抗“所有权的形而上学”的伦理实践，即对僵化意义进行永恒的去占有化运动。
AI.research_question: 巴特的"零度写作"从加缪《局外人》起步，经过自传实验的演变，如何构成一条对抗资产阶级规范性的深层连续性？这种追求如何在与后结构主义思想的对话中被重新理解？
AI.motivation: 巴特的学术轨迹常被阶段化割裂（马克思主义-结构主义-后结构主义），掩盖了其贯穿始终的对抗资产阶级意义占有机制的深层统一性。论文旨在揭示这一被忽视的连续性，并阐明"零度"作为伦理渐近线的理论意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 巴特的零度写作与中性概念；德里达对在场的批判；德勒兹的少数文学与无器官身体；齐泽克的拉康式意识形态批判；福柯的作者功能；利奥塔的异识；克里斯蒂娃的符号态；鲍德里亚的拟像秩序。
AI.method: 理论文本的细读与比较哲学分析，通过巴特与多位后结构主义思想家的概念对话来阐释"零度写作"的深层结构与伦理意涵。
AI.findings: 巴特的零度写作并非一种可实现的风格，而是一种伦理渐近线——一种永不停歇的去占有化实践。从加缪的白色写作到巴特的自传碎片化，这条轨迹构成了对抗"所有权的形而上学"的持续斗争，揭示了每一种自然化符号背后的意识形态封闭性。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新整合了巴特被阶段化分割的思想轨迹，揭示其深层连续性；将零度写作从文学风格问题提升为对抗资产阶级意义占有机制的伦理-政治实践；通过多重视角的理论对话，丰富了我们对"中性"概念在当代批判理论中的位置的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为批判当代文化中意义的自然化、普遍化和商品化提供了理论工具；启示写作者如何在实践中保持对语言和意义的批判性距离；对文学批评和文化研究中如何识别和抵抗意识形态封闭具有方法论意义。

detail.abstract:
Here's the abstract text for easy copying:

This report presents credible, market-supported estimates of annual farmland values and cash rental rates across twelve defined agricultural regions in the northeastern United States, based on verified sales data collected for calendar year 2025. Prepared by the Northeast Chapter of the American Society of Farm Managers and Rural Appraisers (ASFMRA) in collaboration with Cornell University's Dyson School of Applied Economics and Management and Cornell Cooperative Extension, the study covers six regions in New York State (Western New York, Southern Tier, Central New York, Adirondacks, Capital Region, and Hudson Valley), four regions in Vermont (Northwest, Northeast, Southern, and Connecticut River Valley), Southern New England (Massachusetts, Rhode Island, and Connecticut), and Northwestern Pennsylvania.

For each region, the report documents per-acre value ranges across farmland classes—high-quality cropland, medium-quality cropland, low-quality cropland or pasture, woodland and maple sugarbush, and wasteland or recreational land—along with cash rental rate ranges, activity trends, and qualitative market narratives. Across the twelve regions, land value trends in 2025 were largely stable to modestly increasing compared with 2024, with several regions exhibiting limited transaction volumes that reflect the characteristically low turnover of the Northeast farmland market. Key demand drivers identified include ongoing farm consolidation and operational expansion, competing demand from recreational and lifestyle-oriented buyers, the lasting influence of COVID-19-era rural migration trends, geopolitical uncertainty and input cost pressures, growing agritourism and value-added agricultural sectors, a thriving maple industry in Vermont and the Adirondacks, and the influence of proximity to major metropolitan areas—particularly in the Hudson Valley and Southern New England regions.

The report also highlights region-specific dynamics, including the specialized cranberry market in Massachusetts, declining vineyard values in Erie County, Pennsylvania following processor consolidation, the role of conservation easements in shaping buyer pools, and expanding recreational land demand in the Adirondacks and Northeast Vermont. This publication represents the most geographically comprehensive edition to date and expands prior coverage to include Southern New England and Northwestern Pennsylvania for the first time. Future editions are intended to continue expanding coverage across the broader Northeast.

AI.tldr: 该报告基于2025年已验证的销售数据，估算了美国东北部十二个农业区域的农田价值和现金租金率，涵盖纽约州、佛蒙特州、新英格兰南部和宾夕法尼亚州西北部。整体土地价值趋势稳定至小幅上升，需求驱动因素包括农场整合、休闲买家需求、疫情后人口迁移、地缘政治不确定性及都市近郊效应等。
AI.research_question: 美国东北部十二个农业区域2025年的农田价值与现金租金率是多少？影响这些价值的关键驱动因素是什么？
AI.motivation: 为美国东北部农田市场和农村资产评估提供迄今为止最全面的地理覆盖数据，填补新英格兰南部和宾夕法尼亚州西北部等地区的数据空白，支持农业政策制定和土地管理决策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 农业经济学中的土地价值评估理论、供需均衡理论（包括农场整合、休闲需求、都市近郊效应等需求侧因素），以及区域经济学中的空间异质性分析框架。
AI.method: 基于2025日历年份收集的已验证销售数据，采用市场支持的土地价值估算方法，按农田质量等级（高、中、低质量农田/牧场、林地、荒地等）分类报告每英亩价值区间和现金租金率区间，并结合定性市场叙事分析。由美国农场经理与农村评估师协会东北分会与康奈尔大学等机构合作完成。
AI.findings: 1) 2025年土地价值趋势总体稳定至小幅上升；2) 多个地区交易量有限，反映东北 farmland 市场的低周转特征；3) 主要需求驱动因素包括农场合并、休闲买家竞争、疫情后乡村迁移、地缘政治不确定性、投入成本压力、农业旅游增长、枫糖产业繁荣及都市近郊效应；4) 存在区域特定动态，如马萨诸塞州蔓越莓市场、宾州伊利县葡萄园价值下降、保护性地役权的影响、阿迪朗达克地区休闲用地需求扩张等。
AI.theory_contributions: 为东北农业区域的土地价值评估提供了经验证据，拓展了区域农业经济学中关于多因素（都市化、休闲需求、政策干预等）影响土地价值的理论理解，验证了空间异质性在 farmland 价值形成中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为农户、农场管理者、农村评估师、政策制定者和投资者提供了2025年东北部12个农业区域的 farmland 价值和租金率基准数据；首次将新英格兰南部和宾夕法尼亚州西北部纳入覆盖范围，填补了数据空白；为未来的土地交易、农业投资和政策评估提供了可靠的市场参考。

title: Stablecoins, Digital Dollarization, and Financial Self-determination in Kenya
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Stablecoins, Digital Dollarization, and Financial Self-determination in Kenya
detail.abstract: Kenya has quietly become East Africa's largest stablecoin market, with USD-pegged tokens, overwhelmingly USDT and USDC, now carrying billions of dollars in remittances, crossborder trade settlement, and savings that the country's mobile-money rails handle poorly. This paper argues that the architecture Kenyans have defaulted to is neither neutral nor costless: it imposes a dual-layered sovereignty deficit. At the macro scale, the substitution of foreign digital dollars for the shilling ("digital dollarization") erodes the Central Bank of Kenya's monetary transmission, fractures the country's position under the Impossible Trinity, and channels seigniorage to the United States Treasury through the Treasury-bill reserves backing these tokens. At the micro scale, the same instruments expose individual users to extraterritorial surveillance and unilateral, contract-level asset freezes against which they hold no jurisdictional recourse. The paper's central claim is that these are two distinct problems demanding two distinct architectural responses, and that solving either alone leaves the system compromised. Reclaiming monetary sovereignty requires scaling local-currency stablecoins (such as cKES on the Mento protocol) and anchoring continental settlement on-chain via PAPSS; reclaiming individual sovereignty requires zero-knowledge cryptography, ZK-KYC, and decentralized issuance models that remove corporate freezeswitches. True financial self-determination, the paper contends, demands their integration, a local-currency stablecoin issued natively on a privacy-preserving, decentralized ledger. Using Kenya's Virtual Asset Service Providers Act 2025 as the regulatory anchor, the paper maps the institutional roles, legislative amendments, and user-incentive problems such a stack would confront, and argues that stablecoins should be understood not as consumer products but as instruments of digital statecraft. Though framed around Kenya, the dualsovereignty trilemma it identifies generalizes across emerging Sub-Saharan markets.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示肯尼亚稳定币市场（以USDT/USDC为主）带来的双重主权赤字问题：宏观上数字美元化侵蚀货币主权，微观上用户面临域外监控与资产冻结风险，并提出整合本地货币稳定币、零知识密码学与去中心化发行的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 在肯尼亚成为东非最大稳定币市场的背景下，USD锚定稳定币（USDT/USDC）对国家货币主权与个人金融主权造成了怎样的双重侵蚀？如何从架构层面同时解决这两个问题？
AI.motivation: 肯尼亚移动货币（M-Pesa等）在处理跨境汇款、贸易结算和大额储蓄方面存在不足，导致用户大量转向美元稳定币。然而这种"默认架构"并非中性——它在宏观上通过"数字美元化"削弱央行货币政策传导、破坏"不可能三角"并转移铸币税至美国；在微观上使用户暴露于域外监管和单方面资产冻结风险中，且用户无法寻求司法救济。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币主权理论、不可能三角（Impossible Trinity）、数字美元化、铸币税理论、零知识密码学、去中心化治理、金融国家主义（Digital Statecraft）。
AI.method: 理论分析与制度设计：基于肯尼亚2025年《虚拟资产服务提供商法案》为监管锚点，结合肯尼亚稳定币市场现状，提出双重主权赤字的分析框架，并设计整合性的架构解决方案。
AI.findings: （1）肯尼亚存在宏观与微观两个层面的主权赤字，需要两种不同的架构回应；（2）宏观层面需推广本地货币稳定币（如Mento协议上的cKES）并通过PAPSS（泛非支付结算系统）实现链上大陆结算；（3）微观层面需采用零知识证明、ZK-KYC和去中心化发行模型以消除企业级"冻结开关"；（4）真正的金融自决需要将本地货币稳定币原生发行在隐私保护且去中心化的账本上；（5）稳定币应被理解为"数字国家主义工具"而非消费品。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"双重主权赤字"（dual-layered sovereignty deficit）概念，区分宏观货币主权与微观个体主权两个分析维度；揭示"稳定币的非中性架构"假设，挑战稳定币是中性的市场选择这一流行认知；将稳定币问题上升至"数字国家主义"层面进行理论化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚及其他撒哈拉以南新兴市场提供具体政策建议：推广本地货币稳定币（cKES）、接入PAPSS、采用ZK-KYC与去中心化发行机制；以肯尼亚VASP法案2025为监管锚点，为立法机构提供制度角色与立法修正的具体路径；识别用户激励问题，为监管落地提供实操考量。

detail.abstract: In this Policy Brief, Wolff argues that the European Union must step up to lead the world trading system at a moment of historic disruption. With the United States retreating into a power-based approach to trade and China relying heavily on state intervention, Wolff contends that the European Union—the world's largest trader—has both the capacity and the responsibility to fill the void. Drawing on the spirit of postwar institution-building at Bretton Woods, he sets out a strategic roadmap for EU trade policy to 2050: defending the World Trade Organization's rules-based framework; pursuing closer alignment with members of the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP); expanding trade rules to cover climate, artificial intelligence, and food security; and resisting trade coercion through collective action.

AI.tldr: 本文主张在美中贸易摩擦背景下，欧盟应抓住历史机遇，主导全球贸易体系改革，并提出至2050年的战略路线图。
AI.research_question: 在国际贸易体系面临美国权力导向型贸易政策和中国家干预型贸易模式的双重冲击下，欧盟应如何定位自身角色并制定长期贸易战略？

AI.theoretical_framework: 基于布雷顿森林体系战后制度建设的传统，强调规则导向的多边主义与制度性领导力理论。
AI.method: 政策分析/政策简报形式，基于对当前国际贸易格局的定性分析，提出战略性政策建议。

AI.theory_contributions: 将制度主义领导力理论应用于当代国际贸易体系分析，拓展了关于"规则导向型"与"权力导向型"贸易治理模式比较的理论讨论。
