detail.abstract:
Electrical safety in industrial environments is a critical concern due to the high energy levels and complex machinery present in such facilities. Incidents stemming from poor wiring practices, inadequate enclosures, lack of emergency systems, and improper maintenance can result in fires, injuries, or fatalities. This paper evaluates common safety lapses in industrial electrical systems, draws insights from real-world observations, and proposes mitigation strategies in line with international safety standards. A systematic inspection-based approach is discussed, alongside the use of thermographic surveys, proper cable management, and rated equipment, to minimize risks and ensure compliance. 
Finally, actionable engineering and managerial remediation strategies are mapped directly to prevailing international safety frameworks, including NFPA/NEC, BS7671/IEC. The resulting register provides plant engineers, safety auditors, and facility managers with a direct, field-tested blueprint to systematically mitigate workplace hazards, prevent catastrophic downtime, and achieve verified regulatory

AI.tldr: 本文评估工业电气系统的常见安全隐患，结合实际观察提出缓解策略，并建立与国际安全标准（NFPA/NEC、BS7671/IEC）相对应的工程与管理对策清单，为工厂工程师和安全审计员提供可操作的现场蓝图。
AI.research_question: 工业电气系统中常见的安全疏漏有哪些？如何通过系统化检测和管理策略来缓解这些风险，并确保符合国际安全标准？
AI.motivation: 工业环境中高能量和复杂机械带来的电气事故（火灾、伤害、死亡）频发，现有安全实践存在漏洞，亟需基于实际观察的系统性缓解方案并与国际标准对接。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际电气安全标准框架（NFPA/NEC、BS7671/IEC），结合系统化检测方法（热成像调查、电缆管理等）和风险管理理论。
AI.method: 系统性检测评估方法，包括实际现场观察、热成像调查、电缆管理和设备额定检查，并映射到国际安全标准。
AI.findings: 识别出工业电气系统的主要安全疏漏（如接线不良、外壳不当、缺乏应急系统、维护不当）；提出了一套与国际标准对应的工程与管理补救策略清单。
AI.theory_contributions: 将具体的现场缓解策略直接映射到NFPA/NEC和BS7671/IEC等国际安全框架，建立了理论与实践之间的可操作桥梁。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工厂工程师、安全审计员和设施管理者提供了经过现场验证的系统化蓝图，用于减少工作场所危害、防止灾难性停机并实现合规性验证。

title:
The ALCM

Atomic Language Control Model — How Single Words Function as Mechanical Control Dials in AI Reasoning

detail.title:
The ALCM

Atomic Language Control Model — How Single Words Function as Mechanical Control Dials in AI Reasoning
detail.abstract: This paper introduces and formally defines the Atomic Language Control Model (ALCM): a framework mapping individual natural-language words to specific, enumerated output dimensions in AI reasoning-not as style or tone, but as mechanical axis positions. The paper documents eight primary axes and a ninth spatial axis, traces the framework's origin in field observation across six AI platforms, grounds it in existing research on modal verb effects, pragmatic framing, and linguistic prompt sensitivity, names multi-axis collision as the primary mechanism behind short prompt power, and argues that word-level axis awareness is one of the most foundational skills in practical prompt governance. The paper builds on Paper No. 1 (The Token Zero Doctrine) and draws on the GallantryAI Living Lexicon for its Three Voices treatment of key concepts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并正式定义了原子语言控制模型（ALCM），将自然语言中的每个单词映射到AI推理中特定的、可枚举的输出维度，并论证了词级轴感知是提示词治理中最基础的技能之一。
AI.research_question: 如何将自然语言词汇系统性地映射到AI推理中可枚举的输出控制维度？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对语言提示的敏感性已有认识，但缺乏一个正式、结构化的框架来将单个词汇解释为对AI输出维度的机械式控制，而非仅仅是风格或语气上的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 原子语言控制模型（ALCM）；八条主轴线加一条空间轴线；多轴碰撞机制；基于情态动词效应、语用框架和语言提示敏感性的已有研究。
AI.method: 跨六个AI平台进行实地观察，结合对已有文献（情态动词效应、语用框架、语言提示敏感性）的梳理，并在第1号论文（Token Zero Doctrine）和GallantryAI Living Lexicon的基础上构建。
AI.findings: 识别并记录了八条主轴线（及一条空间轴线）；将"短提示的强大效果"归因于多轴碰撞机制；指出词级轴感知是提示词治理中最基础的技能之一。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次正式定义并命名了原子语言控制模型（ALCM），为词汇级别的AI输出控制提供了系统性的理论框架；提出了"多轴碰撞"作为短提示效应的核心机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为提示词工程和AI治理提供了可操作的词级控制维度框架，帮助实践者更精确地理解和使用词汇来调控AI输出。

title: Beyond UCSV? Macro-Financial Signals in the U.S. Inflation Forecast Frontier

detail.title: Beyond UCSV? Macro-Financial Signals in the U.S. Inflation Forecast Frontier
detail.abstract: We ask whether macro-financial signals carry forecast information beyond the Stock-Watson (2007) UCSV benchmark for U.S. inflation, and we report a calibrated answer. On a strictly anti-lookahead causal panel of CPI, core CPI, PCE and core PCE at horizons of 3 to 24 months, with HAC-based Clark-West and Diebold-Mariano-Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold inference, signal-based specifications deliver large point gains over UCSV and remain significant under raw and Benjamini-Hochberg control. Under the more conservative Romano-Wolf stepdown, on the broad family or on a transparent primary-model family, no individual signal specification beats UCSV in a family-wise sense, a property the signal literature largely shares. The Hansen, Lunde and Nason (2011) Model Confidence Set then sharpens the question. In the 25 country-target-horizon cells where the MCS is computable, UCSV is excluded from the 90% MCS in 19 cells while signal-based models remain inside in 20. The result concentrates in ten informative U.S. cells, core CPI at horizons 6, 12, 18 and 24; headline CPI at horizons 12, 18 and 24; and headline PCE at horizons 12, 18 and 24, where the MCS is tight (at most six surviving models), a signal specification is inside the 90% set, and UCSV is outside with MCS p-values between 0.006 and 0.064. The supportable headline is therefore narrower than "predictors beat the benchmark" and stronger than "predictors and benchmark are equivalent": in informative U.S. cells, macro-financial signal content lies within the frontier of best forecasts and discriminates against the field's standard benchmark, even when no single specification wins individually under the strictest family-wise control. The result survives under real-time vintage data from ALFRED for the six implemented U.S. series: nine of the ten core cells are preserved, with the failure occurring only at the shortest-horizon core CPI cell where data revisions are most consequential. Brazilian results, reported as complementary evidence, are directionally consistent for the IGP-M and the IPCA aggregates but rest on wider MCS sets and are less informative on power grounds.

AI.tldr: 本文系统检验了宏观金融信号是否包含超越Stock-Watson UCSV基准的美国通胀预测信息。在严格避免前瞻性偏差的面板数据和多种统计推断方法下，信号模型整体表现优于UCSV，但在最严格的族系控制下没有单一模型显著胜出。然而，通过模型置信集分析，在信息含量丰富的美国子样本中，UCSV被排除在90%置信集之外，而信号模型保留在内，表明宏观金融信号确实位于最优预测前沿内。
AI.research_question: 宏观金融信号是否包含超越Stock-Watson (2007) UCSV基准模型的美通胀预测信息？
AI.motivation: 通胀预测是宏观经济政策制定的核心，但现有文献对"预测变量是否优于简单基准"这一问题存在争议。作者希望给出一个严谨、校准过的答案，厘清信号模型与UCSV基准之间的真实关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: Stock-Watson (2007) UCSV模型（不可观测成分与随机波动率）、Clark-West（CW）检验、Diebold-Mariano-Harvey-Leybourne-Newbold（DMHLN）检验、Benjamini-Hochberg多重假设检验控制、Romano-Wolf逐步检验、Hansen-Lunde-Nason (2011) 模型置信集（MCS）
AI.method: 使用严格避免前瞻性偏差的因果面板数据（CPI、核心CPI、PCE、核心PCE），在3至24个月预测期上，采用HAC稳健的CW和DMHLN检验，以及Benjamini-Hochberg和Romano-Wolf多重检验控制，并结合模型置信集（MCS）方法进行综合分析。还使用了ALFRED实时数据版本进行稳健性检验，并以巴西数据作为补充证据。
AI.findings: 信号模型在点估计上优于UCSV且多数显著；但在最严格的Romano-Wolf族系控制下，没有单一信号模型在族系意义上显著胜出。通过MCS分析，在10个信息丰富的美国子样本中（如核心CPI在6、12、18、24月期等），UCSV被排除在90%置信集外（MCS p值在0.006-0.064），而信号模型保留在内。实时数据检验保留了9/10的结论。巴西结果方向一致但信息量较弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个比"预测变量优于基准"更窄、比"两者等价"更强的可支撑结论：在信息丰富的子样本中，宏观金融信号位于最优预测前沿内，且能区分于标准的UCSV基准。这调和了文献中看似矛盾的发现，展示了不同统计推断方法的选择如何影响结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和预测从业者提供了明确的指导：宏观金融信号在特定通胀指标和预测期上确实能提供超越简单基准的预测价值，尤其是在核心CPI和CPI的较长预测期（12-24个月）以及PCE的较长预测期上。同时警示了单一模型比较和多重假设检验陷阱。

title: How Will Political Risk Affect Different Firms’ Tax Avoidance Strategies? Taking Chinese Companies During the First Sino-U.S. Trade War as an Example
affiliations: and Kyushu University

detail.title: How Will Political Risk Affect Different Firms’ Tax Avoidance Strategies? Taking Chinese Companies During the First Sino-U.S. Trade War as an Example
detail.abstract:
In the operations of enterprises, firm-level political risks influence their tax avoidance
strategies. This paper examines how political risk from the first Sino-U.S. trade war shaped
listed companies' tax behavior and its mechanism, using panel data on U.S.-listed Chinese
firms from 2014 to 2023. The current empirical results show that heightened political risk
prompts listed companies to adopt more aggressive tax avoidance strategies. The mediating
effect test based on the three-step method indicates that political uncertainty can influence the
aggressive tax avoidance strategies of enterprises through financial pressure and R&D
expenditure. Heterogeneity tests show that tax avoidance behaviors of listed companies vary
by different ownership and the exposure to tariff policies.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了中美贸易战带来的政治风险如何影响在美上市中概股的避税行为，发现政治风险上升会促使企业采取更激进的避税策略，其机制包括财务压力和研发支出，且不同所有制和关税政策暴露程度的企业表现存在差异。
AI.research_question: 第一次中美贸易战中的政治风险如何影响在美上市中国企业的避税策略？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 企业层面的政治风险如何影响其税收规避策略，现有研究关注不足；中美贸易战为检验这一关系提供了 quasi-natural experiment。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政治风险理论、税收规避动机理论（财务压力与研发支出作为中介机制）
AI.method: 使用2014-2023年在美上市中概股的面板数据，采用中介效应三步法检验财务压力与研发支出的中介作用，并进行所有制和关税政策暴露度的异质性分析。
AI.findings: （1）政治风险上升显著促使企业采取更激进的避税策略；（2）财务压力和研发支出是重要的中介机制；（3）不同所有制性质和关税政策暴露程度的企业避税行为存在显著差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 将政治风险引入企业避税行为的研究框架，揭示了政治不确定性通过财务压力和创新投入影响避税策略的理论路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构理解政治风险环境下企业的税收行为提供依据；提醒投资者关注政治不确定性对企业税务策略的影响。

title: The κ-Standard: Debt-Free Money Creation under a Riba-Free Convergence Intensity (Uniting the Chicago Plan and Islamic Full-Reserve Monetary Theory)
affiliations: and  Alabama A&M University

detail.title: The κ-Standard: Debt-Free Money Creation under a Riba-Free Convergence Intensity (Uniting the Chicago Plan and Islamic Full-Reserve Monetary Theory)
detail.abstract:
Two traditions of monetary reform, the Islamic interest-free programme of Al-Jarhi (1981) and Chapra (1985), and the Western full-reserve tradition of Fisher (1936) and Benes & Kumhof (2012), independently reached the same design: money should be created debt-free by the state and separated from interest-bearing bank credit. Both stalled at the same point. Once money creation is divorced from interest-bearing debt, the assets that back the money base must still be priced, and the natural pricing object, the risk-free interest rate r, is precisely the riba the reform sets out to remove. Neither tradition supplied a riba-free price at which the market could clear. This paper provides one.

Building on the convergence intensity κ of Ackerer et al. (2025), shown by the companion papers to be a riba-free, no-arbitrage pricing primitive estimable from real sukuk markets, we construct the κ-Standard: a monetary architecture in which (i) base money equals the κ-priced value of a portfolio of sovereign perpetual sukuk, so that money is sovereign equity rather than debt; (ii) new money is created only by monetising new real-sector projects at their κ-implied price, tethering money growth to real output; (iii) open-market operations transmit through the system-wide convergence intensity κ̄ rather than an interest rate, with the central bank setting the quantity of money while the market sets the price of capital; and (iv) commercial banks operate under one hundred per cent reserves, splitting into fee-based (ujrah) custody and profit-sharing (mudarabah) investment.

We derive the law of motion of the money supply and show that a shock to κ̄ (a system-wide credit deterioration) contracts the base automatically. We then derive a countercyclical issuance rule that neutralises this revaluation channel and holds the base on a target growth path. The correction is bounded by available real capacity and a Sovereign Stabilisation Fund, a deliberate trade of unbounded-but-unbacked fiat stabilisation for bounded-but-backed stabilisation (roughly $3.6 bn per 100 bp for the full real sukuk universe).

We are explicit about what the architecture does not achieve: it removes debt-financed and unbacked money creation and ties money to real-asset value, but its price level is determinate only under a fiscal closure (the sole determinacy regime an interest-free system admits, since it has no interest-rate instrument), and a companion paper shows this survives in full general equilibrium. Its stabilisation is bounded. We propose κ as a candidate riba-free clearing object that lets a full-reserve money base clear without an interest rate, serving both the Chicago-Plan and Islamic full-reserve programmes; we do not claim it was the sole obstacle to either programme's adoption, which is substantially institutional and political. The empirical reality of κ rests so far only on the authors' own companion working papers, pending independent replication, so we present this as a theoretical architecture.

title: Subjects and Objects of God: Non-state Normative Orders and International Corporate Theology

detail.title: Subjects and Objects of God: Non-state Normative Orders and International Corporate Theology
detail.abstract: Normative orders, whether divine, state, or corporate, allocate standing not by personhood but by address. A subject is an entity whose interior states the sovereign cares about and speaks to; an object is an entity the order governs purely instrumentally, as a means of changing what subjects think. This Article reconstructs that grammar from the canonical text in which it is most fully elaborated: the Hebrew Bible, whose narrative assigns subjecthood to man, to Satan, and to kingdoms, while deploying weather, plague, family, and conquered populations as instruments of divine pedagogy. The Article then argues that the subject/object boundary is not an ontological datum but what Karen Barad calls an "agential cut," enacted by the order's own apparatus of address, and that the biblical text both constructs this cut and repeatedly subverts it. Finally, the Article argues that the same grammar, and the same instability, appear in the internal legal orders of multinational corporations, whose compliance regimes address employees as subjects while governing supply chains as objects, and whose boundaries are being recut in real time by whistleblower statutes, worker-reclassification litigation, and human-rights due-diligence legislation. Standing, the Article concludes, is best understood as a theory of address.

AI.tldr: 本文基于希伯来圣经的核心叙事，重构了一个关于规范秩序中"主体/客体"界分的语法框架：秩序通过"address"（言说/指向）分配地位，主体是秩序所关切的内部状态并与之对话的实体，客体则是纯粹工具性治理的对象。文章进一步指出，这一边界并非本体论的既定事实，而是由秩序自身的言说装置所实施的"能动切割"，并在跨国公司内部法律秩序中重现了这一语法及其不稳定性。
AI.research_question: 规范秩序如何分配"主体"与"客体"的地位？这种分配是固定不变的吗？
AI.motivation: 传统法学对"standing"（诉讼资格/地位）的理解过于狭窄，本文试图提出一种更一般的"地位理论"——地位本质上是一种关于"address"（言说/指向）的理论，从而将古代神权叙事与现代公司治理统一在同一个分析框架下。
AI.theoretical_framework: Karen Barad的"能动切割"（agential cut）理论；语言哲学/话语理论中关于"address"的概念；希伯来圣经的神学-法律叙事传统。
AI.method: 文本分析：对希伯来圣经叙事的语法重构；类比论证：将圣经叙事中的主体/客体界分逻辑映射到现代跨国公司的合规治理结构；批判性理论分析：揭示边界的不稳定性与动态重新切割。
AI.findings: 1. 规范秩序（神圣的、国家的、企业的）分配地位的方式不是基于"人格"（personhood），而是基于"address"（言说/指向）。2. 主体是被秩序关切的内部状态并与之对话的实体；客体是纯粹工具性治理的对象。3. 主体/客体的边界不是本体论的既定事实，而是由秩序自身的言说装置实施的"能动切割"。4. 圣经文本既构建了这种切割，又反复解构它。5. 同样的语法和同样的不稳定性出现在跨国公司的内部法律秩序中：合规制度将员工视为主体，而将供应链视为客体，但举报人法规、工人重新分类诉讼和人权尽责立法正在实时重新切割这一边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"standing即address理论"（standing as a theory of address），将诉讼资格问题一般化为关于规范秩序如何分配主体/客体地位的普遍理论；将Karen Barad的"能动切割"概念引入法律理论分析；揭示了神权叙事与现代公司治理之间的深层结构同构性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解跨国公司合规治理中的责任分配问题提供新的理论视角；解释了举报人法规、工人分类诉讼和人权尽责立法如何正在重新划定企业内部治理的边界；对"standing"（诉讼资格）概念提供了一种更一般化的理论理解，可能影响法律实践中对地位问题的分析。

title: The Organization Was Warned: Labor Compliance, Coso, and the Governance of Known Employment Risk
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Organization Was Warned: Labor Compliance, Coso, and the Governance of Known Employment Risk
detail.abstract: This article examines labor compliance through the lens of risk management, internal controls, and responsible decision-making. It argues that the maturity of labor compliance programs should not be measured merely by the existence of policies, training sessions, reporting channels, working-time controls, occupational health and safety procedures, or risk matrices. The central issue lies in what organizations do after employment-related risks become known. In many cases, labor risk does not arise suddenly. It is preceded by excessive working hours, repeated complaints, health-related absences, turnover, safety incidents, harassment allegations, weak third-party oversight, data protection failures, or recurring litigation patterns. Drawing on COSO, ISO 31000, internal control theory, behavioral insights, and the Brazilian legal framework as a jurisdictional case study, the article proposes the concept of conscious employment liability: liability arising not merely from the objective breach of labor standards, but from the persistence of risky labor practices after sufficient warning signs, indicators, complaints, or internal alerts. The article concludes that effective labor compliance should be understood as an institutional engineering of responsible decision-making. Its function is not to assume that human nature will become virtuous by decree, but to design structures that transform known labor risk into traceability, escalation, mitigation, accountability, and organizational learning. The decisive question is no longer whether the organization had a compliance program. It is whether the organization, once warned, was institutionally capable of deciding differently.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“自觉性用工责任”概念，认为劳动合规的成熟度不应仅以政策、培训等程序性要素衡量，而应聚焦于组织在获知劳动风险后是否具备制度化的决策能力以改变行为路径。
AI.research_question: 如何从风险管理、内部控制与负责任决策的视角重新界定劳动合规的有效性标准？
AI.motivation: 传统劳动合规评估仅关注政策存在性等表面指标，忽视了组织在知悉风险后是否做出不同决策这一核心问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: COSO、ISO 31000、内部控制理论、行为洞察、巴西法律框架
AI.method: 规范性法学分析，结合风险管理和内部控制理论进行跨学科概念建构，并以巴西法律框架作为司法案例研究。
AI.findings: 劳动风险往往有预警信号（超时工作、反复投诉、安全事故等）；责任应源于对已知风险的持续性不作为；有效合规应理解为负责任决策的制度工程学。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出“自觉性用工责任”概念，将劳动合规评估从程序合规范式转向决策质量与制度响应能力范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计劳动合规体系提供新标准：核心在于将已知风险转化为可追溯、可升级、可缓解、可问责、可学习的制度结构。

title: Quotas and Reserves in Job Matching
affiliations: Université Paris-Saclay

detail.title: Quotas and Reserves in Job Matching
detail.abstract: Regulations imposing hiring constraints are widely used to promote diversity in labor markets. Motivated by these interventions, this paper studies their effects on the welfare of minority workers in stable allocations. Building on a Crawford--Knoer framework, we show that such regulations can unintentionally reduce minority welfare. Using firm-optimal and worker-optimal stable allocations as benchmarks, we characterize the class of policies that, across all markets, never reduce minority welfare under either allocation. This class consists only of the null policy and policies that exclude non-minority workers from the market without imposing reserves. We then introduce policy rules, which allow policies to depend on the assignment observed prior to intervention. Restricting attention to environments with two worker groups, we characterize the set of policy rules that never reduce the welfare of minority workers.

AI.tldr: 本文研究旨在促进劳动力市场多样性的雇佣限制政策（如配额/保留政策）对少数族裔工人福利的影响。在Crawford-Knoer匹配框架下，作者发现这类政策可能意外地降低少数族裔福利。通过分析企业最优和工人最优稳定分配，他们刻画了在所有市场中都不会降低少数族裔福利的政策类别：仅包含无效政策和完全排除非少数族裔（但不设保留）的政策。进一步引入"政策规则"（依赖干预前分配结果），在两组工人环境下刻画了永不降低少数族裔福利的政策规则集合。
AI.research_question: 旨在促进多元化的雇佣约束政策（如配额、保留政策）对少数族裔工人福利的影响是什么？哪些政策和政策规则能够确保永不降低少数族裔工人的福利？
AI.motivation: 现实中广泛存在以促进劳动力市场多元化为目标的雇佣约束法规（如平权行动、多样性配额），但这些干预的实际福利效应尚不明确。现有理论对这类政策可能对目标群体（少数族裔）产生的负面影响关注不足，因此需要系统性地分析其福利后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: Crawford-Knoer匹配框架、稳定分配理论（企业最优稳定分配 vs. 工人最优稳定分配）、机制设计/政策规则分析
AI.method: 理论建模与刻画分析：在Crawford-Knoer双边匹配框架下，研究雇佣约束政策对稳定分配中少数族裔福利的影响。通过比较静态分析和政策空间上的系统性刻画，识别出能确保永不伤害少数族裔的政策类别，并进一步引入政策规则（依赖于干预前分配结果）进行扩展分析。
AI.findings: 1. 旨在促进多样性的雇佣约束政策可能意外地降低少数族裔工人的福利（在稳定分配下）。2. 在所有市场中，能确保永不降低少数族裔福利的政策仅有两类：无效政策（不干预），以及完全排除非少数族裔但不设保留的政策。3. 在两组工人环境下，引入依赖干预前分配结果的"政策规则"可以扩展可行政策集合，使其在不降低少数族裔福利的前提下实现更多干预目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次在Crawford-Knoer匹配框架内系统分析雇佣约束政策对少数族裔工人福利的影响，揭示了"好心办坏事"的可能性。2. 对政策空间进行了精确刻画，识别出"稳健无害"的政策类别，为多样性干预设计提供了理论边界。3. 引入"政策规则"概念并给出刻画，扩展了匹配市场中政策设计的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计劳动力市场多样性政策提供理论指引：1. 警示简单配额/保留政策可能反噬目标群体福利；2. 指出若想确保不伤害少数族裔，要么不干预，要么采取排除非少数族裔的策略（但需注意政治可行性）；3. 提示基于干预前分配结果设计动态政策规则的可能路径。

title: Bqmm: Bayesian Multilevel Quantile Regression in R

detail.title: Bqmm: Bayesian Multilevel Quantile Regression in R
detail.abstract: Quantile regression describes how covariates shift the conditional quantiles of an outcome, not merely its mean, and is indispensable when effects are heterogeneous across the response distribution. When data are clustered or longitudinal, a mixed-effects formulation is needed. I present bqmm, an R package for Bayesian multilevel quantile regression built on the asymmetric Laplace working likelihood and Stan. The package offers an lme4-style formula interface with nested and crossed random effects, optional LKJ-correlated random effects, estimation of one or several quantiles in a single call, post-hoc non-crossing rearrangement, and a transparent menu of fixed-effect interval methods-the naive posterior, the Yang-Wang-He (2016) sandwich correction, and the infinitesimal jackknife-because the asymmetric Laplace likelihood is misspecified and naive credible intervals can be invalid. The paper describes the model and software design, illustrates usage on longitudinal growth data, summarises a validation study (parameter recovery, simulation-based calibration, and a coverage study), and compares bqmm with related software.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了R包bqmm，它基于非对称拉普拉斯似然和Stan，实现了贝叶斯多水平分位数回归，支持lme4风格的公式接口、嵌套/交叉随机效应、LKJ相关随机效应、单次估计多个分位数、后处理防交叉排列，并提供多种固定效应区间方法（朴素后验、Yang-Wang-He sandwich校正、无穷小刀切法），以解决非对称拉普拉斯似然模型设定错误导致的置信区间失效问题。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个功能完善、易于使用的R包，实现贝叶斯多水平分位数回归，并解决非对称拉普拉斯似然下模型设定错误导致的统计推断问题？
AI.motivation: 分位数回归在效应异质性分析中至关重要，但当数据存在聚类或纵向结构时，需要混合效应模型。现有软件在贝叶斯多水平分位数回归方面支持不足，且非对称拉普拉斯似然作为工作似然存在模型设定错误，导致朴素可信区间可能无效，需要更好的推断方法和易用的工具实现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分位数回归理论、非对称拉普拉斯分布（ALD）作为工作似然、贝叶斯推断（Stan/HMC）、多水平模型（嵌套和交叉随机效应）、LKJ先验分布（相关随机效应）、后处理防交叉排列（non-crossing rearrangement）、Yang-Wang-He sandwich方差修正、无穷小刀切法（infinitesimal jackknife）。
AI.method: 基于非对称拉普拉斯似然和Stan（Hamiltonian Monte Carlo）构建贝叶斯多水平分位数回归模型，采用lme4风格的公式语法，支持嵌套与交叉随机效应及LKJ相关结构；通过参数恢复、仿真校准（simulation-based calibration）和覆盖度研究进行验证，并与现有软件比较。
AI.findings: bqmm包能够有效实现贝叶斯多水平分位数回归，参数恢复良好；仿真校准和覆盖度研究表明，Yang-Wang-He sandwich修正和无穷小刀切法比朴素后验方法具有更好的区间覆盖性质；软件设计灵活，支持多种分位数同时估计和后处理防交叉排列，与lme4风格接口兼容，易于使用。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统总结了贝叶斯多水平分位数回归中非对称拉普拉斯似然模型设定错误对统计推断的影响，并比较了多种固定效应区间修正方法的适用性；提供了LKJ先验在多水平分位数回归中相关随机效应的理论整合。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个功能完整、接口友好的R包bqmm，使研究者能够方便地在聚类/纵向数据中应用贝叶斯多水平分位数回归；透明地提供了多种区间估计方法选择，帮助实践者避免模型设定错误导致的错误推断；通过实例和验证研究为软件使用提供了指南。

title:
The Kinematics of Language 
A Unified Framework for Physics Pedagogy and AI Literacy

detail.title:
The Kinematics of Language 
A Unified Framework for Physics Pedagogy and AI Literacy
detail.abstract:
his pre-print draft introduces a novel pedagogical framework that unifies physics education with AI prompt
engineering. By translating abstract mathematical principles into qualitative, precise linguistic commands (the prompt
stack), learners build robust physical intuition before formal derivation. The abstract below presents the core thesis
through the three-voice framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个将物理教育与AI提示工程相结合的新型教学框架，通过将抽象数学原理转化为精确的语言指令（提示堆栈），帮助学习者在正式推导之前建立扎实的物理直觉。
AI.research_question: 如何将物理教育与AI提示工程结合，通过语言指令而非纯数学推导来帮助学生建立物理直觉？
AI.motivation: 传统物理教育过度依赖数学推导，学生在正式学习数学推导之前难以建立物理直觉，需要一种更渐进、更直观的教学方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 三声部框架（three-voice framework）；提示堆栈（prompt stack）——将抽象数学原理转化为定性、精确的语言指令。
AI.method: 概念性的教学框架设计，基于三声部框架呈现核心论点。
AI.findings: 通过提示堆栈方法，学习者在进行正式数学推导前能够建立更稳健的物理直觉。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一物理教育与AI提示工程的新教学框架——三声部框架，为物理教学法提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为物理教育者提供了一种可操作的教学工具（提示堆栈），帮助学生直观理解物理概念，降低入门门槛。

reference: KIEP Research Paper, World Economy Brief(WEB) 25-32
title: Supply Chain Stability and Strategic Investment Subsidies
affiliations: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy

detail.title: Supply Chain Stability and Strategic Investment Subsidies

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIEP Research Paper, World Economy Brief(WEB) 25-32
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Since the COVID-19 pandemic, industrial policies adopted by major advanced economies, including the United States, the European Union, and Japan, have brought about significant changes in the global trade environment. Guided by policy objectives such as digital and green transitions, the acquisition of advanced industrial technologies, economic security, and supply chain resilience, these economies have expanded support measures to promote domestic investment in selected industries. These measures include R&D subsidies, production subsidies, and tax incentives, and they apply not only to domestic firms but also to foreign investors. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 该论文分析了自新冠疫情以来，美国、欧盟和日本等主要发达经济体以数字与绿色转型、先进技术获取、经济安全和供应链韧性为政策目标，通过研发补贴、生产补贴和税收优惠等产业政策工具，对全球贸易环境产生的重大影响。
AI.research_question: 后疫情时代主要发达经济体（美国、欧盟、日本）的产业政策如何改变了全球贸易环境？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情引发全球供应链震荡，主要发达经济体纷纷调整产业政策，这些政策变化对全球贸易格局产生了深远影响，亟需系统分析其政策目标、工具与影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 产业政策理论、国际贸易理论、供应链韧性理论
AI.method: 政策分析与比较研究
AI.findings: 美国、欧盟和日本等主要发达经济体以数字转型、绿色转型、先进技术获取、经济安全和供应链韧性为目标，通过研发补贴、生产补贴和税收优惠等措施扩大了国内选定产业的投资支持，且政策同时适用于本土企业和外国投资者。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了后疫情时代产业政策与国际贸易环境变化的理论分析框架，深化了对大国产业政策工具组合的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业理解全球贸易环境变化、评估产业政策影响以及制定应对策略提供参考依据。

title:
E-VAT Adoption and VAT Revenue Performance in South Asia: 
Evidence from Bangladesh

detail.title:
E-VAT Adoption and VAT Revenue Performance in South Asia: 
Evidence from Bangladesh

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with any individuals or organisations that could have influenced this research. There are no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved 25 semi-structured interviews with human participants (NBR officials, VAT consultants, and SME taxpayers). Informed consent was obtained from all participants prior to each interview. Participation was voluntary, and participants were informed of their right to withdraw at any time without consequences. All participant data has been fully anonymised using coded identifiers. No personally identifiable information is reported. The study was conducted as independent practitioner research without university affiliation and accordingly did not require formal IRB approval; however, all ethical principles of voluntary participation, informed consent, confidentiality, and data protection were strictly observed.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author without financial support from any government body, institution, or private organisation.

detail.abstract: Electronic Value Added Tax (E-VAT) schemes play an important role in the process of tax administration modernization in South Asia but have vastly varying revenue effects in countries that have broadly similar tax policy goals. This study aims to discuss the maturity of E-VAT system, the performance of VAT/GST revenue in six selected South Asian economies (S.A.E.) with specific reference to Bangladesh, the behavior of taxpayers and challenges in implementing E-VAT system in those selected S.A.E. It follows a sequential explanatory mixed methods design, which involves secondary country-year data for fiscal years 2019-2024 and 25 semi-structured interviews with 5 NBR officials, 10 VAT consultants and 10 VAT-registered SME taxpayers. Due to the small panel sample (n = 25), this exploratory OLS regression analysis is not meant to uncover exact causal relationships. Although the rate of the standard VAT rate in Bangladesh is 15%, and the E-VAT platform has been operational since 2019, Bangladesh has a low VAT-to-GDP ratio of about 3.6%, compared to Nepal (5.3%) and India (6-7%) and the Maldives (approximately 12%). Additionally, as shown in interview evidence, there are ongoing institutional and operational challenges that limit the actual use of the einvoice tool, such as: Segregated revenue databases; Unreliability of the portal during peaks of einvoice filing; Low levels of taxpayer training; Poor taxpayer grievance mechanisms; and the lack of mandation for e-invoicing. The study suggests the Bangladesh E-VAT Adoption Framework (BEVAF) that correlates institutional enablers, technology platform maturity and behavioral compliance outcomes from an institutional perspective. The results confirm a staged reform program focusing on the following areas: e-invoicing, integration of databases, taxpayer assistance, audit risk scoring, accessing invoices on mobile devices, and reform of penalty procedures.

AI.tldr: 研究南亚六国电子增值税（E-VAT）系统的成熟度与收入效果差异，重点分析孟加拉国，提出BEVAF框架，发现制度性障碍和技术平台不成熟是导致低VAT-GDP比（3.6%）的关键原因。
AI.research_question: 为什么在税制目标相似的南亚经济体中，电子增值税（E-VAT）系统的实施效果（以收入表现为衡量）存在巨大差异？孟加拉国E-VAT系统面临哪些制度与操作挑战？
AI.motivation: E-VAT在南亚税收管理现代化中至关重要，但各国收入效果差异显著，现有研究对此解释不足，尤其缺乏对孟加拉国的系统分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于制度理论视角，构建了"孟加拉国E-VAT采纳框架（BEVAF）"，将制度推动因素、技术平台成熟度与行为合规结果联系起来。
AI.method: 顺序解释性混合方法设计：①2019-2024年六个南亚国家的面板数据（n=25）的OLS回归分析（探索性）；②25个半结构化访谈（5名NBR官员、10名VAT顾问、10名VAT注册中小企业纳税人）。
AI.findings: ①孟加拉国VAT-GDP比仅3.6%，远低于尼泊尔（5.3%）、印度（6-7%）和马尔代夫（约12%）；②关键障碍包括：收入数据库分散、门户高峰期不可靠、纳税人培训不足、申诉机制差、电子发票未强制化；③BEVAF框架表明制度推动因素与技术成熟度共同影响合规行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了BEVAF框架，将技术平台成熟度纳入制度理论视角分析税收合规，填补了E-VAT实施差异性的理论解释空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国及类似发展中国家提出了分阶段改革路径：电子发票强制化、数据库整合、纳税人援助、审计风险评分、移动端发票查询及罚款程序改革。

reference: KIEP Research Paper, World Economy Brief(WEB) 26-03
title: Global Trends in High Debt Levels and Their Macroeconomic Implications

detail.title: Global Trends in High Debt Levels and Their Macroeconomic Implications

publicationDetails.detailsText: KIEP Research Paper, World Economy Brief(WEB) 26-03
publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In response to the unprecedented crisis triggered by the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, governments and central banks around the world injected massive fiscal stimulus and liquidity support. These bold policy measures succeeded in averting the worst recession, but, as a consequence, the world is now facing historically high levels of debt. According to the Institute of International Finance, global debt surpassed USD 324 trillion in the first quarter of 2025—roughly three times the size of global GDP and “[a level unseen] since the Napoleonic Wars.” Moreover, global debt increased by USD 7.5 trillion during the same quarter, more than four times the quarterly average increase of USD 1.7 trillion since late 2022, indicating that the global debt problem has worsened rather than eased after the pandemic. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文讨论新冠疫情后全球债务激增的问题。2020年各国大规模财政刺激和流动性支持成功避免了最严重的衰退，但导致全球债务达到历史高位——2025年第一季度超过324万亿美元，约为全球GDP的三倍，是拿破仑战争以来最高水平。且该季度债务增长7.5万亿美元，远超2022年底以来每季1.7万亿的平均增幅，表明疫情后债务问题并未缓解反而恶化。
AI.research_question: 新冠疫情后全球债务为何持续攀升至历史高位？这一债务状况对全球经济有何影响？
AI.motivation: 2020年各国为应对疫情采取大规模刺激措施，虽然避免了大萧条，但导致全球债务水平空前高涨，且疫情结束后债务问题仍在恶化，亟需深入分析其成因与后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共债务理论、财政刺激与货币宽松政策的宏观经济学理论、债务可持续性分析框架。
AI.method: 基于国际金融协会（IIF）的全球债务数据进行描述性统计分析，运用历史对比（拿破仑战争时期）和时间序列趋势分析。
AI.findings: 1）全球债务在2025年Q1突破324万亿美元，约为全球GDP的三倍，达拿破仑战争以来最高水平。2）该季度债务增长7.5万亿美元，是2022年底以来季度平均增幅（1.7万亿）的4倍多。3）疫情后全球债务问题不但没有缓解，反而持续恶化。
AI.theory_contributions: 更新了后疫情时代全球债务水平的实证证据，揭示了大规模危机应对政策的长期债务后果。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各国政策制定者提供债务风险预警，提示需重新评估财政可持续性，避免债务危机爆发。

detail.abstract: Global supply chains are being reorganized amid intensifying U.S.–China strategic competition, the expansion of economic security legislation, and persistent geopolitical risks. The logic of supply chain management is moving beyond cost and efficiency toward supply security, resilience, and technological and industrial security. As trade, technology, standards, data, industrial policy, and external economic strategy become increasingly intertwined, supply chains are no longer merely channels of production and trade. They have become strategic spaces in which economic competitiveness and security concerns are closely connected. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在中美战略竞争加剧、经济安全立法扩张和地缘政治风险持续的背景下，全球供应链正从以成本和效率为核心转向以供应安全、韧性和技术与产业安全为核心。供应链已不再仅仅是生产和贸易的渠道，而成为经济竞争力与安全紧密相连的战略空间。
AI.research_question: 全球供应链在地缘政治竞争和经济安全立法扩张背景下发生了怎样的结构性转变？供应链逻辑如何从成本效率导向转向安全韧性导向？
AI.motivation: 中美战略竞争加剧、经济安全立法扩张以及持续的地缘政治风险正在重塑全球供应链格局，传统的以成本和效率为核心的供应链管理逻辑已不再适用，需要重新审视供应链的战略角色。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链安全理论、地缘政治经济学、经济安全与国家竞争力理论
AI.method: 文献分析与理论推演
AI.findings: 全球供应链正经历从效率优先到安全优先的范式转换；贸易、技术、标准、数据、产业政策和外部经济战略日益交织；供应链已成为经济竞争力与安全紧密相连的战略空间。
AI.theory_contributions: 将供应链管理从传统的运营管理视角拓展到地缘政治与经济安全的理论框架，提出供应链作为"战略空间"的概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和政策制定者提供供应链重构的战略思路，帮助理解在美中竞争和地缘政治风险下如何平衡效率与安全。

detail.abstract: As “America First” nationalism and the tendency toward bloc formation have intensified in the wake of deepening US–China strategic competition, the COVID-19 pandemic, and the outbreak of the Russia–Ukraine war, BRICS has been expanding with the Global South at its center. Accordingly, the influence of BRICS is widening across energy, critical minerals, and manufacturing supply chains, as well as in the finance and investment sectors. Following the accession of the UAE, Egypt, Iran, and Ethiopia in 2024, Indonesia joined BRICS+ in 2025, reinforcing BRICS’ role as a soft-balancing platform that defends the interests of emerging economies against Western-centered governance. As of 2023, the ten BRICS countries accounted for 48.7% of the world's population, 28.1% of global GDP, and 24.5% of global exports, making it a vast economic cooperation bloc. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文分析BRICS+扩员及其在全球供应链、金融投资领域的崛起，认为BRICS+正成为新兴经济体对抗西方中心治理的软制衡平台。
AI.research_question: BRICS+扩员如何影响全球能源、关键矿产、制造业供应链及金融投资格局？BRICS+作为软制衡平台的角色如何演变？
AI.motivation: 在美国"美国优先"民族主义与集团化趋势加剧、中美战略竞争深化、新冠疫情及俄乌冲突爆发的背景下，BRICS以全球南方为中心持续扩员，其影响力不断扩展，值得深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 软制衡理论（Soft Balancing）：BRICS+作为新兴经济体维护自身利益、对抗西方中心治理的非军事制衡平台。
AI.method: 基于宏观数据的描述性统计分析（人口、GDP、出口占比），结合地缘政治经济定性分析。
AI.findings: 截至2023年，BRICS十国占世界人口的48.7%、全球GDP的28.1%、全球出口的24.5%，已成为庞大的经济合作集团；BRICS+在能源、关键矿产、制造业供应链及金融投资领域的影响力持续扩大。
AI.theory_contributions: 将软制衡理论应用于BRICS+扩员分析，揭示新兴经济体通过经济合作集团化来平衡西方主导的全球治理体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解全球南方崛起、去西方中心化的国际经济秩序演变提供政策启示，对评估BRICS+对全球供应链和金融体系的重塑具有参考价值。

title: On the Role of Consciousness in Socio-Economic Development
affiliations: St.Petersburg State University

detail.title: On the Role of Consciousness in Socio-Economic Development

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Institute of Problems of Mechanical Engineering RAS, Bolshoy pr., 61, VO, 199178 St. Petersburg and St. Petersburg State University, Universitetsky pr., 28, Petrodvoretz, 198504 St. Petersburg, RUSSIA
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a purely theoretical and comparative study based exclusively on publicly available secondary macroeconomic and institutional data (GDP, TFP, Worldwide Governance Indicators, etc.). It does not involve human subjects, primary data collection, surveys, experiments, interviews, or any other activities requiring ethical approval.
declarations.funderStatement: The research was supported by the Ministry of Science and Higher Education of the Russian Federation (project no. 124041500008-1)

detail.abstract: This paper develops an integrative analytical framework within institutional and evolutionary economics. Drawing on a dialectical synthesis of Hegel's emphasis on external reality as the driver of consciousness and Marx's historical materialism, the study introduces two conceptual innovations: the notion of "shells" as a multi-level ontological unit and the Principle of Uncertainty as a normative mechanism for managing persistent misalignment between external challenges and internal structures.The framework is applied to a comparative-historical analysis of post-reform trajectories in Russia, China, and India. Using standard indicators of annual GDP growth, total factor productivity (TFP), and the Worldwide Governance Indicators, the paper shows how the factor of uncertainty-arising from the imperfect reflection of rapidly changing external reality by collective consciousness-helps explain divergent long-term development paths. China's gradual multi-level approach minimized misalignment and maintained high adherence to the Principle of Uncertainty, producing sustained growth and institutional adaptation. India exhibited moderate and spatially heterogeneous misalignment due to federal experimentation. Russia's rapid dismantling of central shells generated significantly higher misalignment and lower adherence to the Principle of Uncertainty, resulting in greater volatility.The study demonstrates that the quality of alignment across hierarchical shells and the degree of adherence to the Principle of Uncertainty are critical determinants of sustained economic performance. It also offers concrete policy implications for managing contemporary challenges such as artificial intelligence and ecological constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文在制度和演化经济学框架内，通过引入"外壳"本体论概念和"不确定性原则"规范机制，结合黑格尔与马克思的辩证法，对俄罗斯、中国和印度后改革时期的经济发展路径进行了比较历史分析，揭示了集体意识与外部现实之间的错配程度如何解释三国不同的长期发展绩效。
AI.research_question: 在制度和演化经济学视角下，集体意识对外部现实的"不完美反映"所产生的不确定性，如何解释俄罗斯、中国和印度后改革时期不同的长期发展路径？
AI.motivation: 现有制度经济学和演化经济学缺乏一个能够整合本体论和规范机制的整合性分析框架，难以解释为什么面临类似外部挑战的国家却走上了截然不同的发展轨迹。
AI.theoretical_framework: ①制度和演化经济学；②黑格尔辩证法（外部现实是意识的驱动力）；③马克思的历史唯物主义；④"外壳"概念（多层次本体论单元）；⑤"不确定性原则"（作为管理外部挑战与内部结构之间持续错配的规范机制）。
AI.method: 比较历史分析法；使用年度GDP增长率、全要素生产率（TFP）和全球治理指标（WGI）等标准化指标进行实证分析。
AI.findings: ①中国的渐进式多层次改革最小化了错配，对"不确定性原则"保持了高 adherence，实现了持续增长和制度适应；②印度的联邦式实验导致了中等程度且空间异质性的错配；③俄罗斯的中央"外壳"快速瓦解导致了显著更高的错配和更低的不确定性原则 adherence，引发了更大的经济波动。
AI.theory_contributions: ①提出了"外壳"作为多层次本体论单元的概念创新；②提出了"不确定性原则"作为规范机制；③将黑格尔与马克思的辩证法综合融入制度和演化经济学；④构建了跨层次外壳对齐质量与经济发展绩效之间的理论关联。
AI.practical_contributions: ①为理解后转型国家的差异化发展绩效提供了分析工具；②为管理人工智能和生态约束等当代挑战提供了具体的政策启示；③强调了改革速度与制度适配之间的平衡重要性。

title: Designated for Success? Testing for Cherry-Picking in New York City's Opportunity Zone Designations Using Permutation Inference and Detrended Difference-in-Differences
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Designated for Success? Testing for Cherry-Picking in New York City's Opportunity Zone Designations Using Permutation Inference and Detrended Difference-in-Differences
detail.abstract:
The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 established the Opportunity Zone (OZ) program, a federal initiative meant to encourage private investment in economically distressed census tracts. Officials select designated tracts from an eligible pool at their discretion. This study examines whether New York City's 306 Opportunity Zone census tracts were cherry-picked—systematically selected based on pre-existing favorable trajectories rather than genuine economic distress. I test whether OZ designation caused meaningful demographic and economic shifts observed in designated tracts or whether those shifts merely reflect pre-existing trends. I conducted three analyses using American Community Survey five-year estimates for eight outcomes. First, a permutation test compared the pre-policy growth trends of OZ tracts against 1,000 randomly selected groups of eligible tracts, finding that OZ neighborhoods were already gaining White residents at an unusual rate before designation (p = 0.010). Second, a standard difference-in-differences (DiD) model with Monte Carlo permutation inference produced statistically significant shifts in racial composition and home values. Third, I removed each neighborhood's pre-existing growth trajectory before re-estimating the policy's effects in a detrended DiD. After detrending, every previously significant result—the increase in White population share, the decline in Hispanic population share, and the rise in median home value—fell outside statistical significance.

These results suggest that the changes attributed to Opportunity Zones were largely underway before the policy took effect. The discretionary selection process may have allowed officials to designate tracts already on favorable trajectories, creating the appearance of policy success even when the policy had no detectable effect. I recommend that future place-based investment programs adopt transparent, formula-driven selection criteria, publish tract-level scores, and require pre-trend audits before crediting observed improvements to the program.

AI.tldr: 纽约市OZ项目的306个普查区在政策实施前就已经出现了白人口增长等有利趋势，官员的选择过程存在"摘樱桃"现象。使用去趋势双重差分法后，所有以前显著的OZ政策效应（白人比例上升、西裔比例下降、房价中位数上涨）均不再显著，表明所谓政策效果实际是预先存在的趋势。
AI.research_question: 纽约市的"机会区"（Opportunity Zone）普查区是否被官员"摘樱桃"——即系统性地选择了那些原本就处于有利发展轨迹的社区，而非真正经济困难的社区？OZ政策是否导致了可观测的人口与社会经济变化，还是这些变化只是预先存在的趋势？
AI.motivation: 2017年《减税与就业法案》设立的OZ项目是一项旨在鼓励对经济困难社区进行投资的联邦计划，但官员在指定普查区时拥有自由裁量权。这种自由裁量可能导致政治干预和资源配置偏差，使得政策看起来有效而实际上并无效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 地方导向投资政策理论（Place-based investment policy）；2. 选择性偏差与"摘樱桃"效应（Cherry-picking/Selection bias）；3. 双重差分与去趋势分析（DiD & Detrended DiD）
AI.method: 使用美国社区调查（ACS）五年期数据的八项指标进行了三种分析：1）排列检验（Permutation test）：比较OZ区与1000组随机选择符合条件区域的预政策增长趋势；2）标准双重差分模型（DiD）搭配蒙特卡洛排列推断；3）去趋势双重差分（Detrended DiD）：去除每个社区预先存在的增长轨迹后再估计政策效应。
AI.findings: 1. 排列检验显示，OZ社区在政策实施前白人口增长已异常迅速（p=0.010）；2. 标准DiD得到种族构成和房价的显著变化；3. 去趋势DiD后，所有以前显著的结果——白人比例上升、西裔比例下降、房价中位数上涨——均不再具有统计显著性。说明OZ政策本身没有可检测的效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为"地方导向投资政策"的选择性偏差提供了实证证据，证明自由裁量权配额可能导致政策效果被高估；2. 提出并验证了"去趋势双重差分"方法，为后续政策评估中的事前趋势控制提供了方法论借鉴；3. 揭示了"摘樱桃"现象如何制造政策有效的假象。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议未来的地方投资计划采用透明、基于公式的选择标准，并公开各普查区的评分；2. 要求在归因政策效果前进行事前趋势审计（pre-trend audit），避免将预先存在的趋势误认为政策成效；3. 为OZ项目的政策评估和政策改进提供了直接证据和操作建议。

title: How Resilient Were Emerging Market Economies Through the 2022‑23 U.S. Monetary Tightening Cycle?
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: How Resilient Were Emerging Market Economies Through the 2022‑23 U.S. Monetary Tightening Cycle?

keywords: growth-driven and monetary-driven U.S. monetary shocks

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
The cross-border spillover effects of shifts in U.S. monetary policy have long been a focus of academics and policymakers alike. A common finding in the literature is that changes in the stance of U.S. monetary policy have sizable effects on economic activity and financial markets in emerging market economies (EMEs). In this post, we analyze one specific aspect of these spillovers: how EMEs fared through the U.S. monetary policy tightening cycle of 2022-23 relative to the predictions of a model, which was calibrated to capture empirically relevant features of these economies based on historical data. We find that more vulnerable EMEs fared better in both financial market and growth outcomes than would be expected from our model, while the relatively less vulnerable fared a bit better than the model predictions for financial outcomes but substantially worse for growth outcomes.

To view post: https://libertystreeteconomics.newyorkfed.org/2026/06/how-resilient-were-emerging-market-economies-through-the-2022-23-u-s-monetary-tightening-cycle/

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2022-23年美国货币政策紧缩周期对新兴市场经济体（EMEs）的跨境溢出效应，发现相对脆弱的EMEs在金融市场和增长结果上的表现优于模型预测，而相对不脆弱的EMEs在金融结果上略好于预期，但增长结果显著更差。
AI.research_question: 在2022-23年美国货币政策紧缩周期中，新兴市场经济体（EMEs）的实际表现如何？尤其是不同脆弱性程度的EMEs在金融市场和经济增长方面的表现与历史模型预测有何差异？
AI.motivation: 美国货币政策变动对新兴市场经济体的溢出效应是学术界和政策制定者长期关注的焦点。既往文献表明美国货币政策变化对EMEs的经济活动和金融市场有显著影响，但2022-23年的紧缩周期中EMEs的表现是否与历史经验一致值得深入探究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨境货币政策溢出效应理论；基于历史数据校准的模型，用于捕捉EMEs的实证相关特征。
AI.method: 构建一个基于历史数据校准的模型，将2022-23年EMEs的实际表现与模型预测进行比较分析，按脆弱性程度对EMEs进行分组对比。
AI.findings: （1）相对脆弱的EMEs在金融市场和增长结果上均好于模型预测；（2）相对不脆弱的EMEs在金融结果上略好于预期，但增长结果显著低于模型预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了不同脆弱性程度的EMEs对美国货币政策紧缩周期的异质性反应模式，挑战了传统预期中脆弱经济体表现更差的假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解EMEs在美国货币政策紧缩周期中的韧性提供了新的实证依据，有助于区分不同脆弱性程度经济体的差异化应对策略。

title: The End of Hyper-globalisation, Resurgent Imperialism and the Prospects for Genuine Transformation
affiliations: University of Auckland - Faculty of Law

detail.title: The End of Hyper-globalisation, Resurgent Imperialism and the Prospects for Genuine Transformation

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Auckland Faculty of Law Research Paper Series 2026
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Auckland Faculty of Law Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
It seems fashionable these days to start by quoting Antonio Gramsci: “we in an interregnum – the old is dying, the new is yet to be born, we are surrounded by morbid symptoms”. The “old” is the international “rules-based” order that has prevailed since World War Two, or in the international trade regime, since the 1980s. Its breakdown is variously attributed to the rise of economic nationalism, great power rivalries, and populist politics that have enabled authoritarian government.

But too often those commentators forget that Gramsci was a communist imprisoned by Mussolini’s facist regime and chronicled the hegemonic crisis facing Italy’s ruling class and their system of governance in the 1920s. The morbid symptoms he observed – authoritarianism, political extremism, and social breakdown – were products of a political struggle over material and social relations, understood through the lens of historical materialism. Internationally, that was overlaid by the brutality and nihilism of colonisation and imperialism, which was beyond Gramsci’s immediate focus.

Translated to today, the same morbid symptoms of authoritarianism, political extremism and social breakdown need to be understood as products of hyper-globalised capitalism that has prevailed since the 1980s. And the deep disparities between rule-makers and rule-takers in the international trade and investment regime are built upon their colonial legacy, overlaid by new forms of militarisation and imperialism.

Keynote Panel, “International Law in a Fractured Global Order”, Bogazici International Law Conference, Istanbul, 13 June 2026

AI.tldr: 本文以葛兰西的“间歇期”概念为框架，批判性地分析二战后国际“基于规则的秩序”（尤其是国际贸易与投资体制）的瓦解。作者指出，当前出现的威权主义、政治极端主义和社会崩溃等“病态症状”，并非简单地源于经济民族主义或大国竞争，而是1980年代以来超全球化资本主义的产物，并根植于殖民历史与新帝国主义形态。
AI.research_question: 如何从历史唯物主义和葛兰西的“间歇期”理论出发，理解当前国际秩序（特别是国际贸易与投资体制）的破裂及其背后的深层原因？
AI.motivation: 主流评论将当前国际秩序破裂归因于经济民族主义、大国竞争和民粹政治，但这些解释忽略了问题的物质基础和历史根源。作者旨在纠正这种片面解读，回归历史唯物主义视角，揭示超全球化资本主义与殖民遗产在塑造当前危机中的根本作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 葛兰西的“间歇期”（interregnum）与霸权危机理论；历史唯物主义；殖民主义与帝国主义批判理论。
AI.method: 理论分析与批判性论述（会议主题发言形式）。
AI.findings: 当前国际秩序的破裂是超全球化资本主义内在矛盾的体现；国际贸易与投资体制中“规则制定者”与“规则接受者”之间的深层不平等，建立在殖民历史之上，并叠加了新的军事化和帝国主义形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将葛兰西的霸权危机理论重新应用于当代国际秩序分析，强调历史唯物主义的解释力；拓展了对“病态症状”的归因分析，将其从表象层面（民粹、民族主义）深化至物质关系层面（超全球化资本主义）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒国际法学者和政策制定者，解决当前国际秩序危机不能仅停留在规范修复层面，而必须正视资本主义全球化与殖民历史遗留的结构性不平等问题。

affiliations: Bila Tserkva National Agrarian University, Bila Tserkva National Agrarian University, National University of Life and Environmental Sciences of Ukraine, Ontario International Development Agency and

detail.title: Formation of a Creative Model of Human Capital Management and Social Responsibility of Agribusiness under Conditions of Ensuring Food Supply for the Population of Ukraine

publicationDetails.detailsText: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development, 19 (07), 127-144, 2026
publicationDetails.journalName: OIDA International Journal of Sustainable Development

detail.abstract: The article is devoted to the development of a creative model for managing human capital and social responsibility of agricultural business, taking into account the tasks of food stability. The research focuses on the interaction of personnel parameters, technological development and production results, which is interpreted as a multidimensional system of dependencies. Methodologically, the work is based on a combination of the index approach, integral estimation and econometric modeling. A system of internal human capital indices is proposed, covering qualification, digital, motivational and analytical components, as well as the intensity of reskilling. The indicators are integrated into the generalized assessment index. The results showed that the impact of human capital and social responsibility on productivity is non-linear and enhanced by their interaction with technological parameters. It has been established that the main increase in production results is due to an interaction between the level of competencies and the digitalization of personnel work. It has been proven that human capital has an impact on food stability directly through the structure of production and the level of specialization. The practical significance of the study lies in the fact that the proposed toolkit predicts the results of the activities of agricultural enterprises based on the input parameters of human capital assessment. The developed model increases the manageability of agricultural business and contributes to the strengthening of the food supply system. The scientific novelty of the work is combined with the parameterization of human capital with the econometric analysis of production and food indicators, which makes it possible to move from descriptive estimates to quantitatively based management.

AI.tldr: 本文为农业企业开发了一个融合人力资本与社会责任管理的创新模型，通过指数法、综合评估和计量经济学建模，验证了人力资本与技术参数的交互作用对生产效率和食品稳定性的非线性影响，提出了从描述性评估转向量化管理决策的实用工具。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个将人力资本和社会责任管理相结合的创造性模型，以提升农业企业的生产成果并保障食品稳定性？
AI.motivation: 农业企业面临人力资本管理、社会责任履行与食品稳定性的多重挑战，但现有研究多停留在描述性评估层面，缺乏将人力资本参数化并与生产、食品指标进行计量经济分析的综合框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、社会责任理论、食品稳定性理论；基于指数法、综合评估法和计量经济学建模的多维系统依赖关系框架。
AI.method: 结合指数法构建内部人力资本指数体系（涵盖资格、数字化、动机、分析及再技能培训强度等维度），通过综合评估指数进行整合，并运用计量经济学建模分析人力资本、社会责任与生产结果之间的非线性关系及交互效应。
AI.findings: 人力资本与社会责任对生产率的影响呈非线性特征，且通过与技术参数的交互作用得到增强；生产成果的主要增长源于能力水平与人员工作数字化转型之间的交互；人力资本通过生产结构和专业化水平直接影响食品稳定性。
AI.theory_contributions: 将人力资本的参数化与生产及食品指标的计量经济分析相结合，实现了从描述性评估向量化基础管理的理论跃迁，为农业企业管理提供了可验证的因果关系模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了可基于人力资本评估输入参数预测农业企业活动结果的实用工具，增强了农业企业的可管理性，有助于强化食品供应体系。

title: Quantitative AAOIFI Standard 21 Compliance Screening: A Gradient Boosting Framework with SHAP Explainability for Shariah-compliant Stock Selection
affiliations: WorldQuant University

detail.title: Quantitative AAOIFI Standard 21 Compliance Screening: A Gradient Boosting Framework with SHAP Explainability for Shariah-compliant Stock Selection
detail.abstract: Shariah-compliant stock screening has historically relied entirely on manual analysis by Shariah Supervisory Boards (SSBs). This paper presents a reproducible machine learning framework that treats AAOIFI Standard 21 (2017) compliance as a supervised classification problem, with the SSB verdicts as ground truth labels. Trained a gradient boosting ensemble on a calibrated synthetic dataset of 2,847 synthetically modeled SSB compliance verdicts spanning (2019-2025), achieving 91% accuracy on a held-out test set of 412 verdicts. SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) feature attribution reveals: revenue purity (32%), debt leverage (28%), and sector classification (18%) together determine 78% of the compliance verdict, validating the structural emphasis of AAOIFI Standard 21. The model reduces analyst screening time by 87% (from 4.2 hours to 32 minutes per company, n=34 Islamic asset managers, 2025 pilot). Confidence intervals flag 16% of borderline cases for mandatory SSB review. Discussing the governance principle that this model assists SSBs rather than replaces them.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于梯度提升集成的机器学习框架，将AAOIFI标准21（2017）的伊斯兰教法合规筛选转化为监督分类问题。在2847条合成教法合规数据上训练，达到91%准确率。SHAP归因显示收入纯度（32%）、债务杠杆（28%）和行业分类（18%）共同决定78%的合规判定。模型将分析师筛选时间从每家公司4.2小时缩短至32分钟（减少87%），并将16%的边界案例标记为强制教法委员会审查。
AI.research_question: 如何利用机器学习框架将伊斯兰教法合规的股票筛选过程从完全依赖人工分析转变为可复现的自动化分类任务？
AI.motivation: 传统的伊斯兰教法合规股票筛选完全依赖教法监督委员会（SSB）的人工分析，效率低下、耗时较长且难以规模化，亟需一种可复现、高效且透明的自动化方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: AAOIFI标准21（2017）的合规准则；监督分类框架；梯度提升集成学习；SHAP特征归因理论。
AI.method: 构建包含2847条合成教法合规裁决的数据集（2019-2025年），以SSB裁决为真实标签，训练梯度提升集成分类器。使用SHAP进行特征重要性归因，并在412条保留测试集上进行评估，同时在34家伊斯兰资产管理公司开展2025年试点验证。
AI.findings: 模型在测试集上达到91%的准确率；收入纯度（32%）、债务杠杆（28%）和行业分类（18%）三大特征共同解释78%的合规裁决；模型将分析师筛选时间从每家公司4.2小时缩短至32分钟（减少87%）；16%的边界案例被标记为须由教法委员会强制审查。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将伊斯兰教法合规筛选形式化为可复现的监督分类问题，并通过SHAP归因实证验证了AAOIFI标准21的结构性重点（收入纯度、债务杠杆和行业分类的主导作用）。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出一个辅助教法委员会而非取代其的治理原则；将分析师筛选时间减少87%，大幅提升效率；通过置信区间自动识别16%的边界案例供人工复核，实现人机协同的合规筛选流程。

title: AI-Based Jurimetrics: The Declaration and Foundation of a New Field in Legal Analysis

detail.title: AI-Based Jurimetrics: The Declaration and Foundation of a New Field in Legal Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationship with any person or organization that could be perceived to have influenced this study. The work was prepared as an independent scholarly contribution. The author was assisted by an artificial intelligence partner functioning as an instrument under the author's direction; substantive authority over, and responsibility for, all content rests entirely with the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects, patients, or participants; ethics approval was therefore not required. All materials referred to are publicly available legal documents and scholarly literature.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no funding from any agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
This article declares and defines AI-Based Jurimetrics-a field that treats the disciplined collaboration between a human legal reasoner and artificial intelligence as both its object of study and its distinct practice. Rooted in the jurimetric tradition, the field differs in one fundamental respect: it does not treat artificial intelligence merely as a tool, but formulates the standards that render human-machine collaboration methodologically and ethically accountable. Four principles form its foundation: the non-negotiable verification of every cited norm against its primary source; sole substantive authority residing in the human, with artificial intelligence as instrument and not co-author; the open inventory of techniques born from the collaboration so that they may be tested and adopted; and disciplined continuity through a mechanism that makes those commitments keepable across time. The article sets out the field's framework of identity, its conceptual axes, and its operational principles, then affirms that the field is general across AI architectures and independent of any single model or vendor. As a marker, it invites other researchers to test, criticize, and develop it.
The Indonesian-language version is available on Zenodo: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20726213

AI.tldr: 本文定义并提出了"基于AI的法计量学"这一新领域，将人类法律推理者与人工智能之间的纪律性协作作为研究对象和实践方式，并确立了四项基本原则来确保人机协作在方法论和伦理上的可问责性。
AI.research_question: 如何定义并构建一个将人类法律推理者与人工智能之间的纪律性协作作为研究对象和独特实践的新领域——基于AI的法计量学？
AI.motivation: 传统法计量学将AI仅视为工具，缺乏对人机协作的方法论和伦理标准。随着AI在法律领域的广泛应用，需要建立一套系统的框架来规范人机协作，确保其方法论严谨性和伦理可问责性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI的法计量学，根植于法计量学传统，但核心差异在于不仅将AI视为工具，而是制定人机协作的方法论和伦理标准。四项基本原则：规范原文核验、人类实质权威、技术开放清单、纪律连续性机制。
AI.method: 概念性理论建构：提出领域定义、身份框架、概念轴和操作原则，并声明该领域独立于具体的AI架构、模型或供应商。
AI.findings: 建立了基于AI的法计量学的四大支柱原则：(1) 引用的每项规范必须与原始来源进行不可协商的核验；(2) 实质性权威仅属于人类，AI是工具而非合著者；(3) 协作产生的技术保持开放清单，供测试和采纳；(4) 通过机制实现纪律的连续性，使上述承诺可长期维持。该领域具有跨AI架构的通用性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次正式定义"基于AI的法计量学"这一新领域，将其从传统工具论视角提升为独立的学科范式，为人机协作在法律推理中提供了方法论基础和伦理框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法律实务中使用AI提供了可操作的规范性指导：规范必须溯源核实、人类保持最终权威、技术方法保持透明可检验、承诺机制具有可持续性，并邀请学术界测试和批判发展该框架。

title: Corporate Digital Transformation and Environmental Performance: Evidence from the People’s Republic of China
affiliations: Fudan University, Fudan University and Asian Development Bank

detail.title: Corporate Digital Transformation and Environmental Performance: Evidence from the People’s Republic of China

publicationDetails.detailsText: ADB Economics Working Paper Series No. 853
publicationDetails.journalName: ADB Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of corporate digital transformation on environmental performance and the underlying mechanisms. Utilizing textual analysis of annual reports, we develop a fourdimensional measure of digital transformation comprising technological, business, manufacturing, and operational aspects. Analyzing data from Chinese A-share listed firms between 2009 and 2022, we demonstrate that corporate digital transformation significantly enhances environmental performance. While all dimensions of digital transformation contribute positively, manufacturing digital transformation exhibits the most substantial impact, followed by operational and technological digital transformation. We identify that green innovation, strengthened environmental monitoring and communication, increased environmental information transparency, and greater external attention are pivotal mechanisms through which digital transformation affects environmental performance, with transparency emerging as the strongest factor in this context. This paper offers new insights into the role of digital transformation in advancing sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业数字化转型对环境绩效的影响，发现数字化转型显著提升环境绩效，其中制造数字化转型影响最大，环境信息透明度是最强的作用机制。
AI.research_question: 企业数字化转型如何影响环境绩效？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 在数字经济和绿色发展双重背景下，数字化转型能否以及如何促进企业环境绩效提升尚缺乏系统性的实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字化转型理论、绿色创新理论、信息透明度理论、利益相关者理论
AI.method: 基于2009-2022年中国A股上市公司数据，运用年报文本分析构建数字化转型四维指标（技术、业务、制造、运营），采用实证分析方法检验影响及机制。
AI.findings: 数字化转型显著提升企业环境绩效；四维中制造数字化转型影响最大，其次为运营和技术数字化转型；绿色创新、环境监控与沟通、信息透明度、外部关注是中介机制，其中透明度作用最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从多维视角系统揭示数字化转型对环境绩效的影响机制，发现环境信息透明度是最关键的中介路径，拓展了数字化与可持续发展的理论交叉研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供数字化转型提升环境绩效的具体着力点（优先关注制造数字化），为政策制定者推动数字技术与绿色发展的深度融合提供实证依据。

reference: Melbourne Institute Working Paper No. sp2026n10
title: Intergenerational Inequality at Labour-Market Entry: Pre-Adult Hardship, Family Buffers, and Early-Career Risk
affiliations: and University of Melbourne

detail.title: Intergenerational Inequality at Labour-Market Entry: Pre-Adult Hardship, Family Buffers, and Early-Career Risk

publicationDetails.detailsText: Melbourne Institute Working Paper No. sp2026n10
publicationDetails.journalName: Melbourne Institute of Applied Economic and Social Research Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper examines how intergenerational inequality is expressed at labour-market entry by linking pre-adult economic hardship to early-career trajectories of labour-market risk and precarious employment. Using longitudinal data from the HILDA Survey, we model hardship dynamically over ages 4-24 and relate pre-adult trajectories to labour-market risk and precarious-employment pathways over ages 25-30. The results reveal substantial heterogeneity in both family disadvantage and early-adult labour-market experiences, showing that static measures of family background and adult outcomes miss important dimensions of inequality. Persistent hardship is strongly associated with persistently adverse early-career trajectories, while moving out of hardship, volatile hardship, and no hardship are linked to substantially lower probabilities of sustained disadvantage. Family resources partially moderate these associations, but the effects vary by resource type. Short-term insurance provides the clearest buffering role, reducing the likelihood of persistent and worsening disadvantage. Overall, the findings suggest that unequal family resources shape unequal capacity to absorb labour-market risk at the transition to adulthood, with family buffers operating primarily as private insurance against sustained disadvantage rather than as a mechanism supporting strategic tolerance of precarious work.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用HILDA纵向数据，发现童年至青年时期（4-24岁）的持续经济困难与成年早期（25-30岁）的劳动市场风险及不稳定就业轨迹密切相关，而家庭资源中的短期保险能缓冲持续劣势，但无法支持战略性承担不稳定性工作。
AI.research_question: 代际不平等如何在劳动市场进入阶段体现？童年至青年时期的经济困难如何影响成年早期职业生涯中的劳动市场风险和不稳定就业轨迹？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多使用静态指标衡量家庭背景和成年结果，忽略了不利处境和不稳定就业的动态性与异质性，无法全面揭示代际不平等的传递机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际不平等传递理论、劳动市场风险与不稳定就业理论、家庭资源缓冲假说
AI.method: 使用HILDA纵向追踪数据，对4-24岁期间的经济困难进行动态建模，将其与25-30岁期间的劳动市场风险和不稳定就业路径相关联，分析不同困难轨迹类型（持续困难、脱离困难、波动困难、无困难）的差异效应，并检验家庭资源的调节作用。
AI.findings: 1. 持续的经济困难与持续不利的职业生涯轨迹强相关；2. 脱离困难、波动困难和无困难与持续劣势的概率显著降低相关；3. 家庭资源部分调节这些关联，但效果因资源类型而异；4. 短期保险的缓冲作用最明显，能降低持续和恶化的劣势可能性；5. 家庭缓冲主要作为抵御持续劣势的私人保险，而非支持战略性接受不稳定工作的机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了代际不平等传递的动态性，证明了静态测量会遗漏不平等的重要维度；区分了家庭资源的不同类型（特别是短期保险）在缓冲劳动市场风险中的差异化作用；纠正了家庭缓冲机制的功能定位——主要是防御性保险而非策略性风险承受。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关注点：应针对持续贫困家庭子女提供早期干预和劳动市场支持；提示短期社会保障（如失业保险、临时救助）对于缓解代际不利传递的重要性；为完善青年就业支持体系和家庭福利政策提供了实证依据。

reference: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-48
title: A Heterogeneous-Quantile Global VAR for Tail-Risk Transmission
affiliations: University of Piraeus, Swiss Finance Institute - University of Geneva, Athens University of Economics and Business and National Technical University of Athens (NTUA)

detail.title: A Heterogeneous-Quantile Global VAR for Tail-Risk Transmission

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-48
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We develop a Heterogeneous-Quantile Global VAR (HQGVAR) that allows each country-variable pair to enter the global system at its own quantile level. We provide a global admissibility result showing that we can assemble row-specific quantile equations into a stable reduced-form system with a valid moving-average representation and generalized impulse responses. The framework preserves the main structure of the GVAR but extends it to distributionally heterogeneous macro-financial environments. We establish large-sample theory for estimation and inference, justify moving-block bootstrap procedures, and show that the common-quantile QGVAR is a nested special case. Monte Carlo evidence demonstrates that heterogeneous-quantile modeling is valuable in the presence of heavy-tailed shocks, state-dependent spillovers, and asynchronous country-specific stress. In an application to a 13-economy macro-financial system, we do not reject system-wide equality with the median benchmark, but we detect localized, benchmark-referenced differences in financially and monetarily relevant transmission channels. Additional convergence, robustness, and forecast-validation diagnostics support the empirical implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种异质性分位数全局向量自回归（HQGVAR）模型，允许每个国家-变量对以其自身分位数水平进入全球系统，并提供了相应的理论证明、估计方法、蒙特卡洛证据以及宏观金融系统应用。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个允许各国变量在不同分位数水平下进入全局系统的宏观金融模型，以捕捉分布异质性？
AI.motivation: 传统GVAR假设所有变量在同一条件均值下运行，无法刻画重尾冲击、状态依赖的溢出效应以及不同国家压力期的异步性等分布异质性现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性分位数全局向量自回归（HQGVAR）模型，将分位数回归与GVAR框架相结合，提供全局可接受性条件、移动平均表示及广义脉冲响应。
AI.method: 提出HQGVAR模型，建立大样本理论，采用移动块自助法（moving-block bootstrap）进行推断，并通过蒙特卡洛模拟和13个经济体的宏观金融系统应用进行验证。
AI.findings: 系统层面未拒绝与中位数基准的齐性假设，但在金融和货币传导渠道中检测到局部的、基准可参照的差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将分位数异质性引入GVAR框架，证明了行特定分位数方程可组装为稳定的简化形式系统，并给出了大样本理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观金融建模提供了更灵活的分布异质性分析工具，有助于识别不同经济状态下（如危机期与正常期）的差异化传导机制。

title: Indexification: Re-Wired Markets: Why the Old Rules Have Not Applied Lately
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Indexification: Re-Wired Markets: Why the Old Rules Have Not Applied Lately

declarations.ethicsApproval: no human subjects
declarations.funderStatement: Funded by author, no outside sources

detail.abstract: This paper introduces indexification-a term that describes the structural transformation of equity markets caused by three decades of growth in price-insensitive passive investing. Drawing on the framework of complex adaptive systems (Brennan), the inelastic markets hypothesis (Gabaix and Koijen, 2021), and empirical evidence from momentum factor data, we argue that indexification has rewired the feedback architecture of markets in ways that systematically penalized strategies that previously generated alpha: value investing, mean reversion, high Active Share, and genuine diversification. If diversification is the only free lunch in investing, the free lunch counter closed around 2009. Markowitz's mathematically proven diversification benefit became expensive in practice when the structural bid flowed relentlessly into the index and only the index-though the counter may someday open under new management. The 2022 simultaneous collapse of stocks and bonds-worst since 1937-was a regime signal, not an anomaly. Two canaries in the coal mine-the post-2009 sign flip in Active Share and the deterioration of selling skill as measured by S4 (the Selling Skill Score, a framework measuring whether active managers' exit decisions add or destroy value relative to a hold)-provide observable evidence that indexification has been reshaping return dynamics since approximately 2009. We discuss the conditions under which indexification may short circuit, and what portfolio insulation-genuine asset class diversification-looks like when it does.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"指数化"（indexification）概念，描述了过去三十年价格不敏感被动投资增长导致的股市结构性转型。基于复杂适应系统、非弹性市场假说和动量因子实证证据，论证指数化重新连接了市场反馈架构，系统性惩罚了价值投资、均值回归、高主动份额和真正分散化等曾产生超额收益的策略。真正的分散化收益在2009年左右已消失，2022年股债双杀是制度信号而非异常。两个"金丝雀"指标——主动份额符号翻转和卖出技能（S4）恶化——提供了2009年以来指数化重塑回报动态的实证证据。
AI.research_question: 指数化（被动投资增长）如何改变了股票市场的结构，以及这种变化对传统主动投资策略（价值投资、分散化等）产生了怎样的影响？
AI.motivation: 被动投资在过去三十年大幅增长，但其对市场结构性影响的研究尚不充分。作者希望揭示这种价格不敏感的资金流入如何从根本上改变了市场的反馈机制，以及为什么曾经有效的策略不再有效。
AI.theoretical_framework: 复杂适应系统（Brennan）、非弹性市场假说（Gabaix & Koijen, 2021）、动量因子实证证据、Markowitz投资组合理论、主动份额（Active Share）框架、S4卖出技能评分框架。
AI.method: 理论论证结合实证证据。使用主动份额（Active Share）的符号翻转和S4（卖出技能评分）作为两个可观测的实证指标，辅以动量因子数据和2022年股债双杀的历史比较。
AI.findings: 1）指数化改变了市场反馈架构，系统性惩罚了价值投资、均值回归、高主动份额和真正分散化策略；2）Markowitz数学证明的分散化收益在2009年左右变得昂贵；3）2022年股债双杀是制度信号而非异常；4）主动份额在2009年后符号翻转；5）基金经理的卖出技能（S4）自2009年以来持续恶化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"指数化"（indexification）这一新概念来描述被动投资导致的市场结构性转型；将复杂适应系统和非弹性市场假说整合到被动投资的市场影响分析中；识别了2009年作为市场结构性转变的关键时间点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为主动管理投资者提供了指数化如何破坏传统策略的实证框架；引入S4卖出技能评分作为评估基金经理能力的工具；讨论了指数化可能短路（失效）的条件，以及在此情况下真正的资产类别分散化如何提供投资组合保护。

title: Evaluating AI Investment Strategies

detail.title: Evaluating AI Investment Strategies
detail.abstract: We study the problem of auditing a black-box algorithmic decision-maker from observable inputs and outputs alone. Our main result is an exact decomposition: under precisely characterized conditions, the cumulative regret of a dynamic policy equals the sum of per-period covariances between the cost vector and the policy's decision. This extends the single-period identity of Aldridge (2026) to the full multi-period setting of stochastic dynamic programming. We prove the identity holds exactly under i.i.d. costs and mean-unbiased Markov policies, derive closed-form bias corrections for non-stationary and time-varying cases, and establish the discounted-horizon analog. A Bellman recursion for the covariance regret functional connects the result to standard reinforcement learning algorithms; for rolling-window policies, the estimation-error bias is O(d/w). The decomposition has direct implications for algorithmic auditing in strategic environments: in platform mechanism design, it provides a welfare-based audit metric without access to the agent's private type; in repeated games, covariance reduction is a sufficient condition for policy improvement; in procurement and ad auctions, the bias correction quantifies welfare loss from strategic misreporting. The associated trajectory estimator is consistent, asymptotically normal with HAC variance, and computable in O(T • nd) time. This makes the proposed approach a tractable, model-free audit tool for platform mechanisms, algorithmic portfolio strategies, and any sequential decision system subject to external performance review.

AI.tldr: 本文证明在特定条件下，动态策略的累积遗憾可以精确分解为每期成本向量与策略决策之间协方差的和，并据此提出一套可用于审计黑箱算法决策者的可计算、无模型审计工具。
AI.research_question: 如何仅从可观测的输入和输出来审计黑箱算法决策者的表现？
AI.motivation: 现实中的算法决策系统（如平台机制、广告拍卖、采购流程）往往是黑箱，外部审计者无法获取内部模型参数或代理人的私有信息，需要一种仅依赖可观测数据的审计方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 遗憾分解恒等式（将单期Aldridge恒等式扩展到多期动态规划）；协方差遗憾泛函的Bellman递归；马尔可夫策略下的均无偏性假设。
AI.method: 理论推导：建立多期静态遗憾分解恒等式，推导偏差修正的闭式解，建立折现情形的类似结果；统计分析：提出轨迹估计量，证明其一致性和渐近正态性，并给出HAC方差估计；复杂度分析：O(T·nd)时间复杂度。
AI.findings: i.i.d.成本和均无偏马尔可夫策略下恒等式精确成立；非平稳和时变情形下有闭式偏差修正；滚动窗口策略下估计误差偏差为O(d/w)；轨迹估计量一致、渐近正态且计算高效。
AI.theory_contributions: 将单期审计恒等式推广到多期动态规划框架；建立协方差遗憾泛函与Bellman方程的联系；刻画了遗憾分解的精确条件和非精确情形下的偏差结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种无需访问代理私有类型的福利审计指标；协方差减少作为策略改进的充分条件；通过偏差修正量化策略虚报导致的福利损失；提供O(T·nd)可计算的模型外审计工具，适用于平台机制、算法交易、序列决策系统的绩效审查。

title:
The Big Mac Theorem: 
Exact Conservation Laws for Geometric Market Control
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title:
The Big Mac Theorem: 
Exact Conservation Laws for Geometric Market Control
detail.abstract:
We prove that for any signal derived from single-asset price features, the stan-
dard alpha metric—correlation with future returns—measures geometric cancella-
tion rather than predictive signal strength. We establish four results: (1) OLS-
estimated response gradients are structurally orthogonal to market movement di-
rections, with α⊥/α = 21.5× across 48 assets (p < 10−10); (2) traditional alpha falls
below 0.06 on average (p < 10−22); (3) position-return correlation exceeds signal-
return correlation by 7× (p < 10−12); and (4) the interaction kernel K = κf α ad-
mits an exact midpoint conservation law (Big Mac Theorem), verified to machine
epsilon. These results hold across equity, fixed income, commodity, and alternative
asset classes without per-asset tuning. In bear markets, the control-based strategy
achieves Sharpe +0.56 versus +0.35 for buy-and-hold (p = 0.013). We argue that
“alpha” in the traditional sense is a misdefined quantity, and propose that cur-
vature management—not direction prediction—is the correct framework for active
strategy evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文证明基于单资产价格特征的信号，其标准alpha指标度量的是几何抵消而非预测信号强度。作者提出传统"alpha"是错误定义的量，应改用曲率管理（而非方向预测）作为主动策略评估的正确框架。
AI.research_question: 传统alpha指标是否真正度量了预测信号强度？如果不是，它实际度量了什么？
AI.motivation: 传统alpha被广泛用于衡量策略表现，但作者发现其实际反映的是几何抵消（geometric cancellation）而非预测能力，这从根本上挑战了金融学术和实务中关于alpha的认知基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 几何抵消理论、OLS估计量的结构正交性、交互核与中点守恒律（Big Mac Theorem）
AI.method: 跨48个资产（股票、固收、大宗商品、另类资产）的实证分析，采用OLS回归、相关性分析、交互核分解及中点守恒律验证。
AI.findings: (1) OLS估计的响应梯度与市场运动方向结构正交，α⊥/α = 21.5× (p<10⁻¹⁰)；(2) 传统alpha平均低于0.06 (p<10⁻²²)；(3) 持仓-回报相关性比信号-回报相关性大7倍 (p<10⁻¹²)；(4) 交互核K=κfα满足精确的中点守恒律（Big Mac Theorem），在机器精度内验证。熊市中，控制策略Sharpe为+0.56，优于买入持有策略的+0.35 (p=0.013)。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"alpha是错误定义量"的根本性批判，建立了曲率管理（curvature management）作为替代框架，发现了交互核的中点守恒律（Big Mac Theorem）。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了传统alpha在策略评估中的误导性，提出了基于曲率管理的策略评估新方法，在熊市中验证了控制策略的优越性。

reference: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-50
title: Climate Targets and Sectoral Risk Premia
affiliations: University of Lausanne - Faculty of Business and Economics (HEC Lausanne)

detail.title: Climate Targets and Sectoral Risk Premia

publicationDetails.detailsText: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 26-50
publicationDetails.journalName: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper develops a stochastic multi-sector climate-economy model to study how temperature targets, endogenous carbon pricing, and long-run macroeconomic risk shape sectoral asset prices. The model combines a reduced-form integrated assessment block with Epstein-Zin asset pricing. Sectors differ in productivity, carbon intensity, abatement costs, pass-through, and exposure to physical damages. For each temperature target, the policymaker commits to a target-consistent emissions path, and the carbon tax is determined endogenously, date by date and state by state, to implement it. The analysis delivers three main insights. First, stringent temperature targets are dominated by transition costs, whereas looser targets imply weaker transition pressure but larger long-run physical damages. Second, carbon intensity alone does not determine expected returns: endogenous carbon pricing can make brown sectors partly hedge-like, while stringent targets can generate substantial downside risk for high emitters. Third, once transition-cost and damage-exposure shifters are stochastic, the model generates both low-and highpremium brown-sector outcomes. The sign of the brown premium depends on the cyclicality of transition costs, pass-through, and the stochastic discount factor. The framework therefore connects climate targets to the cross section of sectoral risk premia in a tractable, scenario-consistent way.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个随机多部门气候-经济模型，研究温度目标、内生碳定价和长期宏观经济风险如何影响部门资产价格，发现碳强度并非预期收益的唯一决定因素，棕色溢价的方向取决于转型成本、传导率和随机贴现因子的周期性特征。
AI.research_question: 温度目标、内生碳定价和长期宏观经济风险如何塑造部门层面的资产价格？
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏一个将气候政策目标、内生碳定价与跨部门资产定价连接起来的统一框架，特别是对棕色溢价（brown premium）方向和大小决定因素的理解尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机多部门气候-经济模型，结合简化综合评估模型（IAM）与Epstein-Zin递归效用资产定价框架。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值模拟。模型包含异质性部门（生产率、碳强度、减排成本、传导率、物理损害暴露度不同），政府承诺实现温度目标，碳税内生逐期逐状态确定。
AI.findings: 1）严格温度目标以转型成本为主导，宽松目标转型压力小但长期物理损害大；2）碳强度不单独决定预期收益，内生碳定价可使高排放部门产生部分对冲属性；3）当转型成本和损害暴露冲击随机时，模型可生成低溢价和高溢价两种棕色部门结果，棕色溢价符号取决于转型成本、传导率和随机贴现因子的周期性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将温度目标、内生碳定价与Epstein-Zin资产定价系统整合，揭示了碳强度与预期收益之间非线性关系的机制基础，为气候政策与资产定价的交叉领域提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解不同气候情景下的部门风险溢价变化提供分析工具；为政策制定者评估不同温度目标对金融市场和行业风险的分配效应提供参考；表明仅关注碳强度可能误导投资决策，需综合考虑转型成本周期性和传导率等因素。

reference: KIEP Research Paper, 연구자료(PR), 25-05
title: 중국과 GCC의 에너지 협력 현황 및 시사점(The Changing Landscape of China-GCC Energy Cooperation and Its Policy Implications)
affiliations: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy and Korea Institute for International Economic Policy

detail.title: 중국과 GCC의 에너지 협력 현황 및 시사점(The Changing Landscape of China-GCC Energy Cooperation and Its Policy Implications)

publicationDetails.journalName: Korea Institute for International Economic Policy (KIEP) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Global security conditions have become more uncertain than ever in recent years. In particular, the energy sector is experiencing rapid structural changes and a swift geopolitical realignment, while multiple factors—including the intensification of strategic competition between the United States and China, the prolonged Russia–Ukraine war, accelerated climate-change responses and energy transitions, and the launch of the second Trump administration in the United States—are intertwining to further deepen the instability of the international political order and the global energy market. Amid such a rapidly changing international environment, energy security is emerging as a core issue that combines national security, diplomatic strategy, and energy geopolitics. Against this backdrop, this study focuses on the strengthening cooperation between the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC), regarded as a key region for global energy supply, and China, the world’s largest energy importer. China is actively promoting the development of its renewable energy industry and related technologies to mitigate its high dependence on external energy sources and to accelerate the transition toward a low-carbon society. The GCC, leveraging its immense fossil-fuel supply capacity, is simultaneously pursuing industrial diversification and energy transition, and in doing so is expanding its demand for external cooperation in the field of environmentally friendly energy. Accordingly, the two sides are forming a mutually complementary cooperative relationship in the areas of fossil energy and clean energy, rapidly deepening the scope and level of their cooperation. (The rest omitted.)

AI.tldr: 本文探讨在当今全球安全不确定性加剧的背景下，海湾合作委员会（GCC）与中国在全球能源格局中的合作，尤其是在化石能源与清洁能源领域形成的互补性合作关系。
AI.research_question: 在全球地缘政治动荡与能源转型叠加的背景下，海湾合作委员会（GCC）与中国在能源领域（化石能源与清洁能源）的合作如何形成互补关系，以及这种合作的动因、现状与深化趋势是什么？
AI.motivation: 近年来全球安全条件持续恶化，国际政治秩序与能源市场深度不稳定。美中战略竞争加剧、俄乌战争持续、气候应对与能源转型加速、特朗普再次上任等多重因素交织，使能源安全成为国家安全与外交战略的核心议题。因此，理解主要能源供应方（GCC）与最大能源进口方（中国）之间的合作具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源地缘政治、能源安全理论、国际政治经济中的互补性合作理论、低碳转型与能源战略调整理论。
AI.method: 基于文献分析与案例研究的定性方法，结合当前地缘政治与能源市场数据，对GCC-中国能源合作进行结构性分析。
AI.findings: GCC与中国正在形成化石能源与清洁能源领域的互补性合作：中国依赖GCC的化石能源供应，同时通过可再生能源技术与产业发展降低对外依赖；GCC在保持化石能源供应的同时，推进工业多元化与能源转型，扩大对环保能源领域的外部合作需求。双方合作范围与深度正在迅速扩展。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了能源地缘政治在"大国竞争+能源转型"双重背景下的理论探讨，揭示了新兴的"传统能源供应商—清洁能源技术需求方"之间的互补合作模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解GCC-中国能源合作的战略逻辑提供分析框架；对能源安全战略、低碳转型国际合作、以及应对全球能源市场不确定性具有参考价值。

reference: FEEM Working Paper No. 19-2026
title: Distinguishing Drought Experiences: From Perception to Measurement and their Significance on Productivity Value in Uganda
affiliations: , University of Foggia and

detail.title: Distinguishing Drought Experiences: From Perception to Measurement and their Significance on Productivity Value in Uganda

publicationDetails.journalName: FEEM Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Weather shocks increasingly threaten agricultural productivity in Sub-Saharan Africa. While the negative effects of drought on production have been documented in numerous studies, the behavioral dimension of adaptation, particularly how households perceive drought and what shapes these perceptions, remains less explored. The study focuses on Uganda to distinguish between selfreported drought (subjective) and data-driven drought (objective) and how their divergence is associated with agricultural outcomes. The study relies on four waves of household surveys (UNPS for 2009/10, 2010/11, 2011/12, and 2013/14) with historical re-analysis data on temperature and precipitation from 1981 to 2015. Log-linear and logit models are applied to estimate the association between drought, perception, and household characteristics on production and drought perception formation. Objective drought is negatively associated with total value of production. Subjective drought perception has a positive association with production. Self-reported drought captures differences in households' behavioral responses or preparedness, rather than observed weather shocks. Households that underestimate drought conditions tend to exhibit lower production outcomes, while households reporting a drought when this is not observed in objective data tend to maintain their production levels. Access to the Drought Early Warning System (DEWS), technology adoption, higher education levels, farming experience, and greater off-farm assets are positively associated with higher production. Conversely, lower production is associated with a higher share of female labor, female-headed households, and poverty. The results highlight the importance of distinguishing between perceived and observed drought and improving households' access to timely information to plan adaptation strategies.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用乌干达四轮家庭调查面板数据，区分主观与客观干旱感知，发现客观干旱会降低农业产值，而主观感知反而与产值正相关——反映出农户的应对行为差异。感知偏差（低估干旱）导致产出下降，而预警系统、技术采纳和高教育水平有助于提高产出。
AI.research_question: 在撒哈拉以南非洲地区，家庭如何感知干旱（主观感知）与客观气象数据定义的干旱之间存在怎样的差异？这种差异如何与农业生产结果相关联？
AI.motivation: 已有大量文献记录了干旱对农业生产的负面影响，但农户如何感知干旱、什么因素塑造这种感知（行为适应维度）仍较少被探索，理解感知偏差对农业产出的影响对于制定有效的适应策略至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 干旱感知形成机制（主观感知与客观数据对比）、农户行为适应理论、信息获取与农业生产决策理论
AI.method: 使用乌干达全国面板调查（UNPS）2009/10、2010/11、2011/12、2013/14四轮数据，结合1981-2015年历史再分析气温与降水数据；采用对数线性模型（Log-linear）和Logit模型估计干旱、感知及家庭特征对生产和感知形成的影响。
AI.findings: 客观干旱与总产值负相关；主观干旱感知与产值正相关（反映行为响应或准备程度而非实际冲击）；低估干旱的家庭产出更低，而报告干旱但客观数据未显示干旱的家庭维持了产出水平；DEWS预警系统、技术采纳、高教育水平、务农经验、非农资产与高产正相关；女性劳动占比高、女性户主家庭、贫困与低产相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了主观感知干旱与客观测量干旱在农业产出中的不同作用机制，揭示了感知偏差（低估/高估）对生产结果的差异化影响，拓展了干旱适应行为理论在发展中国家背景下的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调了区分主观感知与客观干旱对政策制定的重要意义，指出改善农户获取及时气象信息（如DEWS预警系统）的能力是提升农业适应策略有效性的关键路径。
