Drawing on cognitive science research on skill acquisition, legal writing pedagogy, professional ethics, and empirical studies of AI's impact on legal tasks, this Article examines the mechanisms by which AI over-reliance produces borrowed competence in place of genuine expertise and provides targeted guidance for the three audiences most at risk: law students, young attorneys, and supervising attorneys responsible for their development.

The argument is not that AI is inherently harmful. However, AI shortcuts that replace intellectual exertion, struggle, feedback, and revision undermine lasting competence. Thus, while lawyers may use AI proficiently, those who are methodologically ill-equipped may lack critical professional development, meaning that they will be unable to practice law competently without AI. When those high-stakes moments arrive, including the bar examination, the courtroom, and the client emergency, the Competence Illusion fails, and the consequences fall on the lawyer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"能力幻觉"概念，指出法律学生和年轻律师过度依赖生成式AI会削弱底层分析技能的培养，导致表面能力与实际能力之间的危险差距。
AI.research_question: 过度依赖生成式AI如何影响法律从业者的技能发展？这种依赖是否会造成表面能力与实际能力之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI在法律领域快速普及，但其对法律从业者（尤其是新手）核心技能发展的潜在负面影响尚未被充分认识。作者试图揭示这一隐藏成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知科学的技能获取理论、法律写作教学法、职业伦理规范，以及AI对法律任务影响的实证研究。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，整合认知科学、法律教育、职业伦理和AI实证研究等多学科文献。
AI.findings: AI替代智力付出、挣扎、反馈和修订过程，会削弱持久能力的发展；过度依赖AI导致"借用能力"而非真正专长；在没有AI的情况下，这些从业者将无法胜任法律工作。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"能力幻觉"（Competence Illusion）这一新概念，系统阐释AI依赖如何造成表面与实际能力之间的差距，丰富了技能获取和AI对人类能力影响的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为三类高风险群体（法律学生、年轻律师、监督律师）提供针对性指导；警示律师资格考试、法庭辩论、客户紧急情况等高风险场景下"能力幻觉"的后果。

reference: FEDS Working Paper No. 2026-43
title: Local Labor Market Tightness and Job Quality: Evidence from Job Changers
affiliations: W.E. Upjohn Institute for Employment Research, U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) - Economic Research Service (ERS), Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Local Labor Market Tightness and Job Quality: Evidence from Job Changers

keywords: Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking (SHED)
Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS)

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Using novel data from the Survey of Household Economics and Decisionmaking, we examine how labor market tightness affects workers’ job quality. We estimate that a 10 percent increase in job vacancies not only increases the probability of changing jobs, it yields an 11–18 percent increase in the (unconditional) probability of switching to a better job overall, and one with greater pay and benefits, interest in the work, and advancement opportunities. Because tight labor markets improve both worker pay and job amenities in roughly the same proportion, their benefits to workers are underestimated when based on pay alone.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美联储家庭经济与决策调查的新数据，研究发现劳动力市场紧俏程度每提升10%（以职位空缺衡量），不仅会提高工人换工作的概率，还会使其换到更好工作的概率提升11-18%，更好工作体现在薪酬福利、工作兴趣和晋升机会等多维度。由于紧俏市场同时改善薪酬和工作 amenities，仅用薪酬衡量会低估其福利效应。
AI.research_question: 劳动力市场紧俏程度如何影响工人的工作质量（包括薪酬福利、工作兴趣、晋升机会等多维度）？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注劳动力市场紧俏对工资的影响，但忽视了工作质量的其他重要维度（如工作兴趣、晋升机会等），导致可能低估紧俏市场对工人的整体福利效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力市场匹配理论、工作搜寻理论、补偿性工资差异理论
AI.method: 利用美联储调查（SHED）数据，以职位空缺率衡量劳动力市场紧俏程度，估计其对工人换工作概率及工作质量提升概率的影响。
AI.findings: 职位空缺每增加10%，工人换工作概率上升；换到更好工作的无条件概率提升11-18%；薪酬改善和非薪酬维度（工作兴趣、晋升机会）的改善幅度大致相同，仅用薪酬衡量会低估整体福利。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了劳动力市场紧俏对工人福利影响的分析框架，从单一薪酬维度扩展到多维度工作质量；为补偿性工资差异理论提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估劳动力市场政策（如刺激就业、调节市场热度）提供了更全面的福利分析视角，提示不应仅关注工资变化。

title: Ten Things Law Students Can Do to Become Effective Lawyers

detail.title: Ten Things Law Students Can Do to Become Effective Lawyers

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-48
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Law school provides valuable training in legal analysis, research, and writing, but it often gives students only limited exposure to important aspects of legal practice.  This article offers practical advice to law students about how to make the most of their legal education and prepare themselves for effective practice.

The article identifies ten things that law students can do to develop knowledge, skills, relationships, and professional judgment that may not receive sufficient attention in traditional law school courses.  These include understanding the realities of legal practice, taking responsibility for one's own education, developing an ethical and satisfying professional identity, communicating effectively, thinking strategically about cases and clients, focusing on client decision-making, learning to represent clients in mediation, using artificial intelligence responsibly, and maintaining personal well-being. The article also includes links to short readings that provide additional guidance.

The article emphasizes that students should not assume that merely completing the formal curriculum automatically prepares them for practice.  By actively shaping their own education and seeking experiences beyond the classroom, students can enter practice with greater confidence, competence, and satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 本文为法学院学生提供了十项实用建议，帮助他们弥补传统法学教育在实践技能培养方面的不足，通过自主学习、积累实践经验和关注个人福祉等方式，为高效、满意的法律执业做好准备。
AI.research_question: 法学院学生如何弥补传统法学教育在实践技能方面的不足，从而更有效地为法律执业做好准备？
AI.motivation: 传统法学院课程在法律分析、研究和写作方面提供了有价值的训练，但对法律实践的重要方面（如客户决策、调解、人工智能应用、个人福祉等）关注不足，学生需要主动塑造自身教育以迎接执业挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体验式学习理论、职业身份发展理论、客户中心决策理论
AI.method: 基于经验的归纳性建议文章，结合实务洞察与文献指引（附推荐阅读链接）
AI.findings: 提出了十项关键行动：理解执业现实、对自身教育负责、培养伦理且满意的职业身份、有效沟通、战略性思考案件与客户、关注客户决策、学习调解代理、负责任地使用AI、维护个人福祉。研究表明仅完成正式课程不足以自动为执业做好准备。
AI.theory_contributions: 将职业身份发展、客户中心决策等理论融入法学教育实践建议，拓展了体验式学习在法律教育中的应用视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法学院学生提供了可操作的具体行动清单，帮助其在课堂之外主动构建执业能力，提升进入实践时的自信、胜任力和职业满意度。

reference: FEDS Working Paper No. 2026-44
title: The Response of Equity Yields to a Long-Run Shock
affiliations: , Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, University of Iowa - Department of Finance and University of Notre Dame - Mendoza College of Business

detail.title: The Response of Equity Yields to a Long-Run Shock

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We study how macroeconomic developments affect asset prices by analyzing the response of equity yields to a well-identified long-run growth shock. Using synthetic equity yield data from Giglio et al. (2024), we show that a positive long-run shock steepens the equity yield curve by increasing expected dividend growth while leaving discount rates largely unchanged. We examine how the investment driving this growth is financed and how yields respond across value and growth firms. Growth-firm yields respond more strongly than value-firm yields, reflecting larger changes in expected dividend growth. Ai et al. (2018)'s model, modified to separate cash dividends from total payout, best matches these responses relative to benchmark equity term structure models.

AI.tldr: 本文利用合成股票收益率数据，研究长期增长冲击如何影响股票收益率曲线，发现正向冲击通过提高预期股息增长而非改变贴现率来陡化收益率曲线，增长型公司反应强于价值型公司，修正后的Ai et al. (2018)模型最能匹配这些特征。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济长期增长冲击如何影响股票收益率曲线，以及这种影响在不同类型公司（价值型vs增长型）之间有何差异？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对宏观经济与资产价格关系的研究往往面临识别问题，难以区分长期增长冲击与短期波动的影响；同时，股票收益率曲线的期限结构特征尚未被充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Ai et al. (2018)的模型，将其修正以分离现金股息与总支付（如股票回购），并与基准股票期限结构模型进行对比。
AI.method: 使用Giglio et al. (2024)的合成股票收益率数据，通过识别长期增长冲击，分析股权收益率对冲击的响应；比较价值型与增长型公司的异质性反应；将实证结果与多个理论模型进行匹配检验。
AI.findings: (1)正向长期增长冲击陡化股票收益率曲线；(2)该效应主要通过提高预期股息增长驱动，而非改变贴现率；(3)增长型公司收益率响应强于价值型公司；(4)修正后的Ai et al. (2018)模型最能匹配实证结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 为长期增长冲击影响资产价格的传导机制提供了新证据，特别是区分了现金流渠道（预期股息增长）与贴现率渠道的相对重要性；通过分离现金股息与总支付修正了理论模型，提高了模型的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者理解宏观经济长期增长前景对不同类型股票（价值/增长）的差异化影响提供了实证依据；有助于资产配置和风险管理中更好地预测股票收益率曲线的变动。

reference: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-49
title: Using AI to Help Resolve Disputes: A Practical Introduction
affiliations: University of Missouri School of Law

detail.title: Using AI to Help Resolve Disputes: A Practical Introduction

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-49
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This illustrated guide provides a brief, practical introduction to the appropriate use of AI in dispute resolution.  It encourages parties to use AI to help them think more clearly rather than to rely on AI to predict outcomes or make decisions.  The guide explains common mistakes people make when using AI, discusses confidentiality and privacy risks, and offers practical suggestions for evaluating AI-generated information.

The guide uses plain language, visual design, and principles of universal design to make these ideas accessible to broad audiences, including self-represented parties and people with varying levels of legal knowledge and literacy.  The illustrations are intended to communicate key ideas quickly and reinforce good decision-making practices.

The guide is a resource that courts, dispute resolution programs, lawyers, mediators, and educators can use to help parties use AI appropriately.  The guide may also serve as a teaching resource in legal and dispute resolution education, helping students, trainees, and practitioners learn how to use AI appropriately and how to help clients and parties use AI effectively.  A companion text guide, Using AI in Mediation: A Guide for Parties, provides more detailed guidance for parties participating in mediation.

In addition to its practical purpose, the guide illustrates an approach to legal and dispute resolution education that combines good decision-making principles, plain language, universal design, and visual communication.  As self-represented parties increasingly use AI in disputes, courts and dispute resolution programs are likely to need educational resources like this to help parties use AI appropriately.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份图文并茂的实用指南，旨在帮助争议解决中的各方正确使用AI，强调利用AI辅助清晰思考而非依赖其预测或决策，并涉及保密性、隐私风险及评估AI信息等建议。
AI.research_question: 如何在争议解决中引导各方正确、适当地使用人工智能，避免常见误区？
AI.motivation: 随着自我代理当事人越来越多地在争议中使用AI，法院和争议解决项目亟需教育资源来帮助各方恰当使用AI，避免过度依赖和误用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 良好的决策原则、通俗语言、通用设计原则与视觉传达相结合的教育方法。
AI.method: 采用通俗语言、视觉设计和通用设计原则，制作图文并茂的指南，通过插图快速传达关键信息并强化良好决策实践。
AI.findings: 该指南可作为法院、争议解决项目、律师、调解员和教育工作者帮助各方恰当使用AI的资源，也可用于法律与争议解决教育中的教学工具。同时附有配套文字指南《在调解中使用AI：当事人指南》。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了将良好决策原则、通俗语言、通用设计和视觉传达相结合的法律与争议解决教育方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为各方提供了避免AI常见错误、评估AI生成信息、保护隐私和保密性的实用建议；为法院和教育机构提供了可用的教育资源；帮助自我代理当事人和不同法律知识水平的人群理解AI的恰当使用方式。

reference: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-50
title: Using AI in Mediation: A Guide for Parties
affiliations: University of Missouri School of Law

detail.title: Using AI in Mediation: A Guide for Parties

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper No. 2026-50
publicationDetails.journalName: University of Missouri School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
Parties in mediation increasingly use artificial intelligence (AI) tools.  Many parties use AI inappropriately because they do not understand its limitations.  Although AI systems can appropriately help people organize information, generate ideas, prepare for mediation, and better understand disputes, they can also provide inaccurate information, reinforce unrealistic expectations, and encourage poor decision-making.  Courts, mediation programs, and mediators often encounter problems when parties rely on AI inappropriately.

This guide provides practical advice for parties participating in mediation.  It encourages parties to use AI to help them think more clearly rather than to rely on AI to predict outcomes or make decisions.  The guide discusses common mistakes people make when using AI, explains confidentiality and privacy risks, and offers practical suggestions for evaluating AI-generated information.

The guide emphasizes good decision-making, perspective-taking, realistic assessment of disputes, and careful consideration of risks, costs, and possible outcomes.  It also describes the mediator's role in helping parties evaluate assumptions, consider alternatives, and make informed decisions.

The guide uses plain language and principles of universal design to make these ideas accessible to broad audiences, including self-represented parties and people with varying levels of legal knowledge and literacy.

The guide is a resource that courts, mediation programs, lawyers, mediators, and educators can use to help parties use AI appropriately.  The guide may also serve as a teaching resource in legal and dispute resolution education, helping students, trainees, and practitioners learn how to use AI appropriately and how to help clients and parties use AI effectively.  A companion illustrated guide, Using AI to Resolve Disputes:  A Practical Introduction, provides a shorter, visual introduction to these ideas for parties involved in disputes generally.

In addition to its practical purpose, the guide illustrates an approach to legal and dispute resolution education that combines good decision-making principles, plain language, and universal design.  As self-represented parties increasingly use AI in mediation, courts and dispute resolution programs are likely to need educational resources like this to help parties use AI appropriately.

AI.tldr: 本文提供了一份实用指南，帮助调解当事方合理使用AI工具，避免因不了解AI局限性而产生的问题，并强调AI应辅助思考而非替代决策。
AI.research_question: 调解当事方如何合理使用AI工具？法院、调解项目及调解员应如何帮助当事方避免AI的误用？
AI.motivation: 越来越多当事方在调解中使用AI，但由于不了解AI的局限性（如提供不准确信息、强化不切实际预期、鼓励不良决策），导致诸多问题。现有资源缺乏面向广泛受众的、通俗易懂的实用指南。
AI.theoretical_framework: 良好决策原则（good decision-making principles）、视角采择（perspective-taking）、调解中风险评估、通用设计原则（universal design）。
AI.method: 实践性指南开发，采用平实语言（plain language）和通用设计原则，面向包括无代理当事方和不同法律素养水平人群的广泛受众。
AI.findings: AI可帮助组织信息、产生想法、准备调解、更好理解争议，但也会导致错误信息、不切实际预期和不良决策。指南建议用AI辅助思考而非预测结果或替代决策，强调保密与隐私风险，并提出评估AI生成信息的实用建议。
AI.theory_contributions: 为法律与争议解决教育提供了一种结合良好决策原则、平实语言和通用设计的教育方法范例。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院、调解项目、律师、调解员和教育工作者提供了一份可实际使用的资源，帮助当事方合理使用AI；同时也作为法律与争议解决教育的教学资源。

affiliations: University of Connecticut and University of Trento, Università della Svizzera italiana

detail.title: A conversation with Richard Langlois, author of "The Corporation and the Twentieth Century: The History of American Business Enterprise"

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Entrepreneurial and Organizational Diversity, Vol. 15, No. 1, 2026, pp. 69-74.
publicationDetails.journalName: Journal of Entrepreneurial & Organizational Diversity (JEOD)

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Journal of Entrepreneurial and Organizational Diversity, volume 15, issue 1, 2026[10.5947/jeod.2026.005]

detail.abstract: In this conversation, Massimiliano Vatiero and Richard N. Langlois discuss the themes of Langlois’s The Corporation and the Twentieth Century: The History of American Business Enterprise. Drawing on institutional economics and organizational theory, Langlois argues that large vertically integrated corporations emerged not as an inevitable consequence of technological progress, but as contingent responses to periods of weak market-supporting institutions, economic crises, wars, and political intervention. As markets and institutional infrastructures matured, firms increasingly adopted decentralized, modular, and network-based forms of organization. The conversation concludes with future research directions, highlighting the importance of modularity, knowledge governance, and polycentric systems for understanding entrepreneurship, corporate governance, and organizational diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文基于对Langlois《20世纪的公司》的对话式讨论，提出大型垂直一体化企业并非技术进步的必然结果，而是对制度薄弱、危机与政治干预的权变回应；随着市场制度成熟，企业转向去中心化、模块化和网络化组织形式。
AI.research_question: 大型垂直一体化企业为何出现并演变？其组织形式如何随制度环境变化而转型？
AI.motivation: 挑战"技术决定论"对大型企业兴起的主流解释，强调制度环境与政治干预在组织形态演变中的关键作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度经济学、组织理论、模块化理论、多中心治理理论
AI.method: 对话式讨论与理论综合，基于历史制度分析
AI.findings: （1）大型垂直一体化企业是对制度缺失和危机的权变回应；（2）市场制度成熟后，企业转向模块化与网络化组织；（3）未来研究方向聚焦模块化、知识治理与多中心系统。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）挑战技术决定论，提出制度权变视角；（2）将模块化与多中心治理引入企业史分析；（3）为组织多样性提供制度解释。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为企业组织形式选择提供制度环境分析框架；（2）提醒管理者关注制度基础设施对组织设计的约束与机会；（3）为政策制定者理解市场制度建设与企业活力关系提供参考。

title: Extracted PhD Thesis on Impact of Adoption of Electronic Human Resource Management on Performance of Employees in Bangladesh
affiliations: Bangladesh Army International University of Science and Technology (BAIUST)

detail.title: Extracted PhD Thesis on Impact of Adoption of Electronic Human Resource Management on Performance of Employees in Bangladesh
detail.abstract:
Performance of employees is the lifeline of every organization a firm that aims to put maximum effort into obtaining the desired outcome. Therefore, the unitary role of human resources management becomes more extensive and versatile. The demands of the new century pose a new challenge to people management functions, requiring them to adopt new ways of work and bid farewell to classical methods. The new way of working is heavily reliant on technology. It replaced man with machines and pen with keyboards.

The major attempt of the study is to assess the role of adopting electronic human resource management on performance of employees in Bangladesh. While investigating the association, the study also measured the role of knowledge-sharing behavior and top management support. In accordance to an extensive literature review, the research developed a four-dimensional model of electronic human resource management, encompassing eRecruitment and selection, eTraining and development, ePerformance appraisal, and eCompensation and payroll, as well as unidimensional model of performance of employees, knowledge sharing behavior, and top management support. The model of the study has been drawn under the lens of technology accepted model and social exchange theory. This quantitative research collected data from 320 respondents with the help of structured questionnaire and analyzed data. After finishing the pretesting, the study conducted a pilot survey. The survey, as indicated by the final questionnaire, began after confirmation of validity and reliability. By applying a seven -point Likert scale, the data coded and analyzed using statistical software such as SPSS and SmartPLS version 4. Specifically, the software applied in descriptive analysis, reliability testing, common method bias tests, factor loading, structural equation modeling, model fit tests, and other applications.

The research attempted an emerging issue and produced exciting findings. The adoption of ePerformance appraisal does not significantly influence performance of employees. In contrast, eRcruitment and selection, eTraining and development, and eCompensation and payrolls have a significant impact on performance of employees. Similarly, the knowledgesharing behavior mediates (fully or partially) the association between four-dimensional electronic human resource adoption and performance of employees except the nexus between electronic recruitment and selection to performance of employees. On the other hand, top management support does not moderate the association between knowledge  sharing behavior and performance of employees. Moreover, the open-ended questionnaire provided meaningful insights, including performance of employee’s comparisons before and after the adoption of electronic human resource management, positive consequences, challenges encountered, a list of available software, and employee suggestions for efficient adoption.

The outcome of this emerging research will significantly contribute to organizations in reassessing their existing adoption levels and guiding firms that are planning for future adoption. Keeping performance of employees as a priority, the firm may introduce technology-based workplaces, implement necessary policies for knowledge sharing, and encourage greater involvement from top management to enable employees to perform at their best. Practitioners may apply the outcome to handle the performance management and technology adoption matters. The research experience suggested that future research may be conducted with a bigger sample size, employ different tools and techniques, and include comparative analysis between the government and private sectors, as well as case study-based research, in the context of Bangladesh.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了电子人力资源管理（e-HRM）对孟加拉国员工绩效的影响，发现电子招聘与选拔、电子培训与开发、电子薪酬与薪资对员工绩效有显著正向影响，但电子绩效评估的影响不显著；知识共享行为在其中起中介作用，而高层管理支持对知识共享与员工绩效关系的调节作用不显著。
AI.research_question: 采用电子人力资源管理对孟加拉国员工绩效的影响是什么？知识共享行为和高层管理支持在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 21世纪的工作方式高度依赖技术，需要抛弃传统人力资源管理方法，但电子人力资源管理对员工绩效的影响机制尚不明确，特别是在孟加拉国背景下缺乏相关实证研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术接受模型（TAM）和社会交换理论（SET）
AI.method: 定量研究，通过结构化问卷收集320份数据，采用七点李克特量表，使用SPSS和SmartPLS 4进行描述性分析、信度检验、共同方法偏差检验、因子载荷、结构方程模型、模型拟合检验等。
AI.findings: 1）电子招聘与选拔、电子培训与开发、电子薪酬与薪资对员工绩效有显著正向影响，但电子绩效评估影响不显著；2）知识共享行为在四个维度（除电子招聘与选拔与员工绩效之间）中起完全或部分中介作用；3）高层管理支持对知识共享行为与员工绩效之间的调节作用不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 将技术接受模型和社会交换理论整合到电子人力资源管理研究中，构建并验证了四维度电子人力资源管理模型，揭示了知识共享行为的中介机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织评估现有电子人力资源管理采纳水平提供依据；指导企业引入技术型工作场所、制定知识共享政策、鼓励高层管理参与以提升员工绩效；为绩效管理和技术采纳实践提供决策参考。

title: Prediction, Not Adjudication: Why Crowdsourced Blockchain Decisions Are Not Arbitral Awards
affiliations: University of Oxford - Faculty of Law and University of Oxford - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Prediction, Not Adjudication: Why Crowdsourced Blockchain Decisions Are Not Arbitral Awards
detail.abstract: In this article, we argue that decisions produced by crowdsourced blockchain dispute-resolution systems such as Kleros and Polymarket's UMA protocol do not qualify as arbitral awards. Their defining feature is that they reward participants for predicting what the majority of other participants will decide. Arbitration, by contrast, is oriented towards finding the right answer through independent judgment, deliberation, and reasoned decision-making. Guessing may sometimes produce the correct result, but it is categorically different from adjudication. The fact that a crowd occasionally reaches the right answer does not transform a process of prediction into a process of judgment.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了Kleros和Polymarket的UMA协议等众包区块链争端解决系统产生的决定不构成仲裁裁决，因为它们基于多数预测而非独立判断和理性决策。
AI.research_question: 众包区块链争端解决系统的决定是否构成法律意义上的仲裁裁决？
AI.motivation: 随着区块链去中心化司法系统（如Kleros、UMA协议）的兴起，需要厘清这些基于众包预测的争议解决机制与传统仲裁的本质区别。
AI.theoretical_framework: 仲裁法理论（仲裁裁决的构成要件）；决策理论（预测 vs. 判断/裁决的范畴区分）。
AI.method: 概念分析与比较法论证，通过对"预测"与"裁决"两个核心概念的逻辑区分进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 众包区块链争端解决系统以奖励多数预测为核心机制，而仲裁要求独立判断、审慎审议和理性推理。即使众包偶尔得出正确结果，也不能将预测过程转化为裁决过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 清晰界定了"预测"与"裁决"在决策理论上的范畴差异，为区块链争端解决机制的法律分类提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和法律实务界判断区块链众包争端解决系统产出的法律效力（如是否可被法院承认和执行）提供了分析框架。

title: Beyond AI Adoption: How Curiosity and Reflection Shape Innovative Behavior in Technology-Enabled Workplaces
affiliations: University of Ljubljana

detail.title: Beyond AI Adoption: How Curiosity and Reflection Shape Innovative Behavior in Technology-Enabled Workplaces
detail.abstract: Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) is transforming contemporary workplaces, yet employees vary considerably in their ability to convert AI use into innovative outcomes. Addressing this gap, this study examines the psychological mechanism and boundary condition underlying the relationship between GenAI use and employee innovative behavior. Drawing on the Stimulus–Organism–Response framework and information-gap theory, we propose that work-related curiosity mediates the effect of GenAI use on innovation, while individual reflection strengthens this process. The proposed moderated mediation model was tested using multi-source supervisor–employee dyadic data from 315 employees and 72 supervisors working in project-based technology firms in an emerging economy. Covariance-based structural equation modeling and bootstrapping analyses revealed that GenAI use positively predicts both work-related curiosity and innovative behavior. Work-related curiosity partially mediates the relationship between GenAI use and innovation, indicating that GenAI stimulates innovation by fostering employees’ intrinsic motivation to explore, learn, and experiment. Furthermore, individual reflection positively moderates the effect of GenAI use on curiosity, such that the indirect effect of GenAI on innovative behavior is significantly stronger among highly reflective employees. By identifying curiosity as a critical motivational mechanism and reflection as an important dispositional boundary condition, this study advances understanding of how and when GenAI contributes to employee innovation. The findings extend AI-at-work research beyond instrumental explanations of technology use and provide evidence from an underexamined emerging-economy context. Practically, organizations can enhance innovation outcomes by promoting curiosity-oriented GenAI use and embedding reflective work practices.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于S-O-R框架和信息差理论，发现生成式AI使用通过激发工作相关好奇心促进员工创新行为，且个体反思正向调节这一过程。基于315对员工-主管配对数据的分析验证了有调节的中介模型。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI使用如何以及在何种条件下影响员工的创新行为？
AI.motivation: 虽然GenAI正在变革职场，但员工将AI使用转化为创新成果的能力存在显著差异，现有研究对此心理机制和边界条件的理解尚不充分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 刺激-有机体-反应（S-O-R）框架；信息差理论（information-gap theory）
AI.method: 多源主管-员工配对数据（315名员工、72名主管）；协方差结构方程模型（CB-SEM）；Bootstrapping分析
AI.findings: 1) GenAI使用正向预测工作相关好奇心和创新行为；2) 工作相关好奇心部分中介GenAI使用与创新行为的关系；3) 个体反思正向调节GenAI使用对好奇心的影响，高反思员工中GenAI通过好奇心对创新的间接效应更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了好奇心作为GenAI驱动创新的关键动机机制，将AI工作研究从工具性解释拓展到心理动机层面；识别了反思作为重要的个体特质边界条件；提供了新兴经济体情境下的实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 组织可通过促进好奇心导向的GenAI使用和嵌入反思性工作实践来提升员工创新成果。

reference: FEDS Working Paper No. 2026-45
title: An Evaluation of Difference-in-Differences Methods Using Placebo Event Studies
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: An Evaluation of Difference-in-Differences Methods Using Placebo Event Studies

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Researchers are faced with the choice of which of the many recently developed difference-in-differences methods to use in practice. To assess these estimators' relative performance for single-unit event studies, we conduct 134,000+ state-level placebo event studies across 13 estimators. We find that no single method dominates. Performance is context-dependent, with synthetic-control-like methods sometimes outperforming and sometimes underperforming two-way-fixed-effect-like and matching methods. Performance also varies across states at least as much as it does across estimators. Our results highlight the need for practitioners to conduct placebo tests to understand the performance of methods in their research context.

AI.tldr: 本文通过134,000+项州级安慰剂事件研究，系统比较了13种双重差分方法的性能，发现没有单一方法占优，表现取决于研究情境，且不同州之间的表现差异至少与方法间的差异一样大。
AI.research_question: 在单一单元事件研究中，研究人员应如何从众多新兴的双重差分方法中选择最合适的方法？
AI.motivation: 近年来涌现了大量新的双重差分方法，研究者面临选择困难，且缺乏系统性的实证比较来指导方法选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于安慰剂事件研究框架，比较合成控制类方法、双向固定效应类方法和匹配方法的相对表现。
AI.method: 在州级层面开展134,000+项安慰剂事件研究，涵盖13种估计量，系统评估各方法在不同情境下的表现。
AI.findings: ①没有单一方法在所有情境下占优；②方法表现高度依赖于研究情境；③合成控制类方法有时优于、有时劣于双向固定效应类和匹配方法；④不同州之间的表现差异至少与方法之间的差异同样显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了DID方法选择的情境依赖性，指出方法选择需要基于具体研究背景进行针对性检验，而非盲目遵循某一方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了实践建议：开展安慰剂检验以评估所选方法在自身研究情境中的表现，避免依赖单一方法的"一刀切"做法。

reference: FEDS Working Paper No. 2026-46
title: Sequence-Space Jacobians of Life-Cycle Models
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Australian National University (ANU) - Crawford School of Public Policy and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Sequence-Space Jacobians of Life-Cycle Models

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: The sequence-space Jacobian (SSJ) method of Auclert et al. (2021a) has made heterogeneous-agent models far easier to solve, fueling an explosion of applications. But even SSJ strains against capacity constraints when state spaces grow very large, as in economies with overlapping generations of heterogeneous agents (HA-OLG). We show how to exploit the special properties of age—finite planning horizons and deterministic transitions between ages—to compute the Jacobians of a general class of HA-OLG models orders of magnitude faster. We provide rigorous proofs, age-specific Jacobians that decompose aggregate dynamics across cohorts, an application to the dynamic general-equilibrium effects of secularly declining birth rates, and an accessible cookbook for adopting our method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对异质性代理人-世代交叠模型（HA-OLG）的加速雅可比计算方法，利用年龄的特殊性质（有限规划期和确定性年龄转换）大幅提升计算效率，将求解速度提升数个数量级。
AI.research_question: 如何利用世代交叠模型中年龄的特殊性质，显著加速异质性代理人模型的雅可比矩阵计算？
AI.motivation: 现有的序列空间雅可比（SSJ）方法虽已极大简化异质性代理人模型的求解，但当模型包含世代交叠结构（HA-OLG）时，状态空间变得十分庞大，SSJ方法面临计算容量瓶颈。
AI.theoretical_framework: 序列空间雅可比（SSJ）方法；世代交叠异质性代理人（HA-OLG）模型；年龄的特殊性质（有限规划期、年龄间确定性转换）。
AI.method: 利用年龄的特殊性质，推导出针对HA-OLG模型的高效雅可比矩阵计算算法，并提供严格证明、年龄特定雅可比分解、以及可复现的"烹饪书"式操作指南。
AI.findings: 新方法比SSJ方法快数个数量级；提供了年龄特定雅可比矩阵，可将总体动态分解到各代际队列；成功应用于分析出生率长期下降的动态一般均衡效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为HA-OLG模型提供了理论上严格且高效的雅可比计算方法，丰富了序列空间方法在复杂人口结构模型中的应用；年龄特定雅可比分解为理解跨代际动态提供了新的分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 大幅降低了HA-OLG模型的计算门槛，使研究者能够处理此前因计算容量限制而难以求解的大型模型；提供易于使用的"烹饪书"式指南，便于其他研究者采用该方法。

title: Stop Debugging the Dreamer: A Manager’s Framework for Turning AI Hallucinations into Breakthroughs
affiliations: and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Stop Debugging the Dreamer: A Manager’s Framework for Turning AI Hallucinations into Breakthroughs
detail.abstract: Most organizations treat generative AI’s hallucinations as a defect to stamp out. That instinct is backwards. Discovery has always run on the same engine — abundant variation, then ruthless selection — and generative AI has made variation almost free. The binding constraint is no longer imagination but verification, and verification cost is something managers can deliberately lower. We give managers a diagnostic, the Verifiability–Stakes matrix, that says when to amplify a model’s “dreaming,” when to harness it behind a verification gate, and when to contain it. More importantly, we show a dynamic move competitors miss: by engineering verification cheaper, a firm can tip whole domains from “too risky to touch” into “too valuable to ignore.” A four-step protocol — Provoke, Filter, Capture, Bound — builds the organization that turns AI’s errors into advantage — and tells you fast, before the expensive bet, when it is not paying.

AI.tldr: 本文提出，生成式AI的“幻觉”不应被消灭，而应被策略性利用。通过降低验证成本，企业可以将AI的“做梦”能力从缺陷转化为竞争优势。作者给出了Verifiability–Stakes矩阵诊断工具和“触发-过滤-捕获-边界”四步法。
AI.research_question: 企业如何策略性地利用生成式AI的幻觉（而非消除它）来获得竞争优势？
AI.motivation: 大多数组织将AI幻觉视为必须消除的缺陷，但作者认为这种直觉是错误的——发现过程始终依赖“丰富变异+严格选择”，而生成式AI让变异几乎免费，真正的约束已转向验证成本。
AI.theoretical_framework: 变异-选择（Variation-Selection）发现机制；验证成本经济学；Verifiability–Stakes矩阵（可验证性- stakes矩阵）
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，提出诊断工具（Verifiability–Stakes矩阵）和四步协议（Provoke, Filter, Capture, Bound）
AI.findings: 通过主动降低验证成本，企业可以将原本“风险过高”的领域转变为“价值巨大不容忽视”的领域，从而获得竞争对手难以复制的动态优势。
AI.theory_contributions: 颠覆了AI“幻觉”必须消除的传统认知，将验证成本而非想象力视为创新瓶颈，提出了AI时代企业创新的新理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了Verifiability–Stakes矩阵诊断工具和四步操作协议，帮助企业在何时放大、何时利用门控、何时遏制AI“做梦”方面做出决策。

reference: Cross-Selling Gatekeepers in RESEARCH HANDBOOK OF AGENCY AND INTERMEDIATION (Deborah A. DeMott & Tan Cheng-Han eds. Edward Elgar Publishing, 2026)
title: Cross-Selling Gatekeepers

detail.title: Cross-Selling Gatekeepers

publicationDetails.detailsText: Cross-Selling Gatekeepers in RESEARCH HANDBOOK OF AGENCY AND INTERMEDIATION (Deborah A. DeMott & Tan Cheng-Han eds. Edward Elgar Publishing, 2026)

detail.abstract:
Cross-selling, or leveraging an existing client relationship to sell additional services, is a
ubiquitous and enduring business practice. Cross-selling by professional service
providers (“PSP”) creates agency costs and can undermine the PSP gatekeeper role in
corporate governance. The expertise of cross-selling gatekeepers can help client corporations cut costs,
create efficiencies, and promote sound governance. But cross-selling gatekeepers can
also contribute to client capture and anticompetitive effects that foreclose opportunities
for other service providers. They may exploit clients through inferior service offerings
and conflicts of interest that significantly compromise corporate governance.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了专业服务提供商（PSP）的交叉销售行为，指出其既能为客户企业带来降低成本、提高效率、促进治理的收益，也会产生代理成本、损害PSP作为公司治理"看门人"的角色，导致客户锁定、反竞争效应和利益冲突等问题。
AI.research_question: 专业服务提供商的交叉销售行为如何影响公司治理？其作为"看门人"的收益与成本分别是什么？
AI.motivation: 交叉销售是商业实践中普遍且长期存在的现象，但其对公司治理的影响尚未得到系统分析，尤其是在专业服务领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理成本理论、看门人理论、利益冲突理论
AI.method: 理论分析/概念性研究
AI.findings: 交叉销售看门人既可以通过专业知识帮助企业降本增效、促进良好治理，也可能导致客户捕获、反竞争效应、劣质服务和利益冲突，从而损害公司治理。
AI.theory_contributions: 将交叉销售理论引入专业服务提供商的公司治理角色分析，揭示了其作为"看门人"的双刃剑效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业管理者识别和防范交叉销售带来的治理风险提供了理论依据和警示。

reference: Columbia Business School Research Paper Forthcoming
title: Disruptive vs. Collaborative Positioning and the Cost of Talent: Evidence from Startup Hiring Field Experiments
affiliations: London Business School, Columbia University - Columbia Business School, Management and Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: Disruptive vs. Collaborative Positioning and the Cost of Talent: Evidence from Startup Hiring Field Experiments

publicationDetails.detailsText: Columbia Business School Research Paper Forthcoming
publicationDetails.journalName: Columbia Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine how a startup's strategic positioning, including whether it frames its technology and market approach as disruptive or collaborative, affects talent acquisition in new ventures. Although prior research has examined how disruptive positioning influences investors, its impact on prospective employees remains less well understood. We conduct two preregistered field experiments with an early-stage climate-technology startup in India, randomly assigning prospective software engineers to receive disruptive, collaborative, or, in the second experiment, neutral positioning language while holding all other job and firm attributes constant. Across both experiments, positioning affected candidates' perceptions of the opportunity. In Field Experiment 1, when candidates encountered positioning early in the application process, disruptive positioning reduced application completion by 6 percentage points and, conditional on completion, increased compensation demands by nearly 5% relative to collaborative positioning. In Field Experiment 2, where treatment was introduced later, completion rates did not differ significantly, yet candidates exposed to disruptive positioning demanded 9% higher total compensation than those exposed to collaborative positioning. Benchmarking against a neutral control suggests that this gap was driven primarily by collaborative positioning lowering compensation demands relative to baseline expectations. Follow-up evidence from interviews and a survey experiment suggests that disruptive positioning increased perceptions of technological novelty, specialized skill requirements, and effort demands. Consistent with this mechanism, the compensation gap was concentrated among more experienced and higher-earning candidates. Overall, our findings demonstrate that strategic positioning affects candidates' willingness to engage with startup employment, impacting the cost of attracting talent.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两个预注册的实地实验（与印度一家早期气候科技初创公司合作），研究初创企业的战略定位（颠覆性 vs. 协作性 vs. 中性）如何影响人才招聘。结果发现，颠覆性定位会降低应聘者完成申请的概率并提高薪酬期望，而协作性定位能降低薪酬要求，这一效应在经验丰富和高收入的候选人中更为显著。
AI.research_question: 初创企业的战略定位（颠覆性 vs. 协作性）如何影响潜在员工的求职意愿和薪酬期望？
AI.motivation: 已有研究关注颠覆性定位对投资者的影响，但对其如何影响潜在员工（人才招聘）的认识不足。对于依赖人才生存的初创企业而言，了解定位策略对招聘成本和人才吸引力的影响至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论、感知劳动经济学（技术新颖性、技能要求、努力需求的感知机制）
AI.method: 两个预注册的实地实验（Field Experiment 1 & 2），辅以访谈和一项调查实验。实验对象为印度一家早期气候科技初创企业的潜在软件工程师候选人，随机分配接受颠覆性、协作性或中性定位语言。
AI.findings: 1. 早期接触颠覆性定位使申请完成率降低6个百分点，完成后薪酬要求提高近5%。2. 后期接触时完成率无显著差异，但颠覆性定位组薪酬要求高出9%。3. 与中性对照组相比，协作性定位降低了薪酬预期。4. 效应在经验更丰富、收入更高的候选人中更明显。5. 机制：颠覆性定位增加了感知的技术新颖性、专业技能要求和努力需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 将战略定位的研究视角从投资者拓展到劳动力市场；揭示了定位语言对人才招聘成本和候选人自我筛选的影响机制；区分了颠覆性与协作性定位的差异化效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为初创企业提供了招聘策略建议：颠覆性定位可能增加招聘成本并筛选掉部分人才，协作性定位有助于降低薪酬预期；企业应根据招聘时机和目标候选人特征审慎选择定位语言。

title: CROSS-SELLING GOVERNANCE

detail.title: CROSS-SELLING GOVERNANCE
detail.abstract: Corporate governance faces threats from all sides-not just the familiar narratives of CEO malfeasance and inattentive directors, but lawyers, bankers, accountants, management consultants, and other professional service providers (PSPs) who engage in cross-selling. Cross-selling, or leveraging an existing client relationship to sell additional services, is a ubiquitous business strategy. While it may create opportunities for corporate clients, it can also lead to abuses. The quality of PSP advice, upon which company directors and officers often rely to fulfill their fiduciary duties and responsibilities, can be undermined. Existing regulation of PSP cross-selling does not adequately address corporate governance risks. Their elimination will require a synthesis of both regulatory and private ordering approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了专业服务提供商（PSPs）的交叉销售行为对企业治理的威胁，指出现有监管不足，并提出需要结合监管与私人秩序的综合方案来应对这些风险。
AI.research_question: 专业服务提供商的交叉销售行为如何威胁公司治理，以及如何有效监管此类行为？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注CEO渎职和董事不作为等传统治理问题，但忽视了律师、银行家、会计师、管理顾问等专业服务提供商通过交叉销售行为对公司治理造成的系统性威胁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公司治理理论、代理理论、专业服务提供商（PSPs）的激励与利益冲突理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律与经济分析，结合现有监管框架的批判性评估。
AI.findings: 1) 交叉销售损害了PSP建议的独立性，削弱了董事和高管履行信义义务所依赖的咨询质量；2) 现有监管（包括法律和行业规范）未能充分应对这些治理风险；3) 需要采取监管与私人秩序相结合的综合方法来消除风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将公司治理威胁的研究从传统的CEO和董事层面，拓展到PSP交叉销售这一被忽视的系统性风险来源，丰富了代理理论和公司治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构和政策制定者提供了识别和应对PSP交叉销售治理风险的分析框架；为企业董事会和管理层识别PSP利益冲突并完善内部治理机制提供了实践指导。

title: Predicting Employee Attrition Using Machine Learning: A Comparative Analysis of Classification Models for Human Resource Analytics

detail.title: Predicting Employee Attrition Using Machine Learning: A Comparative Analysis of Classification Models for Human Resource Analytics
detail.abstract: Employee attrition-the voluntary resignation of employees from an organization-represents one of the most significant challenges facing human resource management today. The cost of replacing a single employee can reach up to 200% of their annual salary, making accurate attrition prediction a strategic priority for organizations worldwide. This study presents a comparative analysis of three machine learning models-Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and XGBoost-for predicting employee attrition using the IBM HR Analytics Employee Attrition dataset comprising 1,470 employee records and 31 features. Each model was evaluated across five performance metrics: accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and ROC-AUC. Results demonstrate that Logistic Regression achieved the highest predictive performance with an accuracy of 87.41% and ROC-AUC of 0.8057, outperforming Random Forest (ROC-AUC: 0.7890) and XGBoost (ROC-AUC: 0.7580). Feature importance analysis identified total working years, overtime, and stock option level as the strongest predictors of attrition. These findings provide empirical evidence for model selection in enterprise HR analytics systems and offer actionable insights for workforce retention strategy design.

AI.tldr: 该论文比较了三种机器学习模型（逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost）在预测员工离职方面的表现，发现逻辑回归在准确率和ROC-AUC上表现最佳，并识别出总工作年限、加班和股票期权水平为最强预测因素。
AI.research_question: 三种机器学习模型（逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost）在预测员工离职方面表现如何？哪些特征最能预测员工离职？
AI.motivation: 员工离职成本极高（可达年薪的200%），准确预测离职对组织人力资源战略至关重要，但目前缺乏对不同机器学习模型在离职预测中的系统性比较。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于机器学习分类算法（逻辑回归、随机森林、XGBoost）以及特征重要性分析框架。
AI.method: 使用IBM HR Analytics员工离职数据集（1,470条记录，31个特征），对比三种模型在准确率、精确率、召回率、F1分数和ROC-AUC五个指标上的表现，并进行特征重要性分析。
AI.findings: 逻辑回归表现最佳（准确率87.41%，ROC-AUC 0.8057），优于随机森林和XGBoost；总工作年限、加班和股票期权水平是最强的离职预测因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 为员工离职预测场景下的机器学习模型选择提供了实证比较依据，验证了逻辑回归在该特定数据集上的优越性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业HR分析系统选择预测模型提供了依据；识别出的关键预测因素（工作年限、加班、股票期权）可指导企业制定针对性的员工保留策略。

title: Stories People Hear About Inflation

detail.title: Stories People Hear About Inflation
detail.abstract: Households form inflation expectations not only from observed price changes and official statistics, but also from the stories they hear about inflation. Using more than 350,000 podcast episodes, I study how inflation is discussed in public media. I distinguish between causal stories, which link inflation to mechanisms such as housing shortages, oil shocks, sanctions, or monetary policy, and stories which assign responsibility to political actors or institutions without a clear causal account. To estimate their effects, I exploit recurring podcast guests who repeat similar explanations across shows reaching different local audiences. Stories centered on war, oil shocks, sanctions, and trade conflict lower short term inflation expectations, though the effect fades at longer horizons. Partisan blame stories are associated with higher expectations, but the evidence points to audience selection rather than persuasion. Overall, the paper shows that public stories about inflation matter: some move expectations by changing how households interpret economic shocks, while others reveal the political sorting of media audiences.

AI.tldr: 本文利用超过35万集播客节目，研究公众媒体中关于通货膨胀的故事如何影响家庭通胀预期。因果性故事（如住房短缺、石油冲击、制裁、货币政策）与归责性故事（将责任归于政治行为者而无明确因果解释）产生不同效果。战争、石油冲击、制裁和贸易冲突类故事降低短期通胀预期，但长期效果消失；党派归责故事与更高预期相关，但证据指向受众选择而非说服。
AI.research_question: 公众媒体中关于通货膨胀的叙事（故事）如何影响家庭的通胀预期？不同类型的叙事（因果性故事 vs. 归责性故事）会产生怎样不同的影响？
AI.motivation: 家庭形成通胀预期不仅来自观察到的价格变化和官方统计，还来自他们听到的关于通胀的故事。然而，关于这些故事如何影响预期的实证证据相对缺乏，尤其是在区分不同叙事类型及其效果差异方面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 通胀预期形成理论；叙事经济学；媒体对公众预期的影响机制；因果归因理论
AI.method: 利用超过35万集播客节目数据，区分因果性故事和归责性故事；利用重复做客播客的嘉宾（在不同节目、面向不同本地受众时重复相似解释）作为识别策略，估计不同叙事对通胀预期的影响。
AI.findings: （1）关于战争、石油冲击、制裁和贸易冲突的因果性故事降低短期通胀预期，但长期效果消失；（2）党派归责故事与更高的通胀预期相关，但证据更支持受众选择效应而非说服效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了叙事经济学和通胀预期形成理论，系统区分了不同类型的通胀叙事（因果性vs.归责性）及其对预期的异质性影响，揭示了公共叙事影响经济预期的机制边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和央行沟通策略提供启示：不同类型的通胀叙事对公众预期的影响不同，因果性叙事在短期有效但长期效果有限，而归责性叙事更多反映受众既有立场而非改变预期。

reference: Craig Atkinson, Why Trade Facilitation Reform Requires Mainstreaming Digital Technologies, LSE Business Review (July 2020).
title: Why Trade Facilitation Reform Requires Mainstreaming Digital Technologies

detail.title: Why Trade Facilitation Reform Requires Mainstreaming Digital Technologies

publicationDetails.detailsText: Craig Atkinson, Why Trade Facilitation Reform Requires Mainstreaming Digital Technologies, LSE Business Review (July 2020).

detail.abstract: This article explores how the context for crafting trade policy is changing, particularly when considering the digitalisation of trade, and what it could imply for the role of NTFCs in fostering modernisation. Mainstreaming digital technologies in trade facilitation reform is not merely an obligation for most countries, it is a necessity. Indeed, conditions for the cost-effective and rapid movement of goods can have as much to do with a product's data as with a product itself. This is increasingly the case as the shift toward paperless trade is premised on policy delivery and compliance through digital means. Yet, disparate and emergent rules/regulations (e.g. General Data Protection Regulation, European data strategy), arrangements (e.g. Digital Economy Partnership Agreement), framework treaties (e.g. Cross-border Paperless Trade in Asia and the Pacific), and provisions (e.g. e-commerce chapters in trade agreements) highlight a need to coordinate all relevant legal and technical communities when crafting 'future proof' policies at the national level. In addition, modern supply chain models specify relationships between data entities in international sales/transport contracts and demand a reformulation of measures in accordance with the broadening scope of channels (e.g. cross-border e-commerce) and modes of policy delivery (e.g. the Internet).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了贸易数字化背景下，国家贸易便利化委员会（NTFCs）在协调法律与技术社区、推动政策现代化中的作用与挑战。
AI.research_question: 贸易数字化如何改变贸易政策制定环境，以及这对国家贸易便利化委员会（NTFCs）推动现代化意味着什么？
AI.motivation: 随着贸易数字化（如无纸化贸易、跨境电子商务）加速，现有规则分散且不协调，亟需理解如何在国家层面制定"面向未来"的贸易政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易便利化理论、数字贸易治理、供应链数据模型理论。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性分析，基于对现有规则（如GDPR、欧洲数据战略）、协议（如DEPA）、框架条约及贸易协定条款的梳理。
AI.findings: 1) 数字技术主流化已成为贸易便利化改革的必要条件；2) 货物高效流动越来越依赖于产品数据本身；3) 分散的规则/协议/条款要求在国家层面协调法律与技术社区；4) 现代供应链模型要求根据政策交付渠道和模式的扩大而重新制定措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了贸易便利化理论在数字时代的适用性，强调数据流在贸易政策中的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NTFCs在数字时代协调多利益相关方、制定协调一致的政策提供了方向性指导。

title: Distillation and Strategic Launches on the LLM Frontier: An Empirical Analysis
affiliations: University at Buffalo (SUNY) - School of Management and University at Buffalo (SUNY) - School of Management

detail.title: Distillation and Strategic Launches on the LLM Frontier: An Empirical Analysis
detail.abstract: We study how distillation shapes the innovation frontier in the large language model (LLM) market. A distinctive feature of this market is that launches can also become inputs into rivals’ subsequent development: Model behavior can be learned from, and open-weight releases expose reusable artifacts more directly. We build a provider-week panel from 529 model launches by 51 providers between November 2022 and June 2026, measuring both launch decisions and benchmark-based quality states. Reduced-form evidence identifies two opposing margins: While realized open-weight rival frontier raises in the same capability dimension are associated with larger subsequent quality improvements, anticipated near-term open-weight rival launches reduce current launch probabilities. Closed-weight rival activity does not exhibit similar patterns. We then estimate a structural launch model in which distillation affects both quality improvement and launch timing. Counterfactual analyses show that an all-closed-weight regime increases launch frequency but reduces quality gains per launch, whereas an all-open-weight regime tempers launch frequency but increases quality gains per launch. These opposing margins offset more strongly under all-open than under all-closed: All-open remains close to the baseline frontier, while all-closed yields greater total quality improvement through a substantially higher launch frequency. Impacts on consumers are modest and dimension-specific, with the all-open regime tending to benefit consumers more than the all-closed regime by improving the best available models. Our work highlights how distillation and model openness reshape the LLM innovation frontier through timing and magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了蒸馏（distillation）如何塑造大语言模型（LLM）市场的创新前沿。通过构建2022年11月至2026年6月期间51个提供商的529次模型发布的提供者-周面板数据，发现两种相反的效应：已实现的开放权重对手前沿提升会促进后续质量改进，而预期的近期开放权重对手发布会降低当前发布概率。结构模型和反事实分析表明，全封闭权重制度提高发布频率但降低每次发布的质量收益，全开放权重制度则相反；全封闭通过更高发布频率实现更大总质量改进，而全开放在改善最佳可用模型方面更有利于消费者。
AI.research_question: 蒸馏（distillation）如何影响大语言模型市场的创新前沿？模型开放性（开放权重 vs. 封闭权重）如何通过蒸馏机制影响创新的时机与质量？
AI.motivation: LLM市场中存在一个独特特征：模型发布后可以成为竞争对手后续开发的输入（通过学习模型行为或直接利用开放权重），这区别于传统产品市场。理解这种"蒸馏驱动"的竞争动态对创新政策、平台设计和人工智能治理具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新竞争理论、知识溢出理论、实物期权理论。模型将蒸馏视为一种既影响质量改进又影响发布时机的机制，区分了"已实现"的对手前沿效应和"预期"的对手发布效应。
AI.method: 1) 构建529次模型发布的提供者-周面板数据（2022.11-2026.06），包含发布决策和基于基准测试的质量状态测量；2) 简化形式证据（reduced-form evidence）识别两种对立边际效应；3) 估计结构模型（structural launch model）；4) 反事实分析比较全开放权重与全封闭权重制度。
AI.findings: 1) 已实现的开放权重对手前沿提升与更大的后续质量改进正相关；2) 预期的近期开放权重对手发布降低当前发布概率；3) 封闭权重对手活动无类似模式；4) 全封闭权重增加发布频率但降低每次发布的质量增益；5) 全开放权重降低发布频率但增加每次发布的质量增益；6) 两种效应在全开放下抵消更强，全封闭通过更高发布频率实现更大总质量改进；7) 消费者影响适中且维度特异，全开放更有利于消费者。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统建模蒸馏（知识溢出的一种特殊形式）在AI市场创新竞争中的作用；区分了知识溢出的"激励效应"（促进后续创新）和"抢先效应"（抑制当前投资）；拓展了创新经济学中关于知识溢出和 appropriability 的理论到AI模型市场。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI治理政策提供实证依据：全开放权重和全封闭权重各有优劣，政策制定者需权衡创新频率与创新质量；为模型发布策略提供指导：开放权重可促进整体技术进步但可能延迟自身发布；为反垄断和竞争政策提供参考：蒸馏效应塑造了独特的市场竞争动态。

reference: FEDS Notes No. 2026-06-26
title: Recent Developments in Foreign Direct Investment into the U.S
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Recent Developments in Foreign Direct Investment into the U.S

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: In 2025, U.S. tariffs rose sharply, contributing to record-high trade and economic policy uncertainty. Part of the motivation for the tariffs announced in April 2025 reflects a desire to spur foreign direct investment (FDI) into the United States.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025年美国关税大幅上升对贸易和经济政策不确定性的影响，并探讨了关税政策旨在吸引外国直接投资（FDI）进入美国的动机。
AI.research_question: 2025年美国关税上升如何影响贸易和经济政策不确定性？关税政策是否有效促进了外国直接投资（FDI）流入美国？
AI.motivation: 2025年美国关税大幅上升导致贸易和经济政策不确定性达到历史新高，同时政策制定者宣称关税旨在吸引FDI进入美国，本文旨在检验这一动机的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易政策不确定性理论、外国直接投资（FDI）区位选择理论、关税与投资关系的经济学理论。
AI.method: 基于2025年美国关税政策变化的实证分析，结合贸易和经济政策不确定性指数数据进行定量研究。
AI.findings: 2025年美国关税大幅上升导致了贸易和经济政策不确定性达到创纪录水平；关税政策的动机之一确实是为了吸引FDI进入美国。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关税政策与FDI流动之间关系的理论研究，特别是在高不确定性环境下的投资区位选择理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估关税政策对吸引FDI的实际效果提供依据，并提示高不确定性可能抵消关税吸引投资的预期效果。

title: Examining the Impact of Brexit and COVID-19 Pandemic on Sovereign and Bank Systemic Risk Co-Movements: A Value-at-Risk and Wavelet Analysis
affiliations: , University of Sousse, Dubai Business School- University of Dubai and SOAS University of London

detail.title: Examining the Impact of Brexit and COVID-19 Pandemic on Sovereign and Bank Systemic Risk Co-Movements: A Value-at-Risk and Wavelet Analysis
detail.abstract: : We analyze the impact on financial markets of two major, overlapping sources of uncertainty, the UK exit from the European Union and the pandemic. We examine how these compounded events have impacted the co-movement between systemic sovereign risk and systemic bank risk, utilizing Value-at-Risk (VaR) and wavelet-based methodologies. Systemic risk is measured in terms of sovereign and bank credit default swap (CDS) spreads for the United Kingdom, as well as for selected countries. In our analysis, wavelets capture the dynamic interdependencies and lead-lag relationships between sovereign and banking risk time series. For robustness, we use sovereign bond spreads as an alternative proxy for systemic risk. We found strong temporal correlations in systemic bank risk with a sovereign-driven pattern characterizing the EU and the USA during the pandemic. Moreover, we show that the co-movements between sovereign and bank systemic risks and broader financial systemic risk feature the influence of market dynamics on sovereign and banking activities.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了英国脱欧与新冠疫情两大不确定性事件对金融市场的影响，利用VaR和小波方法研究主权系统性风险与银行系统性风险之间的协同运动，发现疫情期间存在主权驱动的模式，且市场动态显著影响主权与银行活动。
AI.research_question: 英国脱欧与新冠疫情两大重叠不确定性事件如何影响主权系统性风险与银行系统性风险之间的协同运动？
AI.motivation: 两大重大不确定性事件（英国脱欧与疫情）叠加发生，其对金融市场的复合影响尚未被充分研究，尤其是对主权与银行系统性风险之间动态关系的传导机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、Value-at-Risk (VaR)方法论、小波分析（wavelet analysis）理论
AI.method: 采用VaR方法测度系统性风险，运用小波分析方法捕捉主权风险与银行风险时间序列之间的动态相互依赖关系及领先-滞后关系，并使用主权债券利差作为稳健性检验的替代指标。
AI.findings: （1）系统性银行风险存在强烈的时间相关性；（2）疫情期间，欧盟和美国呈现主权驱动的模式；（3）主权与银行系统性风险之间的协同运动以及更广泛的金融系统性风险，反映出市场动态对主权和银行活动的影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将小波分析方法应用于主权与银行系统性风险的动态关联研究，揭示了重大不确定性事件叠加下主权驱动型风险传导模式，丰富了系统性风险传染理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融监管机构在应对多重叠加危机时提供风险监测与预警的实证依据，有助于理解主权风险与银行风险之间的传导机制。

reference: FEDS Working Paper No. 2026-47
title: Cyclical Fluctuations, Financial Frictions, and Productivity Differences across Firms
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Korea University and National Research University Higher School of Economics (Moscow) - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Cyclical Fluctuations, Financial Frictions, and Productivity Differences across Firms

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Within narrowly defined industries, the most productive firms produce far more than the least productive from the same inputs, and this dispersion widens in downturns. We build a tractable representative-agent model in which financial frictions—adverse selection and moral hazard—make firms sort endogenously into lenders, strategic defaulters, and producers. As credit conditions vary, the resulting misallocation gives aggregate total factor productivity (TFP) an endogenous component that accounts for about 30 percent of the variance of TFP at business-cycle frequencies, a third of it from strategic default. We show that our tractable model can match key features of the observed distribution of productivity across firms and its co-movement with output growth and credit conditions in the data.
